local local_class = newclass('FoxMainSection12')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxMain @
		Comment = 호랑이와 대면. 인간들을 혼내주기로 마음먹음. @
		Index = 11 @
		NextSections = 12 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'fox_1_3'

	self.loop = true

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local town = get_character(string.format('town%d', i))
		character_util.set_active_state(town, 'disabled')
	end

	local tiger = get_character('tiger_man')
	character_util.set_direction(tiger, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(tiger, vector(-24.5, 1, 49.5))
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'attack', loop = true })

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('s12', 27, true, tiger)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local town = get_character('town'..i)
		character_util.set_active_state(town, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's12_tiger' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tiger_speech, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:tiger_speech()
	local nari = get_character('nari')
	local tiger = get_character('tiger_man')

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_pressing', state = 'event', mix = 0})
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-24.5, 1, 49.5), 2)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
	-- 형제들이여! 이젠 일어설 때가 되었다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_count_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.1 })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.2, 0.3)
	-- 인간들은 선을 넘었다! 지금 이 시간에도 우리 형제들은 목숨을 잃어가고 있다!
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_count_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.1 })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_to(2.9, 0.3)
	-- 이젠 맞설 차례다! 이빨을 벼리고, 발톱을 세워...
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_count_final_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_3', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.1 })

	-- 이게 미쳤나아아아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01'})
	-- bgm_transition: Field(ondemand/fox/preload:bgm_fox_main) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_4', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.3, screen_pos = vector(-200, -150) })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tiger)
	character_util.set_direction(tiger, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'surprise', loop = true })

	character_util.set_position(nari, vector(-24.5, 0, 42))
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'mad', loop = true })

	nari.SpineController:MarioJump(nari.Direction, 1, 3)
	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'sword_attack2', loop = false, scale = 0.6 })
	character_util.move_to(nari, tiger.Position, 1, nil)
	wait_for_sec(0.77)
	wait_for_sec(0.03)
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.1, 'slow')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_slowmotion_01'})
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.07))
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(tiger, 'right')
	character_util.move_to(tiger, vector(-22.5, 1, 49.5), 0.2, nil)
	tiger.SpineController:AddFadeColor(tiger.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0, 0, 1), 1, 0)
	tiger.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(tiger.Name, 1)
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'confused' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_missile_02'})
	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_trickery_theme)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(tiger.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(tiger.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(nari)
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('slow')

	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'right')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.move_async(nari.Position, 0, { end_target = nari })

	-- 이건 영물이란게... 정신이 있는거야 없는거야?
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_s12_5', skip = true})

	-- 이씨...
	character_util.shake(tiger, 0.04, 9999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'})
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_6', skip = true})

	-- 인간 쪽에 붙은 끄나풀 신선놈에게 할 말은 없다!
	tiger.SpineController:CancelShake()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_7', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 근데 이게 뚫린 입이라고...!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_s12_8', skip = true})

	character_util.move_to_async(nari, vector(-23, 1, 49.5), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tiger_damage, self, tiger))

	-- 크르르르, 아무리 때려도 내 긍지는 꺾이지 않...
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_9', skip = true})

	-- 잠깐, 이건 좀...
	camera_util.resize_to(3.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_10', skip = true})

	-- 저기, 말로 합시다 선생님!
	camera_util.resize_to(2.9, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_11', skip = true})

	-- 죄... 죄송합니다! 잘못했습니다! 그만 때리세요!
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.4)
	self.loop = false
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.move_to(nari, vector(-24, 1, 49.5), 0.3, nil)
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(tiger, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'scared', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01'})
	character_util.normal_jump(tiger)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_12', skip = true})

	-- 상황 설명해! 지금 당장!
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_s12_13', skip = true})

	-- 아 그게, 저흰 다른 신선님께서 내려주신 이 자루 덕분에 사람들을 해치지 않고 조용히 살고 있었습니다요...
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_14', skip = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_throw_01'})
	local flower_item_mind = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{itemid = 20025, notforinven = true, pos = tiger.Position,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', target = tiger.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
				+ vector(0, 0, 0), skip_text = true})
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	flower_item_mind.ConsumeTarget = tiger

	-- 그런데 이 인간놈들이, 이 자루가 탐이 났는지 저희 호랑이들을 공격하지 뭡니까?
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_15', skip = true})

	-- 저흰 최대한 충돌을 피해보려 했지만...
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_16', skip = true})

	-- 이 정도를 모르는 놈들은 급기야 숲을 마구 베고 새끼들을 납치해가기 시작했습니다!
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_17', skip = true})

	-- 이건 도저히 참을 수 없었습니다! 그래서 인간놈들을 모조리 도륙을 내기로...
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tiger, { key = 'fox_s12_18', skip = true})

	character_util.move_to_async(nari, vector(-23, 1, 49.5), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.26)
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'damaged' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.24)
	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_trickery_theme) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01'})
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(tiger.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(tiger.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(tiger)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(tiger, 1.15, 0.85, 1, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.24)

	-- 하.. 정말...
	character_util.move_to(nari, vector(-26, 1, 49.5), nil, 4, true, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_s12_19', skip = true})

	--...
	tiger.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_s13_3'

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	character_util.convert_to_npc(nari)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('s12')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2})

	--- 다음 섹션으로 진행
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:tiger_damage(target)
	while self.loop do
		wait_for_sec(0.26)
		if self.loop == false then break end
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.24)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01'})
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.15, 0.85, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.24)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FoxMainSection13')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxMain @
		Comment = 호랑이로 변신해서 인간들을 혼내줌. @
		Index = 12 @
		NextSections = 13 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'fox_1_3'

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		old_talk = 1,
		rescued = 2,
		runaway_old = 3,
		done = 4,
		after = 5
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	-- npc 이름
	self.guard_name = 'guard_'
	self.battle_citizen_name = 'tiger_battle_'
	self.tiger_baby_name = 'tiger_baby_'
	self.captured_tiger_name = 'captured_tiger_'
	self.bad_old_name = 'bad_old'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.tiger_prison_name = 'tiger_baby_prison_'
	self.tiger_barricade_name = 'tiger_barricade_'
	self.ending_house_name = 'ending_house_'
	self.forest_entrance_name = 'forest_entrance_'
	self.destroy_house_name = 'destroy_house_'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.tiger_guard_near_zone_name = 'tiger_guard_near_'
	self.tiger_battle_zone_name = 'tiger_battle_'
	self.tiger_battle_out_zone_name = 'tiger_battle_out_'
	self.after_tiger_zone_name = 'after_tiger_zone'
	self.tiger_salute_zone_name = 'tiger_salute_zone_'
	self.ending_bad_old_zone_name = 'ending_bad_old_zone'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.battle_out_marker_name = 'battle_out_marker_'

	-- 이펙트 이름
	self.hit_effect_name = 'FX_hit'
	self.dash_effect_name = 'fx_fox_tiger_dash'
	self.smoke_effect_name = 'FX_Common_SmokeScreen'

	-- 플레이어가 변신 했는지
	self.changed_player = false

	-- 호랑이가 전투하는 존에 있는지
	self.in_battle_zone = { false, false }

	-- 주민들이 도망 갔는지
	self.move_battle_citizen = { false, false }

	-- 전투하는 주민 수
	self.tiger_battle_citizen_count = { 5, 8 }

	-- 호랑이 감옥 수
	self.prison_count = 10

	-- 달리기 키를 상태인지
	self.run_key_down = false

	-- 호랑이 대시가 끝났는지
	self.end_dash = true

	-- 가드 충돌 체크 루틴이 실행중인지
	self.play_check_crash_routine = false

	-- 집이 파괴됐는지
	self.destroy_house = false

	-- 호랑이들이 경례를 했는지
	self.tiger_salute = { false, false }

	-- 가드들이 도망갔는지
	self.is_run_away_guard = { false, false, false }

	self.is_air_spin = {
		{ false, false },
		{ false, false },
		{ false, false }
	}

	-- 호랑이 대시 스킬로 집을 박아야 하는 횟수
	self.hit_house_count = 3

	-- 집을 대시 스킬로 박았는지
	self.hit_house = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_AuraSkill_Cast')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Boss_Engulf')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_thunderstrike')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_clock')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_fox_portal')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dash_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_name)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local town = get_character(string.format('town%d', i))
		character_util.set_active_state(town, 'disabled')
	end

	local nari = get_character('nari')
	character_util.set_active_state(nari, 'enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(nari, vector(-26, 1, 49.5))
	if nari.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		nari.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end

	local tiger = get_character('tiger_man')
	character_util.set_direction(tiger, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(tiger, vector(-22.5, 1, 49.5))
	character_util.set_anim(tiger, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tiger, { name = 'tired' })

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('s13', 27, true, nari)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.in_battle_zone = nil
	self.move_battle_citizen = nil
	self.tiger_battle_citizen_count = nil
	self.tiger_salute = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local nari = get_character('nari')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, nari) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.old_talk
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trans_tiger, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		-- 주민이 도망갈 때 특정 위치를 넘어가지 못하게 함 (옆으로 이동하도록 함)
		if e.FullEnter and not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			local _, end_index = string.find(zone_name, self.tiger_battle_out_zone_name)
			if end_index ~= nil then
				local zone_index = tonumber(string.sub(zone_name, end_index + 1, end_index + 1))
				local index = tonumber(string.sub(zone_name, end_index + 3, end_index + 3))

				for i = 1, self.tiger_battle_citizen_count[zone_index] do
					local battle_citizen = get_character(self.battle_citizen_name .. zone_index .. '_' .. i)
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, battle_citizen) then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.check_battle_out, self, battle_citizen , zone_index, index))
						return true
					end
				end

				return true
			end
		end

		if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

		-- 호랑이로 변신했을 때만
		if self.changed_player then
			-- 가드들 포효로 도망가도록 하는 존
			for i = 1, 3 do
				if zone_name == self.tiger_guard_near_zone_name .. i and not self.is_run_away_guard[i] then
					self.is_run_away_guard[i] = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.runaway_guard, self, i))
					return true
				end
			end

			-- 전투하는 주민들 포효로 도망가도록 하는 배틀존
			for i = 1, 2 do
				if zone_name == self.tiger_battle_zone_name .. i and not self.move_battle_citizen[i] then
					-- 주민들 적으로 변경
					for j = 1, self.tiger_battle_citizen_count[i] do
						local battle_citizen = get_character(self.battle_citizen_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
						character_util.convert_to_monster(
							battle_citizen, 'tiger_battle_' .. i, 'tiger_battle_' .. i)
						battle_citizen.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'tiger_battle_' .. i
						command_util.execute_monster_notice(battle_citizen, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

						self.in_battle_zone[i] = true
					end
					return true
				end
			end

			if zone_name == self.after_tiger_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.done then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.after
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tiger_after, self))
			end

			for i = 1, 2 do
				if zone_name == self.tiger_salute_zone_name .. i and
					self.current_progress == self.event_progress.old_talk and not self.tiger_salute[i] then
					self.tiger_salute[i] = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.salute_tiger, self, i))
				end
			end

			if zone_name == self.ending_bad_old_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.rescued then
				self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.runaway_bad_old, self)
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if self.changed_player then
			for i = 1, 2 do
				if zone_name == self.tiger_battle_zone_name .. i then
					self.in_battle_zone[i] = false
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

	if not self.changed_player then return false end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.run_key_down = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_crash_guard, self))
		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action2TouchDown then
		self.end_dash = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_crash_guard, self))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			self.end_dash = true
		end))

		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
		self.run_key_down = false
		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
		for k, v in pairs(self.in_battle_zone) do
			if v and not self.move_battle_citizen[k] then
				self.move_battle_citizen[k] = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_02')
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_roar, self, k))
				return true
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.prison_count do
		local prison = get_field_object(self.tiger_prison_name .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, prison) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rescue_tiger, self, i))
			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local house = get_field_object(self.ending_house_name .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, house) then

			camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)

			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {-1, 0, 0},
				20000, 0.03, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

			command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party.Leader.Owner, user_party.Leader, knock_back_info, nil)

			local effect_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_name):Instantiate(effect_pos)

			house.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.hit_house = false
				house.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
			end))

			if not self.hit_house then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
				self.hit_house = true
				self.hit_house_count = self.hit_house_count - 1
			else
				return true
			end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.speak_bad_old, self))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:battle_roar(index)
	local battle_citizens = {}
	for i = 1, self.tiger_battle_citizen_count[index] do
		local battle_citizen = get_character(self.battle_citizen_name .. index .. '_' .. i)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(battle_citizen)

		character_util.set_emotion(battle_citizen, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(battle_citizen, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		message_system:Send(battle_citizen.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(
			CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(battle_citizen)))

		table.insert(battle_citizens, battle_citizen)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- bgm_transition: Field(ondemand/fox/preload:bgm_fox_main) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 주민들 도망 루틴
	for _, v in pairs(battle_citizens) do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.runaway_battle_citizen, self, v, user_party.Leader.Position))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_fox_tiger)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_tiger', state = 'event'})

	-- 풀려난 호랑이들
	if index ==  1 then
		local tiger = get_character(self.captured_tiger_name .. 3)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tiger)
		character_util.stop_shake(tiger)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(tiger, { name = 'unique/shout' })

		local move_info = character_util.move_waypoint(
			tiger, tiger.Position + 7 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 10, true)

		wait_for_sec(move_info:GetDuration(tiger.Position) - 0.2)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(tiger, 0, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_active_state(tiger, 'disabled')

	elseif index == 2 then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local captured_tiger = get_character(self.captured_tiger_name .. i)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function(target)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
				character_util.stop_shake(target)
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(target, { name = 'unique/shout' })

				local move_info = character_util.move_waypoint(
					target, target.Position + 7 * unity_class.vector3.right, 10, true)

				wait_for_sec(move_info:GetDuration(target.Position) - 0.2)

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 0, 0.2)
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				character_util.set_active_state(target, 'disabled')
			end, captured_tiger))
		end
	end
end

-- 호랑이 포효로 도망가는 주민들 이동
function local_class:runaway_battle_citizen(fo, target_pos)
	fo.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetCollidedFieldObjects(fo.Bounds, 20 * (fo.Position - target_pos).normalized)
	local dist = 20
	if list ~= nil then
		local distance_list = list.Item1
		local obj_list = list.Item2
		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if obj.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
				dist = distance_list[i].distance
				break
			end
		end

		distance_list:Dispose()
		obj_list:Dispose()
	end

	local end_pos = fo.Position + dist * (fo.Position - target_pos).normalized

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, end_pos, 7)

	if fo.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
	character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.shake(fo, 0.04, 99999)
end

-- npc가 너무 멀리 도망가지 않도록 구역을 설정하여 해당 구역에 도착하면 옆의 벽으로 이동하도록
function local_class:check_battle_out(fo, zone_index, index)
	character_util.stop(fo)

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.battle_out_marker_name .. zone_index .. '_' .. index).position
	local target_pos

	local direction

	if zone_index == 1 then
		direction = 'up_down'
	elseif zone_index == 2 then
		if index == 1 then
			direction = 'right_left'
		elseif index == 2 then
			direction = 'up_down'
		elseif index == 3 then
			direction = 'right_left'
		end
	end

	if direction == 'up_down' then
		if marker.x < fo.Position.x then
			target_pos = marker + 2 * unity_class.vector3.left
		else
			target_pos = marker + 2 * unity_class.vector3.right
		end

	elseif direction == 'right_left' then
		if marker.x < fo.Position.z then
			target_pos = marker + 2 * unity_class.vector3.back
		else
			target_pos = marker + 2 * unity_class.vector3.forward
		end
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.runaway_battle_citizen, self, fo, target_pos))
end

-- 호랑이와 가드 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_crash_guard()
	if self.play_check_crash_routine then return end

	self.play_check_crash_routine = true

	while self.run_key_down or not self.end_dash do
		local leader = user_party.Leader

		local guards = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local zone_guards = {}

			for j = 1, 2 do
				local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
				table.insert(zone_guards, guard)
			end

			table.insert(guards, zone_guards)
		end

		-- 호랑이와 충돌한 물체 체크
		local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(leader.Position, leader.Bounds)

		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]

			for zone_index = 1, 3 do
				for index = 1, 2 do
					local guard = guards[zone_index][index]

					if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, guard) and not self.is_air_spin[zone_index][index] then
						-- 가드와 충돌 연출
						camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

						character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)
						character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fo)
						unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name):Instantiate(fo.Position)

						character_util.stop(fo)
						character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

						coroutine.yield(nil)

						local spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(fo,
							3 * direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction), 1, 0.25, true)

						message_system:SendSync(fo.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(spin_state))

						self.is_air_spin[zone_index][index] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.play_check_crash_routine = false
end

-- 도망가는 가드들
function local_class:runaway_guard(index)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local guards = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. index .. '_' .. i)
		guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	-- 가드가 도망가는 방향 및 경로 설정
	local runaway_dir = 1
	local way_points

	if index == 1 then
		if guards[1].Position.x < leader.Position.x then
			runaway_dir = 2
		end

		way_points = {
			{
				{
					vector(3, 0, 0),
					vector(3, 0, -1),
					vector(12, 0, -1)
				},
				{
					vector(3, 0, 0),
					vector(3, 0, -1),
					vector(12, 0, -1)
				}
			},
			{
				{
					vector(-6, 0, 0)
				},
				{
					vector(-6, 0, 0)
				}
			}
		}
	elseif index == 2 then
		if guards[1].Position.z < leader.Position.z then
			runaway_dir = 2
		end

		way_points = {
			{
				{
					vector(0, 0, 3),
					vector(-3, 0, 3)
				},
				{
					vector(0, 0, 4),
					vector(-4, 0, 4)
				}
			},
			{
				{
					vector(0, 0, -6),
					vector(-4, 0, -6),
				},
				{
					vector(0, 0, -6),
					vector(-5, 0, -6),
				}
			}
		}
	elseif index == 3 then
		if guards[1].Position.x < leader.Position.x then
			runaway_dir = 2
		end

		way_points = {
			{
				{
					vector(8, 0, 0)
				},
				{
					vector(8, 0, 0)
				}
			},
			{
				{
					vector(-7, 0, 0)
				},
				{
					vector(-7, 0, 0)
				}
			}
		}
	end

	-- 도망가는 가드들
	for k, v in pairs(guards) do
		v.Interactable.Talk = nil

		for i = 1, #way_points[runaway_dir][k] do
			way_points[runaway_dir][k][i] = way_points[runaway_dir][k][i] + v.Position
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.look_at(v, leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(v, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(v, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(v)

			if lua_helper.type_compare(v.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState) or
				v.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				return
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			if lua_helper.type_compare(v.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState) or
				v.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				return
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(v, way_points[runaway_dir][k], 7)

			wait_for_sec(0.05)

			if lua_helper.type_compare(v.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState) or
				v.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				return
			end

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(v)

			if v.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				character_util.set_direction(v, 'right')
			end

			character_util.set_emotion(v, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.set_anim(v, { name = 'prostrate' })

			character_util.shake(v, 0.04, 99999)

		end))

-- 도망가는 나쁜 노인
function local_class:runaway_bad_old()
	local bad_old = get_character(self.bad_old_name)

	camera_util.move_async(bad_old.Position, 0.7)

	character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_china_master_shout_01')
	-- 다들 뭣들 하는게냐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_30', skip = true })

	-- 어서 저 호랑이놈을 막아라!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_31', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 집을 스킬로 부술 수 있도록 변경
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local house = get_field_object(self.ending_house_name .. i)
		house.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.speak_bad_old, self))
end

function local_class:speak_bad_old()
	local bad_old = get_character(self.bad_old_name)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(bad_old)

	local current_count = self.hit_house_count

	while self.hit_house_count == 3 do
		-- 다들 뭣들 하는게냐!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_30', skip = true })

		if self.hit_house_count ~= 3 then
			return
		end

		-- 어서 저 호랑이놈을 막아라!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_31', skip = true })

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	if current_count == 3 then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bad_old)

	if current_count == 2 then
		character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump_async(bad_old)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_emotion(bad_old)

		character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	while self.hit_house_count == 2 do
		-- 야, 이 자식아! 이거 방탄기와야, 이 자식아!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_32', skip = true })

		if self.hit_house_count ~= 2 then
			return
		end

		-- 박아봐, 이 자식아!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_33', skip = true })

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	if current_count == 2 then
		return
	end

	if current_count == 1 then
		character_util.normal_jump_async(bad_old)

		character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
		-- 히이익!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_34', skip = true })

		-- 무… 무너진다...
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_old, { key = 'fox_s13_35', skip = true })

		return
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending_destroy, self)
end

-- 집 부수는 마지막 장면
function local_class:ending_destroy()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, vector(64, 0, -82.5), 2)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	camera_util.move(leader.Position, 0)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'pounce_ready', loop = false })
	-- 아직 한 방 남았다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({{ 'fox_s13_36', 'brutal' }})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	local dash_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dash_effect_name):Instantiate(leader.Position)
	dash_effect.transform:SetParent(leader.Transform)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + 4 * unity_class.vector3.right,
		10, true)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.3)

	local effect_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_name):Instantiate(effect_pos)

	local bad_old = get_character(self.bad_old_name)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bad_old)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_air_spin_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		bad_old.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(bad_old.Position)

		character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		local fall_duration = 1.5
		character_util.spine_rotate(bad_old, 360 * 8, fall_duration)
		character_util.move_to(bad_old, vector(65.5, 0, -83), fall_duration)
		bad_old.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(bad_old.Position)

		local time_passed = 0
		local height = 5

		while time_passed < fall_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fall_duration)

			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 5 * (1 + 4 * progress)) * height
			bad_old.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bad_old)

		character_util.set_direction(bad_old, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(bad_old, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(bad_old, { name = 'damaged', loop = true })
	end))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
	self.destroy_house = true

	self:old_be_dog()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:setting_stone()
	local stone = get_field_object('magic_stone')
	stone.Position = vector(-74.5, 0, -49)
	self.magic_stone = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5), sprscale = 0.5
			, itemid = 20181, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	self.magic_stone:SetSortingLayer(true)
	local time_passed = 0
	local check = false
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * (time_passed / 3)) + 1
		if y > 0.9 then
			check = true
			if self.water_effect ~= nil then
				self.water_effect:Dispose()
				self.water_effect = nil
			end
		end

		if y < 0.1 and check then
			self.water_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(self.magic_stone.Position)
			self.water_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			check = false
		end

		self.magic_stone.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.magic_stone.Position, y)
		self.magic_stone.ShadowTransform.position = stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 쓰레기 던지는
function local_class:throw_trash_to_target(thrower, target, emotion)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local random_count = random_util.get_random_int(1, 7)
	local itemid
	if random_count == 1 then
		itemid = 20169
	elseif random_count == 2 then
		itemid = 20173
	elseif random_count == 3 then
		itemid = 20019
	elseif random_count == 4 then
		itemid = 20009
	elseif random_count == 5 then
		itemid = 20051
	elseif random_count == 6 then
		itemid = 20081
	else
		itemid = 20014
	end

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = itemid, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
	if (rock.Position - target.Position).magnitude < 0.5 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	if emotion ~= nil then
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = emotion })
	else
		character_util.remove_emotion(target)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

		if e.Zone.Name == 'fairy_meet' and self.is_meet_fairy == false then
			if not self.fairy_zone_in_coroutine then
				self.fairy_zone_in_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy_zone_in, self, true))
				return true
			end
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'town_zone' and self.saw_town_zone == false then
			self.saw_town_zone = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.town_zone, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fairy2) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fairy3) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy2_first_talk, self, e.Target))
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('magic_stone')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_narration, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect)

function local_class:setting_stone()
	local stone = get_field_object('magic_stone')
	stone.Position = vector(-74.5,0,-49)
	self.magic_stone =  drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5), sprscale = 0.5
			, itemid = 20181, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	self.magic_stone:SetSortingLayer(true)
	local time_passed = 0
	local check = false
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * (time_passed / 3)) + 1
		if y > 0.9 then
			check = true
			if self.water_effect ~= nil then
				self.water_effect:Dispose()
				self.water_effect = nil
			end
		end

		if y < 0.1 and check then
			self.water_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(self.magic_stone.Position)
			self.water_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			check = false
		end

		self.magic_stone.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.magic_stone.Position, y)
		self.magic_stone.ShadowTransform.position =  stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:setting_people()
	local default_pos = field:GetMarker('setting_point_1').position
	local trash_pos = field:GetMarker('setting_point_2').position

	-- 가만히 서 있는 마을 사람 세팅

	character_util.set_direction(self.people1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.bandit, 'down')

	-- 쓰레기를 준비하는 마을 사람 세팅
	local trash_top = get_field_object('trash_top')
	trash_top.Position = trash_pos + vector(0,0,-2)
	trash_top.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))
	character_util.set_position(self.peoplef1, trash_pos + vector(-0.5,0,0))
	character_util.set_position(self.people2, trash_pos + vector(0.5,0,0))

	character_util.set_emotion(self.people2, { name = 'doyagao' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.people2, { name = 'success', loop = true })

	local trash_people = get_character('throw_people_4')
	character_util.set_position(trash_people, trash_pos + vector(-2,0,-2))
	character_util.set_direction(trash_people, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(trash_people, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.set_anim(trash_people, { name = 'success', loop = true })
	-- 히히, 이거면 이번에는 놈들도 포기하겠지??
	trash_people.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_4'

	local trash_people2 = get_character('throw_people_5')
	character_util.set_position(trash_people2, trash_pos + vector(2,0,-2))
	character_util.set_direction(trash_people2, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(trash_people2, { name = 'doyagao' })
	-- 욕심쟁이 선녀놈들. 쓰레기 맛 좀 봐라!
	trash_people2.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_3'

	-- 쓰레기 더미 세팅
	self.trash_list = {}
	local count = 0
	while count < 30 do
		local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1.0, 1.0)
		local z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, -3)

		local throw_pos = trash_pos + vector(x, 0, z)

		local random_count = count % 7 + 1
		local itemid
		if random_count == 1 then
			itemid = 20169
		elseif random_count == 2 then
			itemid = 20173
		elseif random_count == 3 then
			itemid = 20019
		elseif random_count == 4 then
			itemid = 20009
		elseif random_count == 5 then
			itemid = 20051
		elseif random_count == 6 then
			itemid = 20081
		else
			itemid = 20014
		end

		local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = throw_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

		local rotation = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 360)
		trash_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotation, 0)
		trash_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotation, 0)
		table.insert(self.trash_list, trash_item)

		count = count + 1
	end

	-- 호수 쪽으로 가까이 가지마.
	self.people1.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_1'
	-- 선녀들은 욕심쟁이야!
	self.bandit.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_2'

	-- 욕심쟁이 선녀놈들. 쓰레기 맛 좀 봐라!
	self.peoplef1.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_3'
	-- 히히, 이거면 이번에는 놈들도 포기하겠지??
	self.people2.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_4'

	-- 길목을 막는 NPC 세팅
	local gate_people = get_character('gate_people_1')
	local gate_people2 = get_character('gate_people_2')
	local gate_people3 = get_character('gate_people_3')
	local gate_people4 = get_character('gate_people_4')
	local open_position = stage.Field:GetMarker('open_point').position
	local close_position2 = field:GetMarker('close_point_2').position

	character_util.reset_all_state(gate_people, 'down')
	character_util.reset_all_state(gate_people2, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(gate_people, open_position)
	character_util.set_position(gate_people2, open_position + vector(0,0,-3))
	--  흥!
	gate_people.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_18'
	-- 뻔뻔한 선녀들...
	gate_people2.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_19'

	character_util.reset_all_state(gate_people4, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(gate_people3, close_position2 + vector(2,0,1))
	character_util.set_position(gate_people4, close_position2 + vector(2,0,-2))
	gate_people3.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_18'
	gate_people4.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_main_s15_19'

	character_util.set_anim(self.fairy2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party.Leader})

		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil, 4, true, true, false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

function local_class:moving_baby()
	local baby = get_character('turtle_1')
	local baby2 = get_character('turtle_2')
	local baby3 = get_character('turtle_3')

	local start_position = vector(-107, 0, -75)
	local start_position2 = vector(-106, 0, -80)
	local start_position3 = vector(-95, 0, -79)
	character_util.set_position(baby, start_position)
	character_util.set_position(baby2, start_position2)
	character_util.set_position(baby3, start_position3)

	local count = 1
	while true do
		if count % 3 == 1 then
			character_util.move_to(baby, start_position + vector(0,0,0.4), 1, nil, true ,true)
			character_util.move_to(baby2, start_position2 + vector(-0.4,0,0), 1, nil, true ,true)
			character_util.move_to(baby3, start_position3 + vector(0.5,0,0), 1, nil, true ,true)
		elseif count % 3 == 2 then
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					"physics", true, vector(0,0,-1), 8000, 0.05,
					CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
			local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(baby, knock_back_info)

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = baby, loop = false, max_distance = 12 })
			baby.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
			baby.SpineController:AddFadeColor(baby.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0, 0, 1), 1, 0)
			baby.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(baby.Name, 1)

			knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					"physics", true, vector(1,0,0), 8000, 0.05,
					CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
			ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(baby2, knock_back_info)

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = baby2, loop = false, max_distance = 12 })
			baby2.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
			baby2.SpineController:AddFadeColor(baby2.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0, 0, 1), 1, 0)
			baby2.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(baby2.Name, 1)

			character_util.move_to(baby3, start_position3, 1, nil, true ,true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		count = count + 1
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:baby_game(option)
	if option then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 1, 6 do
			local worm_game_gate = get_field_object('wormgame_gate_' .. i)
			worm_game_gate.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end

		self.fairy3:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		self.fairy3.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	self.game_playing = true

	local game_position = stage.Field:GetMarker('start_point').position
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("save_baby")

	-- 파티원들 제외
	self:deactivate_my_party(false)

	-- 리더 위치 변경
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, game_position)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 선녀 설정
	character_util.set_direction(self.fairy3, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(self.fairy3, game_position + vector(1,0,0))
	self.fairy3.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.fairy3, user_party, 0, 0, 0.3, false)
	self.fairy3:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))

	-- 자라 세팅
	local current_pos = vector(0,0,0)
	for i = 1, self.baby_count do
		local baby = get_character('turtle_' .. i)
		local x = random_util.get_random_int(1, 6)
		local y = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
		local init_pos = stage.Field:GetMarker('move_point_' .. x).position + vector(0,0, y * 2)
		local rand_dir = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
		if rand_dir == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(baby, 'left')
		elseif rand_dir == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(baby, 'up')
		elseif rand_dir == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(baby, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(baby, 'down')
		end
		if current_pos ~= init_pos then
			character_util.set_position(baby, init_pos)
			baby.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			baby.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			character_util.remove_anim(baby)
			character_util.remove_emotion(baby)
		else
			i = i - 1
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--camera_util.move(vector(-99,0,-77), 0)
	--camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = "victory_get", loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if option then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 1 })
	end
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 플레이어 state 변경
	local speed = 4
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerWormGameMoveState.Create(user_party.Leader, speed, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	local cur_position = vector(99,0,99)
	local check_time = 0
	self.run_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.fairy3, { name = 'run' })
	local count = 0
	-- 게임 진행 중 다음에 나올 자라 생성
	while self.get_count < self.baby_count do
		local baby = get_character('turtle_' .. self.get_count + 1)
		if baby.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			baby.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_guild_warp_01')

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(baby.Position)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_collision, self, baby))

			-- 마리 남았어요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.fairy3,
					{ key=  game_string:Format("fox_main_s16_20", self.baby_count - self.get_count)
					})
		end

		if not self.is_pause then
			if cur_position == user_party.Leader.Position then
				check_time = check_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				if check_time > 0.05 then
					self.baby_game_coroutine = nil

					local knock_back_info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
					knock_back_info.type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
					knock_back_info.stun = true
					knock_back_info.direction = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
					knock_back_info.impactForce = 5000
					knock_back_info.impactTime = 0.05
					knock_back_info.muCoefficient = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient

					local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party.Leader, knock_back_info)
					user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_save_baby, self, false))
					return
				end
			else
				cur_position = user_party.Leader.Position
				check_time = 0
			end
		end

		if self.get_count >= count then
			count = count + 1
			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.speed = speed + self.get_count * 0.15
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.get_count == self.baby_count then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_save_baby, self, true))
		return
	end
end

-- 자라 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_collision(baby)

	local leader_crashed = false
	local next_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local cur_pos = next_pos
	while not leader_crashed and lua_helper.type_compare(baby.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour) do
		cur_pos = next_pos
		next_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

		local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(user_party.Leader.Bounds, next_pos - cur_pos)

		if collide_fos:Contains(baby) and not leader_crashed then
			leader_crashed = true
		end

		collide_fos:Dispose()
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if leader_crashed then
		baby.Position = cur_pos
		baby.Direction = user_party.Leader.Direction;
		baby.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(baby, user_party, self.get_count + 1, 0, 0.3, false)
		baby:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		self.get_count = self.get_count + 1

		baby.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_anim(baby, { name = 'walk', scale = 2 })
	end
end

-- 전체 파티원 제외
function local_class:deactivate_my_party(option)
	-- option : false 경우 파티원 제외
	-- option : true 경우 따라다니던 토끼 제외
	if not option then
		self.my_party_list = {}

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local cur_party_member = user_party[i]

			table.insert(self.my_party_list, cur_party_member)
		end

		for i = 1, #self.my_party_list do
			if i ~= 1 then
				character_util.convert_to_npc(self.my_party_list[i])
				self.my_party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end
		end
	else
		for i = 1, self.baby_count do
			local baby = get_character('turtle_' .. i)
			baby:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			baby.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.set_position(baby, vector(99, 0, 99))
			baby.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

-- 제외했던 파티원 합류
function local_class:activate_my_party()
	for i = 1, #self.my_party_list do
		if i ~= 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.my_party_list[i], user_party, false)

			self.my_party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:action_qte(type)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	self.listening_touch_event = true

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	while self.qte_type == nil or self.qte_type ~= type do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.qte_type = nil

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.listening_touch_event = false
end

		for i, item in ipairs(self.trash_list) do
			if item ~= nil then
				item:ConsumeComplete()
			end
		end
		self.trash_list = nil
	end

	if self.setting_stone_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.setting_stone_coroutine)
		self.setting_stone_coroutine = nil
	end

	if self.magic_stone ~= nil then
		self.magic_stone:ConsumeComplete()
		self.magic_stone = nil
	end
	if self.water_effect ~= nil then
		self.water_effect:Dispose()
		self.water_effect = nil
	end

	get_field_object('magic_stone').Position = vector(99,0,99)
	get_field_object('fairy_diary_1').Position = vector(99,0,99)
	get_field_object('fairy_diary_2').Position = vector(99,0,99)

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if (e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1' or
					e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1_2' or
					e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1_3')
					and self.morning_check == false then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy_warn, self, e.Zone.Name))
				return true
			end

			if e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check2' and self.morning_check == false then
				self.morning_check = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_check, self))
				return true
			end

			if e.Zone.Name == 'save_baby' and not self.save_start and not self.clear_game then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_baby_game, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e.Params[0] == 'over_worm_game' and self.game_playing then
		stop_coroutine(self.baby_game_coroutine)
		self.baby_game_coroutine = nil
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_save_baby, self, false))
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fairy2) and self.clear_game then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_fairy, self))
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('magic_stone')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_narration, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_type = 'up'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_type = 'right'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_type = 'down'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_type = 'left'
		end
		return true

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent) then
		self.is_pause = true
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent) then
		self.is_pause = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fox_lightning_kick_start')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fox_lightning_kick_ready')

	self.attach_sprite_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attach_sprite, self))

	local diameter = 1
	local trash_area = field:GetZone('trash_area').Bounds
	local area_width = math.floor(trash_area.size.x)
	local area_height = math.floor(trash_area.size.z)
	local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(trash_area.center) + unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) + unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
	for y = 0, area_height - 1 do
		for x = 0, area_width - 1 do
			local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (diameter / 2.0 + x)
			local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (diameter / 2.0 + y)
			local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset + vector(0, 0, 1)
			table.insert(self.trash_points, target_point)
		end
	end

	return true

function local_class:setting_stone()
	local stone = get_field_object('magic_stone')
	stone.Position = vector(-74.5, 0, -49)
	self.magic_stone = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = stone.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), sprscale = 0.5
			, itemid = 20181, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	self.magic_stone:SetSortingLayer(true)

	local time_passed = 0
	local check = false
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * (time_passed / 3)) + 1
		if y > 0.9 then
			check = true
			if self.water_effect ~= nil then
				self.water_effect:Dispose()
				self.water_effect = nil
			end
		end

		if y < 0.1 and check then
			self.water_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(self.magic_stone.Position)
			self.water_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			check = false
		end

		self.magic_stone.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.magic_stone.Position, y)
		self.magic_stone.ShadowTransform.position = stone.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 바구니 스프라이트 부착
function local_class:attach_sprite()
	local basket = get_field_object('trash_basket')
	local basket_2 = get_field_object('trash_basket_2')
	local id = 20179
	local basket_sprite = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = basket.Position, target = basket.Position
			, itemid = id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	local basket_sprite2 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = basket_2.Position, target = basket_2.Position
			, itemid = id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	self.basket_list = {}
	table.insert(self.basket_list, basket_sprite)
	table.insert(self.basket_list, basket_sprite2)

	basket.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 0.4))
	basket_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 0.4))

	while true do
		basket_sprite.Position = basket.Position
		basket_sprite2.Position = basket_2.Position

		if self.get_item_list ~= nil then
			for i, sprite in ipairs(self.get_item_list) do
				if sprite ~= nil then
					if i <= 4 then
						sprite.Position = basket_2.Position + vector(-0.3 + i * 0.06, 0.1 + i * 0.002, 0)
					else
						if i % 2 == 1 then
							if i <= 16 then
								sprite.Position = basket.Position + vector(-0.25 + (i - 4) * 0.03, 0.1 + i * 0.001, 0)
							else
								sprite.Position = basket.Position + vector(-0.20 + (i - 16) * 0.03, 0.2 + i * 0.001, 0.1)
							end
						else
							if i <= 16 then
								sprite.Position = basket_2.Position + vector(-0.3 + i * 0.03, 0.1 + i * 0.001, 0)
							else
								sprite.Position = basket_2.Position + vector(-0.25 + (i - 16) * 0.03, 0.2 + i * 0.001, 0.1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_timer, self, 20))

	local sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	local complete = false
	while true do
		self:update_count_ui(self.drop_count)
		if self.give_up_count >= self.clear_count then
			complete = true
			break
		elseif self.drop_count >= self.fail_count then
			complete = false
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	sound:Stop()

	if throw_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(throw_coroutine)
		throw_coroutine = nil
	end

	self:detach_count_ui()
	self:end_timer()
	-- 완료
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_game, self, complete))
end

-- Timer 시작
function local_class:start_timer(duration)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer);

	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, duration, nil,
			CS.Oak.InGameTimer.TimerType.DeltaTime)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
end

-- 타이머 중단
function local_class:end_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end

-- 쓰레기 던지는 위치 설정
function local_class:throw_trash()
	local current_pos = self.trash_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.trash_points)]
	while true do
		local throw_pos = self.trash_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.trash_points)]
		local dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((current_pos - throw_pos).magnitude)

		if dist >= 2 and dist < 5 then
			current_pos = throw_pos
			-- 랜덤 시민이 쓰레기를 던짐
			local people = get_character('throw_people_' .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 3))
			wait_for_sec(0.45)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(people
			, { key = "fox_main_s17_" .. random_util.get_random_int(8, 10) })
			character_util.set_anim(people, { name = 'hold_loop', loop = true })
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			character_util.set_anim(people, { name = 'throw', loop = false })
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.throw_item_check, self, people.Position, throw_pos))

			character_util.set_anim(people, { name = 'idle' })
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 아이템 떨어짐, 충돌 체크
function local_class:throw_item_check(start_pos, throw_pos, option)

	local random_count = random_util.get_random_int(1, 7)
	local itemid
	if random_count == 1 then
		itemid = 20169
	elseif random_count == 2 then
		itemid = 20173
	elseif random_count == 3 then
		itemid = 20019
	elseif random_count == 4 then
		itemid = 20009
	elseif random_count == 5 then
		itemid = 20051
	elseif random_count == 6 then
		itemid = 20081
	else
		itemid = 20014
	end

	local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = start_pos, target = throw_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(throw_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, 1)

	attack_range:Show()

	local giv_up = false

	-- 던져지는 스피드
	local time_passed = 0
	local throw_duration = 1.7
	local check = false
	while time_passed < throw_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / throw_duration)
		local cur_h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 7

		trash_item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, throw_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_h
		if option == nil then
			local dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((trash_item.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude)
			if dist < 1 then
				giv_up = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_enhance_light_01')
				--self.give_up_count = self.give_up_count + 1
				local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(trash_item.Position)
				effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)
				trash_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
				trash_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
				trash_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
				table.insert(self.get_item_list, trash_item)
				break
			end
		else
			if throw_duration - time_passed < 0.3 and not check then
				check = true
				character_util.move_to(self.fairy3, throw_pos, 0.3, nil, true, true)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

	if option ~= nil then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_enhance_light_01')
		trash_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
		trash_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
		trash_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		table.insert(self.get_item_list, trash_item)
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(trash_item.Position)
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)
	else
		if not giv_up then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_snowball_hit_01')

			self.drop_count = self.drop_count + 1

			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = 1
			local custom_alpha = 1
			local shadow_alpha = 1

			while time_passed <= duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (time_passed / duration))

				local custom_sprite = trash_item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
				local shadow_sprite = trash_item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

				custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ custom_alpha * alpha_progress
				, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress })
				shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress
				custom_sprite:Rebuild()
				shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			wait_for_sec(2)
			trash_item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_trash_top()
	local top = get_field_object('trash_throw_point')

	top.Position = vector(-54, 0, -78)
	self.item_list = {}

	local count = 0
	while count < 40 do
		local people = get_character('throw_people_' .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 5))
		character_util.set_anim(people, { name = 'throw', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1.2, 1.2)
		local z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1.2, 1.2)

		local throw_pos = top.Position + vector(x, 0, z)

		local random_count = count % 7 + 1
		local itemid
		if random_count == 1 then
			itemid = 20169
		elseif random_count == 2 then
			itemid = 20173
		elseif random_count == 3 then
			itemid = 20019
		elseif random_count == 4 then
			itemid = 20009
		elseif random_count == 5 then
			itemid = 20051
		elseif random_count == 6 then
			itemid = 20081
		else
			itemid = 20014
		end

		local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = people.Position, target = throw_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
		table.insert(self.item_list, trash_item)

		character_util.set_anim(people, { name = 'idle' })
		coroutine.yield()
		count = count + 1
	end
end

	local custom_alpha = 1
	local shadow_alpha = 1

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1.2
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (time_passed / duration))
		for i, sprite in ipairs(throw_list) do

			local custom_sprite = sprite.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			local shadow_sprite = sprite.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ custom_alpha * alpha_progress
			, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress })
			shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress
			custom_sprite:Rebuild()
			shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i, sprite in ipairs(throw_list) do

		end
	end
	throw_list = nil

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if (e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1' or
				e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1_2' or
				e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check1_3')
				and self.morning_check == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy_warn, self, e.Zone.Name))
			return true
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'morning_check2' and self.morning_check == false then
			self.morning_check = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_check, self))
			return true
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'search_fairy' and self.game_start and not self.saw_bed then
			self.saw_bed = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_bed, self)
		end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'wave_battle_zone' and self.saw_bed then
			quest_marker_util.remove('move_bed')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'go_home', get_field_object('fairy_in'))
			return true
		end
		if e.Zone.Name == 'search_fairy' and self.saw_bed then
			quest_marker_util.remove('go_home')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'move_bed', get_field_object('bed_2'))
			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) then
		if e.IsComplete then
			self.give_up_count = self.clear_count

			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_type = 'up'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_type = 'right'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_type = 'down'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_type = 'left'
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('bed_2')) and self.game_start then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_act, self))
			return true
		end

		if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('trash_basket')) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('trash_basket_2')))
				and not self.game_start and self.morning_check then
			self.game_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_up_trash, self, true))
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('magic_stone')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_narration, self))
			return true
		end

		if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('fairy_diary_1'))
				or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('fairy_diary_2'))) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.diary_talk, self, get_field_object('fairy_diary_2'))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

			{ pos = stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5), sprscale = 0.5
			, itemid = 20181, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	self.magic_stone:SetSortingLayer(true)
	local time_passed = 0
	local check = false
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * (time_passed / 3)) + 1

			check = true
			if self.water_effect ~= nil then
				self.water_effect:Dispose()
				self.water_effect = nil
			end
		end

		if y < 0.1 and check then
			self.water_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(self.magic_stone.Position)
			self.water_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			check = false
		end

		self.magic_stone.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.magic_stone.Position, y)
		self.magic_stone.ShadowTransform.position =  stone.Position + vector(0,0,0.5)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:exit()

		self.controller = nil
		self.quest_spec = nil
