	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local diary = get_field_object('fairy_diary_1')
	local diary2 = get_field_object('fairy_diary_2')

	diary.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)
	diary2.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)

	self.fairy2 = nil
	self.monkey = nil
	self.bully1 = nil
	self.bully5 = nil
	self.bully4 = nil
	self.bully3 = nil
	self.tiger  = nil
	self.cat  = nil
	self.dog  = nil

	self.fairy = nil
	self.fairy2 = nil
	self.nari = nil

	if self.setting_stone_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.setting_stone_coroutine)
		self.setting_stone_coroutine = nil
	end

	if self.magic_stone ~= nil then
		self.magic_stone:ConsumeComplete()
		self.magic_stone = nil
	end
	if self.water_effect ~= nil then
		self.water_effect:Dispose()
		self.water_effect = nil
	end

	if self.memo_item ~= nil then
		self.memo_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.memo_item = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'nari_says_hi_zone' and not self.is_nari_saying and not self.talk_with_nari_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nari_says_come_on, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'wave_battle_zone' and not self.talk_with_nari_over and self.interact_memo_check then
			quest_marker_util.remove('go_nari')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'nari', self.nari)
			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'search_fairy' and not self.talk_with_nari_over and self.interact_memo_check then
			quest_marker_util.remove('nari')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'go_nari', get_field_object('fairy_exit'))
			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('magic_stone')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_narration, self))
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.nari) and not self.talk_with_nari_over then
			self.talk_with_nari_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_nari, self))
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('memo')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_memo, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

-- 배틀 시작
function local_class:wave_battle(wave_count)
	if wave_count == 1 then
		-- 3번의 웨이브 동안 bgm이 전투로 고정되도록 필드 bgm을 비워서 자동으로 돌아가지 않도록 함.
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
		--music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

		-- 팡파레 나오지 않도록 설정
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('fairy_in')
		get_field_object('fairy_in').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	local i = 1
	while true do
		local bully = get_character('wave_' .. wave_count .. '_' .. i)

		if bully == nil then
			break
		end
		local position = field:GetMarker('wave_point_' .. i).position
		character_util.set_active_state(bully, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_emotion(bully, { name = 'mad' })
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		local duration = (position - bully.Position).magnitude / 8
		if i <= 4 then
			character_util.move_to(bully, position, duration, nil, true, true)
			character_util.jump(bully, 1.7, duration)
		else
			character_util.move_to(bully, position, duration, nil, true, true)
			character_util.jump(bully, 1.7, duration)
		end
		i = i + 1
	end

	if wave_count == 1 then
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 선녀다 잡아!!!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'fox_main_s19_4', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, 300), scale = 1.5 })

		for j = 1, 6 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(string.format("wave_battle_" .. j), false))
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

	i = 1
	while true do
		local bully = get_character('wave_' .. wave_count .. '_' .. i)

		if bully == nil then
			break
		end
		character_util.convert_to_monster(bully, 'wave_battle')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(bully, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		i = i + 1
	end

	self.current_wave = self.current_wave + 1
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'wave_battle_zone' and self.current_wave == 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('search_fairy')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle, self, self.current_wave))
			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'search_fairy' and self.rage_fairy_over == false then
			self.rage_fairy_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rage_fairy, self))
			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'find_diary' and not self.saw_in_fairy_room then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.in_fairy_room, self)
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'wave_battle' then
			if self.current_wave <= 3 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject
				, util.cs_generator(self.wave_battle, self, self.current_wave))
				return true
			elseif self.search_fairy_check == false then
				-- WAVE 배틀 완료 직후
				get_field_object('fairy_in').ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'fairy_in', get_field_object('fairy_in'))
				for j = 1, 6 do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(string.format("wave_battle_" .. j)))
				end
			end

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.finish_battle, self)
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('human_male1')) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('human_male2')) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	self.garam_kid.SpineController:RemoveColor(self.garam_kid.Name, 0)
	self.garam.SpineController:AddColor(self.garam.Name, self.opening_tint_color, 1, 0)
	self.garam_kid.SpineController:AddColor(self.garam_kid.Name, self.opening_tint_color, 1, 0)

	for i=1, 5 do
		local temp = get_character('s2_npc'..i)

	end

	temp = get_character('tiger')

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s2_npc3) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s2_ending, self))
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_obj) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exit_func, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('garam_kid')) then
		return false
	end
	if e.Zone.Name == 's2_ending' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s2_ending, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	local garam_kid_girl = get_character('garam_kid_girl')

	if garam_kid_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		garam_kid_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local garam_kid_girl = get_character('garam_kid_girl')


	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'garam_fight_against_thieves_zone' and self.garam_fight_against_thieves_over == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_fight_against_thieves, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'girl_talk_zone' and self.girl_talk_over == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.girl_talk_zone_enter, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'garam_see_girl_back_and_fight_enemy_zone' and self.garam_see_girl_back_and_fight_enemy_over == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_see_girl_back_and_fight_enemy, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'see_girl_first_zone' and self.is_seeing_girl_first == false then
			self.is_seeing_girl_first = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_girl_first, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'see_girl_second_zone' and self.is_seeing_girl_second == false then
			self.is_seeing_girl_second = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_girl_second, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'see_girl_third_zone' and self.is_seeing_girl_third == false then
			self.is_seeing_girl_third = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_girl_third, self))

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, garam_kid_girl) and not self.girl_talk_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.girl_talk, self))
			return true

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('flower_grave')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.grave_interact, self, e.Target))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_win, self))
		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_open, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

end

function local_class:knock_back_character(character, direction)
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'physics', true, direction, 13000, 0.05,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(character, knock_back_info)
	character.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	character.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	character.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
end

function local_class:orb_fx_on(orb_pos)

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
		effect:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:thieves_move()
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local enemy = get_character('enemy_3_'..i)
		if i <= 3 then
			local civil_dead = get_character('civil_dead_'..i)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_dead, self, enemy, civil_dead))

		else
			if enemy.Position.z ~= 54.5 then
				character_util.move_to_async(enemy, vector(enemy.Position.x, 0, 54.5), nil, 5, true, true)

			elseif enemy.Position.x ~= 37.5 then
				character_util.move_to_async(enemy, vector(37.5, 0, enemy.Position.z), nil, 5, true, true)

			end
			character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)
			character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'dagger_idle', loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(enemy, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_to_dead(enemy, civil_dead)
	if enemy.Position.z ~= civil_dead.Position.z then
		character_util.move_to_async(enemy, vector(enemy.Position.x, 0, civil_dead.Position.z), nil, 5, true, true)

	end

	if enemy.Position.x > civil_dead.Position.x then
		character_util.move_to_async(enemy, vector(civil_dead.Position.x + 0.3, 0, enemy.Position.z), nil, 5, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'left')

	elseif enemy.Position.x <= civil_dead.Position.x then
		character_util.move_to_async(enemy, vector(civil_dead.Position.x - 0.3, 0, enemy.Position.z), nil, 5, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'right')

	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)
	character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(enemy, { name = 'greed', loop = true })
end

function local_class:npc_move_one_by_one()

		local civil = get_character('civil_'..i)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end
end

--마을 사람들 애니메이션 및 이모션 설정
function local_class:npc_move_to_garam_side(npc, number)
	local randomint = unity_class.random.Range(-0.1, 0.1)

	if number == 1 or number == 6 or number == 11 then
		if number % 2 == 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, { key = 'fox_main_s20_18', skip = true })
		else
			if number == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02'})
			end
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, { key = 'fox_main_s20_19', skip = true })
		end
	end

	if number % 3 == 0 then

		character_util.shake(npc, 0.04, 0.2)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)

		character_util.mario_jump_async(npc, npc.Direction, 0.5, 0.3)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if npc.Position.x < self.civil_end_pos[number].x or npc.Position.x < self.civil_end_pos[number].x then
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(self.civil_end_pos[number].x, 0, npc.Position.z), nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		else
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, self.civil_end_pos[number], nil, 6, true, true)

		end

		if npc.Position.z < self.civil_end_pos[number].z or npc.Position.z < self.civil_end_pos[number].z then
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, self.civil_end_pos[number].z), nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		else
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, self.civil_end_pos[number], nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		end

		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')

		if number % 2 == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success', loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile', loop = true })

		else
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'clap', loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		end

	else
		character_util.stop_shake(npc)

		if npc.Position.x < self.civil_end_pos[number].x or npc.Position.x < self.civil_end_pos[number].x then
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(self.civil_end_pos[number].x, 0, npc.Position.z), nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		else
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, self.civil_end_pos[number], nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		end

		if npc.Position.z < self.civil_end_pos[number].z or npc.Position.z < self.civil_end_pos[number].z then
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, self.civil_end_pos[number].z), nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		else
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, self.civil_end_pos[number], nil, 6 + randomint, true, true)

		end

		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')

		if number % 2 == 1 then
			if number == 6 then
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
			else
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success', loop = true })
			end

			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile', loop = true })

		else
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'clap', loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		end
	end

	if number == 6 then
		wait_for_sec(3)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success', loop = true })
	end
end


--가람으로 플레이어블 캐릭터 바꾸기
function local_class:change_to_garam()
	local garam = get_character('garam')

	local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1

		user_party[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(garam, param)

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()

	local garam = get_character('garam')
	local garam_kid_girl = get_character('garam_kid_girl')
	garam.SpineController:AddColor(garam.Name, self.remember_color, 1, 0)
	garam_kid_girl.SpineController:AddColor(garam_kid_girl.Name, self.remember_color, 1, 0)

	garam_kid_girl:HideWeapon(true)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_yellow')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Proj_Explosion_Light')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('fox_door_5', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('fox_door_6', false))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic("ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_flashback", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 2)

	--이전 섹션에서 넘어오지 않은 경우
	if user_party.Leader ~= garam then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_to_garam, self))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_and_girl_talk, self))
	end

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'civil_fight_about_silk_zone' and not self.has_seen_silk_fight then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_fight_about_silk, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'civil_fight_about_land_zone' and not self.has_seen_land_fight and self.is_silk_fight_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_fight_about_land, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'someone_shout_zone' and not self.has_heard_someone_shout and self.is_silk_fight_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.someone_shout, self))

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_1')) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_2')) then
			if not self.is_silk_fight_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_solve_first_problem, self))
				return true
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_11')) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_12')) then
			if self.is_land_fight_over == false and self.is_silk_fight_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_solve_second_problem, self))
				return true
			end

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_type = 'up'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_type = 'right'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_type = 'down'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_type = 'left'
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:orb_fx_on(orb_pos)
	while self.flashback_start == false do
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_instant_heal_stomp_01'})
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_yellow'):Instantiate(orb_pos)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.flashback_start == true then
			effect:Dispose()
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.flashback_start == true then
			effect:Dispose()
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.flashback_start == true then
			effect:Dispose()
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.flashback_start == true then
			effect:Dispose()
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		effect:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:action_qte(type)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	self.listening_touch_event = true

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	while self.qte_type == nil or self.qte_type ~= type do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.qte_type = nil

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.listening_touch_event = false
end

function local_class:item_shake(item_object, amplitude, duration)
	local pos_1 = item_object.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local pos_2 = item_object.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local time = 0
	while time < duration do
		if self.stop_shake then
			break
		end
		local rand_1 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)
		local rand_2 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)

        item_object.SpriteTransform.localPosition = pos_1 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)
		item_object.ShadowTransform.localPosition = pos_2 + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_2)

		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj_Explosion')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char_black')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_dark')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_purple')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('fox_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('fox_door_2', false))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic('ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_flashback', CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 2)

	self:civil_move_to_real_map()

	local garam = get_character('garam')

	get_character('garam_kid_girl'):HideWeapon(true)

	--이전 섹션에서 넘어오지 않은 경우
	if user_party.Leader ~= garam then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_to_garam, self))

	else
		user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
	end

end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.flower_item = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_4' and self.has_seen_girl_die and self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and not self.battle_4_over and not self.battle_4_entered then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_4_enter, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_5' and self.has_seen_girl_die and self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and not self.battle_5_over and not self.battle_5_entered then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_5_enter, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_6' and self.has_seen_girl_die and self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and not self.battle_6_over and not self.battle_6_entered then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_6_enter, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'civil_talk_with_garam' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over and not self.civil_talk_to_garam_over
		 and self.interact_to_house_over then
			self.civil_talk_to_garam_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_talk_to_garam, self, true))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'civil_talk_with_garam_2' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over
		 and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over and not self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 then
			self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_talk_to_garam_2, self, true))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'garam_talk_with_girl' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and not self.garam_talk_with_girl_over then
			self.garam_talk_with_girl_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_talk_with_kid_girl_all_night, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'civil_turn_to_evil_zone' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over
		and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 then
			self.has_civil_turn_to_evil = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_turn_to_evil, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_2' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over
		and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 then
			self.has_seen_girl_die = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_see_girl_die, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'civil_see_garam_zone' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over
		and self.interact_to_desk_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_see_garam, self, true))

		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_20')) then
			if self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 == false and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over and self.civil_talk_to_garam_over then
				self.civil_talk_to_garam_over_2 = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_talk_to_garam_2, self, false))
				return true
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('civil_0')) then
			if self.civil_talk_to_garam_over == false and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over and self.interact_to_house_over then
				self.civil_talk_to_garam_over = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_talk_to_garam, self, false))
				return true

			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('girl_house_desk')) then
			if self.interact_to_desk_over == false and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_to_desk, self))
				return true
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('girl_house')) then
			if self.garam_talk_with_girl_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_to_girl_house, self))
				return true
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('girl_flower')) then
			if self.has_to_interact_to_flower == true then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_kill_all_civil, self))
				return true
			end

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_3' and self.battle_3_over == false then
			self.battle_3_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_kill_evil_civil, self))

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' or e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_5' or e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_6' then
			self:garam_kill_civil(e.BattleGroupName)

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' and not self.has_seen_girl_die and self.has_civil_turn_to_evil then
			self.has_seen_girl_die = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_see_girl_die, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('battle_4')

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_5' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('battle_5')

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_6' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('battle_6')
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'civil_see_garam_zone'
		and not self.has_seen_girl_die and not self.has_civil_turn_to_evil and self.garam_talk_with_girl_over
		and self.interact_to_desk_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_see_garam, self, false))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

end

function local_class:garam_talk_with_kid_girl_all_night()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	local garam_kid_girl = get_character('garam_kid_girl')
	local garam = get_character('garam')

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('garam_kid_girl')

	character_util.stop(garam_kid_girl)

	camera_util.move(vector(-6, 0, 79), 1, {ignorecameragrids = false, end_target = garam})

	character_util.move_to(garam_kid_girl, vector(-7, 0, 79), 0.99, 4, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(garam, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(garam_kid_girl, 'right')

	--신선님 오빠, 피곤하진 않아?
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	character_util.normal_jump(garam_kid_girl)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0', skip = true })

	--마을 사람들이 욕심을 덜 내면 좋겠는데...
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_0', skip = true })

	--매일 신선님 오빠한테 이거 해달라 저거 해달라 부탁하기만 해...
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_1', skip = true })

	--선택지
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	--많이 피곤하다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('fox_main_s22_0_0_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	--전혀 피곤하지 않다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('fox_main_s22_0_0_3'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = garam_kid_girl

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		character_util.set_anim(garam, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.0)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(garam)

		-- 맨날 괜찮다고만 하더니 그럴 줄 알았어!
		character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_5', skip = true })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(garam, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.0)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(garam)

		--아니야! 오늘 신선님 오빠 고생 많이해서 피곤해!!
		character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_4', skip = true })
	end

	--오늘은 푹 쉬고 있어!
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_6', skip = true })

	--내가 저녁밥 할게!!
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_7', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	-- 조금만 기다리고 있어!!
	character_util.set_anim(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam_kid_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam_kid_girl, { key = 'fox_main_s22_0_0_8', skip = true })

	--소녀 집 안으로 퇴장.
	character_util.move_to_async(garam_kid_girl, vector(garam_kid_girl.Position.x, 0, 80), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(garam_kid_girl, vector(-5, 0, 80), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(garam, 'right')
	character_util.move_to_async(garam_kid_girl, vector(-4.15, 0, 80), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(garam_kid_girl, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(garam_kid_girl, vector(-4.15, 0, 80.5), 0.5, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_position(garam_kid_girl, vector(999, 0, 999))

	stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(garam_kid_girl, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	--가람에게 카메라 넘어온다.
	camera_util.move_async(garam.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = false, end_target = garam})

		end

	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = civil_0

	while wait_for_branch do

--가람의 기운에 랜덤 마을 주민들이 놀라는 함수
function local_class:random_civil_surprise(number, issurprise)

	local cnt = 0
	for i = 4, 15 do
		if cnt >= number then

			break
		end

		if self.civil_already_surprise[i-3] == false then
			local randomint = unity_class.random.Range(-0.1, 0.1)

			cnt = cnt + 1
			local civil = get_character('civil_'..i)
			character_util.set_anim(civil, { name = 'idle', loop = true })

			character_util.shake(civil, 0.02, 9999)

			if randomint > 0 then
				character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'surprise', loop = true })
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'scared', loop = true })
			end
			character_util.normal_jump(civil)

			self.civil_already_surprise[i-3] = true
		end

	end

end

--가람이 소녀의 무덤과 얘기하는 씬
function local_class:garam_kill_all_civil()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	self.garam_kill_all_civil_over = true

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('flower')

	local garam = get_character('garam')
	local nari = get_character('nari')

	local invisible_interact = get_field_object('girl_flower')

	character_util.stop_shake(garam)
	self.garam_mad_fx_2:Dispose()

	local time = 0

	while self.garam_mad_fx_2.transform.localScale.x > 0 do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.garam_mad_fx_2.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vector(1, 1, 1), vector(0, 0, 0), time)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'tired', loop = true })

	if garam.Position.x < invisible_interact.Position.x then
		character_util.move_to_async(garam, invisible_interact.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, 4, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(garam, 'right')
		character_util.move_to(garam, garam.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1.5, 4, true, true)
	else
		character_util.move_to_async(garam, invisible_interact.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, 4, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(garam, 'left')
		character_util.move_to(garam, garam.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1.5, 4, true, true)
	end

	--fade out / fade In
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_flashback', state = 'event', mix = 2})
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	lua_helper.call_interface(self.flower_item, 'System.IDisposable', 'Dispose')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battlegate_3', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battlegate_4', false))

	--틴트 빼기
	field:RemoveTint(nil, 0)
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, self.remember_color, 0)

	garam.SpineController:AddColor(garam.Name, self.remember_color, 1, 0)

	--가람 위치 세팅
	character_util.set_position(garam, vector(0.5, 0, 7))

	character_util.set_direction(garam, 'up')

	--혹시 모를 플레이어 원래 파티들 세팅 + 원복
	party_manager:RestorePlayerParty()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	character_util.set_position(nari, vector(999, 0, 999))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(garam.Position, 0, {use_unscaledtime = false, ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = garam})

	character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'sleep_deep', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam, { key = 'fox_main_s22_24', skip = true })

		{itemid = self.flower_id, notforinven = true, pos = garam.Position, target = vector(0.5, 0, 9.5),
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})

	local customSprite = flower_item_last.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	customSprite.TintColor = self.remember_color
	customSprite:Rebuild()

	--이 꽃들이 그대를 덮어주기를…

	character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'idle', loop = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'sleep_deep', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam, { key = 'fox_main_s22_26', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(garam, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(garam, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam, { key = 'fox_main_s22_27', skip = true })

	--회상에서 빠져 나오기
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fade_out_01'})

function local_class:character_add_color_lerp(character, start_color, end_color, duration)
	local time = 0
	while true do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		character.SpineController:AddColor(character.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, time / duration), 1, 0)
		if time >= duration then

			break

		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:move_fx(fx_cast_name, fx_end_name, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration
	local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_cast_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_end_name):Instantiate(target_pos)
	fx:Dispose()
end

return local_class

end

-- 배틀 게이트 온오프 함수: 매뉴얼 타입이 트루이면 클로즈, 거짓이면 오픈
function local_class:gate_manual_controll(manual_type,battle_num, length)
	if manual_type then
		for i=1, length do
			local temp_name = 'battle_'.. battle_num ..'_gate_'.. i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end

	elseif not manual_type then
		for i=1, length do
			local temp_name = 'battle_'.. battle_num ..'_gate_'.. i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end
	end
	return
end

function local_class:move_fx(fx_cast_name, fx_end_name, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration
	local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_cast_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_end_name):Instantiate(target_pos)
	fx:Dispose()
end

	local nari = get_character('nari')

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

		if e.Zone.Name == 'fox_up_entrance_zone' then
			self:change_marker('fox_up_entrance_zone', true)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'fox_up_zone' then
			self:change_marker('fox_up_zone', true)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'fox_down_entrance_zone' then
			self:change_marker('fox_down_entrance_zone', true)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_4' then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bossbattle_intro, self))
			end
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bossbattle_ending, self))

		end
	end

	return false
end


function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local flower = get_field_object('kid_flower')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, flower) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.flower_garden then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.farewell_kid, self))
	end

end


--마커 관리
function local_class:change_marker(fo_name, is_zone_enter)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.none then
		return
	end

	local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
	local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
	local garam = get_character('garam')

	if is_zone_enter then
		if fo_name == 'fox_up_entrance_zone' and self.present_quest_marker_key ~= 'fox_entrance' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.present_quest_marker_key)
			self.present_quest_marker_key = 'fox_entrance'
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('fox_entrance', quest_id, is_story, vector(26.5, 0.5, 18))

		elseif fo_name == 'fox_up_zone' and self.present_quest_marker_key ~= 'fox_up' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.present_quest_marker_key)
			self.present_quest_marker_key = 'fox_up'
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('fox_up', quest_id, is_story, vector(48.5, 0.5, 64.5))

		elseif fo_name == 'fox_down_entrance_zone' and self.present_quest_marker_key ~= 'garam_boss' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.present_quest_marker_key)
			self.present_quest_marker_key = 'garam_boss'
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('garam_boss', quest_id, is_story, garam)

		end

	else
		self.present_quest_marker_key = 'fox_entrance'
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('fox_entrance', quest_id, is_story, vector(26.5, 0.5, 18))

	end

end

end

function local_class:move_and_resize_fx(fx, start_pos, target_pos, start_scale, target_scale, final_duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, target_scale, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 위슾의 랜덤 루트 생성
function local_class:rand_root_gen(type, root)
	local center_pos = vector(68.5, 0.8, 30.5)	-- 루트의 시작점, 제단 중앙 위치
	local inner_bound_x = 8.5					-- 방 내부 x 길이의 절반
	local inner_bound_z = 5.5					-- 방 내부 z 길이의 절반
	local out_bound_x = 7						-- 방 외부로 x 좌표 어디까지 갈 것인지
	local out_bound_z = 5						-- 방 외부로 z 좌표 어디까지 갈 것인지

	local direction = { lt = 1, ct = 2, rt = 3, l= 4, r = 5, lb = 6, cb = 7, rb = 8}	-- 방향 정의
	local rand_direction = random_util.get_random_int(1, 8)								-- 랜덤 방향 지정

	local inner_rand_x = 0
	local inner_rand_z = 0
	local out_rand_x = 0
	local out_rand_z = 0

	local rand_root_result = { }				-- 리턴할 값

	local inner_x = {0, 0}	-- [1] min / [2] max 값 지정. 정수 값이 들어갈 수 있도록 해야함.
	local inner_z = {0, 0}
	local out_x = {0, 0}
	local out_z = {0, 0}

	if type then
		rand_direction = root
	end

	if rand_direction == direction.lt then		-- 좌상향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x - inner_bound_x
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x - 0.5
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z + 0.5
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z + inner_bound_z

		out_x[1] = inner_x[1] - 5 - out_bound_x
		out_x[2] = inner_x[1] - 5
		out_z[1] = inner_z[2] + 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[2] + 5 + out_bound_z

	elseif rand_direction == direction.ct then	-- 상향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x - 2.5
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x + 2.5
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z + 0.5
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z + inner_bound_z

		out_x[1] = inner_x[1] - 2
		out_x[2] = inner_x[1] + 2
		out_z[1] = inner_z[2] + 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[2] + 5 + out_bound_z

	elseif rand_direction == direction.rt then	-- 우상향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x + 0.5
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x + inner_bound_x
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z + 0.5
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z + inner_bound_z

		out_x[1] = inner_x[2] + 5
		out_x[2] = inner_x[2] + 5 + out_bound_x
		out_z[1] = inner_z[2] + 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[2] + 5 + out_bound_z

	elseif rand_direction == direction.l then	-- 좌향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x - inner_bound_x
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x - 0.5
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z - 2.5
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z + 2.5

		out_x[1] = inner_x[1] - 7 - out_bound_x
		out_x[2] = inner_x[1] - 7
		out_z[1] = inner_z[2] - 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[2] + 5

	elseif rand_direction == direction.r then	-- 우향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x + 0.5
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x + inner_bound_x
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z - 2.5
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z + 2.5

		out_x[1] = inner_x[2] + 5
		out_x[2] = inner_x[2] + 5 + out_bound_x
		out_z[1] = inner_z[2] - 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[2] + 5

	elseif rand_direction == direction.lb then	-- 좌하향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x - inner_bound_x
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x - 0.5
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z - inner_bound_z
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z - 0.5

		out_x[1] = inner_x[1] - 5 - out_bound_x
		out_x[2] = inner_x[1] - 5
		out_z[1] = inner_z[1] - 5 - out_bound_z
		out_z[2] = inner_z[1] - 5

	elseif rand_direction == direction.cb then	-- 하향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x - 2.5
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x + 2.5
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z - 6.5 - inner_bound_z
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z - 3.5 -- inner_bound_z

		out_x[1] = inner_x[1] - 15
		out_x[2] = inner_x[1] + 15
		out_z[1] = inner_z[1] - 5
		out_z[2] = inner_z[1] - 5 - out_bound_z

	elseif rand_direction == direction.rb then	-- 우하향
		inner_x[1] = center_pos.x + 0.5
		inner_x[2] = center_pos.x + inner_bound_x
		inner_z[1] = center_pos.z - inner_bound_z
		inner_z[2] = center_pos.z - 0.5

		out_x[1] = inner_x[2] + 5
		out_x[2] = inner_x[2] + 5 + out_bound_x
		out_z[1] = inner_z[1] - 5 - out_bound_z
		out_z[2] = inner_z[1] - 5

	end

	inner_rand_x = random_util.get_random_int(inner_x[1], inner_x[2])
	inner_rand_z = random_util.get_random_int(inner_z[1], inner_z[2])

	out_rand_x = random_util.get_random_int(out_x[1], out_x[2])
	out_rand_z = random_util.get_random_int(out_z[1], out_z[2])

	rand_root_result[1] = center_pos
	rand_root_result[2] = vector(inner_rand_x, 0, inner_rand_z)
	rand_root_result[3] = vector(out_rand_x, 0, out_rand_z)

	return rand_root_result

end

-- 깜빡이는 틴트, 카메라 쉐이크
function local_class:tint_loop()
	local duration = 2
	local time = 0

	while self.tint_loop_stat do
		if self.boss_in == true then
			camera_util.shake(0.02, duration)
		end
		field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({1.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), duration)
		while time < 2.5 do
			time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if self.tint_loop_stat == false then

				break

			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if self.tint_loop_stat == false then

			break

		end

		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, duration)
		while time < 2.5 do
			time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if self.tint_loop_stat == false then

				break

			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if self.tint_loop_stat == false then

			break

		end
	end
end

-- 움직이는 이펙트
function local_class:move_fx(fx_cast_name, fx_end_name, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration
	local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_cast_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end
		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

	end
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_end_name):Instantiate(target_pos)
	fx:Dispose()
end

	-- 아이템위치에 터지는 이팩트
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Proj_Explosion_Dark'):Instantiate(garam_portal_pos)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(self.move_and_resize_fx, self, self.garam_magic_fx_1, garam_portal_pos, garam_portal_pos, fx_scale[5], fx_scale[1], 1))

	character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'throw', loop = false})

	camera_util.move(camera_center, 0.3)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration)

		-- 아이템 포물선운동
		local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
		self.orb_item:SetPosition(temp_pos, true)

		-- 아이템 회전
		self.orb_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 360 * 3 * progress))
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:event_set_fox_orb_fx(true, 0.3, 0.35)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_summon_effect_01'})

	local broken_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_transform_end'):Instantiate(garam_portal_pos)

	orb_sprite.TintColor = 	unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0})

	self.wisp_gen_stat = false

	time_util.mod('attack', 0.3)

	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0.3)

	local knock_back_info_nari = character_util.knockback_info(
		'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 20000, 0.05,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
	local knock_back_info_garam = character_util.knockback_info(

	nari.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	local ckms2 = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(garam, knock_back_info_garam)

function local_class:fall_down_girl(girl, start_pos, target_pos, final_duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)

		character_util.set_position(girl, pos, true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

	self.garam_kid = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		-- 스테이지 시작 시 처리.
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_start_event, self))
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's3_ending' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.well then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s3_ending, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's3_follow_2' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.cnt == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.man_follow, self, self.s3_npc2))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's3_follow_3' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.cnt == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.man_follow, self, self.s3_npc3))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's3_follow_4' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.cnt == 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.man_follow, self, self.s3_npc4))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 's3_ending' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.well then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s3_ending, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's5_vil' then
			self.tree_in = false

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("s4_begin")
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO("s4_begin", 27, true, old)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's5_tree' then
			self.tree_in = true

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("s4_begin")
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('s4_begin', 27, true, vector(-104.5, 0, -41))

	end

	return false

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s4_meet_oldman, self))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.old_man) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.deny then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s4_meet_oldman_again, self))

	return false

local local_class = newclass('FoxMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxMain @
		Comment = 제사를 지내다 나리를 만나고 마을을 구하러 과거로 감. @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'fox_1_1'

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		tree = 1,
		cut = 2,
		fire_off = 3,
		fire_on = 4,
		nari_act = 5,
		to_past = 6
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.opening_tint_key = 'opening_tint'
	self.opening_tint_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1)

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.get_brazier = function(num) return get_field_object('s5_brazier_' .. num) end

	self.well_effect = nil

	self.sec_end = true

	self.pray_end_1 = false

	self.pray_end_2 = false

	self.is_vil = true
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fox_portal_nari_portal_action')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char_black')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	local tree = get_field_object('first_tree')
	local nari = get_character('nari')
	local old = get_character('old_man')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(nari, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(nari, 'disabled')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(old)

	self.flower_item_mind_1 = drop_item_util.create_item(

			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 1, target = vector(-105, 0, -32), skip_text = true})

	self.flower_item_mind_2 = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{itemid = 20180, notforinven = true, pos = vector(-104.5, 0, -33),

function local_class:exit()

	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.resholder = nil

	self.sec_end = false

	self.is_vil = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local nari = get_character('nari')
	local old = get_character('old_man')

	local tree = get_field_object('first_tree')

	local brazier_1 = self.get_brazier(1)
	local brazier_2 = self.get_brazier(2)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, nari) then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.nari_act then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.to_past
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.to_past, self))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.to_past then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.to_past_2, self))
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, old) then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cut then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fire_off
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready_for_nari_2, self))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fire_on then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.nari_act
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_nari, self))
			end
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, tree) then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.tree
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tree, self))
			else
				local marker = field:GetMarker('up_point_a')
				CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's5_meet' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.tree then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.cut
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready_for_nari_1, self))
			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's5_vil' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nari')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nari', 27, true, vector(-35.5, 2, 2.5))
			self.is_vil = true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's5_tree_above' then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fire_off then
				if self.is_vil ~= true then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('fire_1')
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('fire_2')
				else
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nari')
				end
			else
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nari')
			end
			self.is_vil = false
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nari', 27, true, vector(-104.5, 0, -76))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's5_tree' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nari')

			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none or self.current_progress == self.event_progress.tree then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nari', 27, true, vector(-104.5, 0, -31))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cut then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nari', 27, true, vector(-104.5, 0, -29))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fire_off then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('fire_1', 27, true, brazier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('fire_2', 27, true, brazier_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fire_on then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nari', 27, true, old)
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.nari_act or self.current_progress == self.event_progress.to_past then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nari', 27, true, nari)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, brazier_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, brazier_2) then
				if brazier_1.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fire_off then
					self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fire_on

					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('fire_1')
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('fire_2')
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nari', 27, true, old)

					if old.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
						old.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
					end
					return true
			  	end
		   	end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local chk = false
		for i = 1, 15 do
			if get_field_object('grass_'..i).ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				chk = true
			end
			if chk == true then
				break
			end
		end
		if chk == false then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nari')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nari', 27, true, old)

			self.pray_end_2 = true

			if self.pray_end_1 == true and self.pray_end_2 == true then
				if old.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
					old.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
				end
			end
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

	self.get_rat_hole_out = function(num) return get_field_object('rat_hole_out_' .. num) end

	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end
	self.get_fx_heal = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a') end
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small') end
	self.get_fx_time_travel = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_clock') end
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fx_lasthit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end

	-- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'fox_main'

	-- 쥐구멍의 ExitInteractable 백업

	self.outside_mother_favor_start_over = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_rat_hole_out(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.get_rat_hole_out(4).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local civil_out = self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(i)
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(civil_out) then
			civil_out.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		local cat_1 = get_character('cat_1')
		cat_1.Position = vector(-4, 0, 60)
		cat_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end

	self.get_civil_out_mom().Position = vector(4, 0, -14)
	self.get_civil_out_kid().Position = vector(5, 0, -14)

	local portal_effect_pool = self.get_portal_effect()
	self.get_fx_heal()
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke()
	self.get_fx_time_travel()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()

	-- 포탈 이펙트 풀이 로드 될 때까지 기다린다.
	while not object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(portal_effect_pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.portal_out_to_watch_well, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local civil_out = self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(i)
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(civil_out) then
			civil_out.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local rat_hole_out_1 = self.get_rat_hole_out(1)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, rat_hole_out_1) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_rat_hole, self)
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, {
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(1),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(2),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(3),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(4),
	}) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_guard, self)
	end

	return false
end

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(nari, user_party, true)

function local_class:start_rat_routine()
	self.is_rat_shuttle = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rat_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_rat_routine()
	self.is_rat_shuttle = false
end

function local_class:rat_routine()
	local rat = self.get_rat()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(rat, 0, 0)
	rat:SetGiantFactor('rat', 0.5)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(rat, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	local sfx_pos = field:GetMarker('rat_hole_outside_1').position

	coroutine.yield()

	while self.is_rat_shuttle do
		rat.Position = vector(-7, 0, 5.7)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(rat, 1, 0.2)
		--쥐가 쥐구멍으로 들어가는 것이 보인다.
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(rat, vector(-7, 0, 9.2), 4, true)
		-- 쥐가 구멍 안으로 사라지는 연출
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(rat, 0, 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_mouse_01', position = sfx_pos, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(rat, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:interact_to_rat_hole()

	self:stop_rat_routine()

	-- 나리와 리더를 제외한 모든 파티원을 빼서 따로 저장한다.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 2 do
		local party = user_party[1]

		character_util.convert_to_npc(party)
		table.insert(prev_party_list, party)
	end

	-- 쥐구멍 앞에 일제 정렬
	--local align_coroutine_list = {}
	character_util.move_waypoint(user_party_leader, rat_hole_out_1.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(nari, rat_hole_out_1.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	-- 기존 파티원을 유저와 나리의 오른쪽에 가지런히 정렬시킴
	for i = 1, #prev_party_list do
		local position = rat_hole_out_1.Position + vector(2, 0, -2 + ((i - 1) * -0.5) + (i - 1))
		local party = prev_party_list[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(party, position, 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_15_6', skip = true })

	--나리: 음? 이게 뭐야? 쥐?
	--선택지 : 저 구멍으로 들어갈 수 있었으면... / 난 항상 쥐구멍 안 쪽이 궁금했어.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'fox_main_s6_talk_branch_2_0', 'normal'},
		{'fox_main_s6_talk_branch_2_1', 'intellect'},
	})

	--나리 : ...그거 좋은 생각인데.
	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.normal_jump(nari, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_15_7', skip = true })

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	--기대하라고. 잊지 못할 경험을 하게 해줄테니까!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, nari)
	character_util.look_at(nari, user_party_leader)
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_17', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(nari)

	self.controller:nari_magic(nil, nil, false, 0, 0)

	yield_return_func(self.change_rat_party, self, prev_party_list)

	-- 자! 얼른 가 보자고!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_die_mouse_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse_nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_21', skip = true })

	-- 4번 쥐구멍의 PublishInteractable를 원래대로 돌려놓는다.
	self.get_rat_hole_out(4).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

end

-- 나리가 플레이어와 자신을 쥐로 변신시킴
function local_class:change_rat_party(prev_party_list)
	local mouse_knight = self.get_mouse_knight()
	local mouse_nari = self.get_mouse_nari()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.3)

	-- 이벤트 날려줘서 변신시킴.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nari, { 'change_rat_party' }))

	local flag = false
	local handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'change_end'  then
				flag = true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 변신 풀릴때까지 대기
	message_system:Subscribe(handler, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'callback')
	while not flag do coroutine.yield() end
	message_system:Unsubscribe(handler, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	character_util.stop(mouse_nari)

	-- 리더를 제외한 파티원이 존재하는 경우
	if #prev_party_list > 0 then
		for i = 1, #prev_party_list do
			local party = prev_party_list[i]
			character_util.set_emotion(party, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		for _, v in pairs(prev_party_list) do
			character_util.remove_anim(v)
		end

		-- 왜? 너희도 변신시켜줄까?
		character_util.normal_jump(mouse_nari, true)
		character_util.set_direction(mouse_nari, 'right')
		if #prev_party_list > 1 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse_nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_19', skip = true })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse_nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_19_1', skip = true })
		end

		for k, v in pairs(prev_party_list) do
			character_util.remove_emotion(v)
			character_util.set_direction(v, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'sing'})
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 에잉, 싱겁기는…
		character_util.look_at(mouse_nari, mouse_knight)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse_nari, { key = 'fox_main_s6_20', skip = true })

		for _, v in pairs(prev_party_list) do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(v)
			character_util.set_direction(v, 'left')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter()

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local well = self.get_well(2)
	local good_kid = self.get_good_kid()
	local civil_out_mom = self.get_civil_out_mom()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, well) and self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_well, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, good_kid) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_good_kid, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, civil_out_mom) and self.current_progress >= self.progress.get_well_water then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_water_to_outside_mother, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.rat_hole_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
				-- 아무것도 안하고 쥐구멍 안에 들어가면
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_in(3))

				local selected_party = CS.Oak.User.Me.Party

				for i = 1, selected_party.Count - 1 do
					local member_name = CS.Oak.PartyUtil.GeneratePartyName(selected_party, selected_party[i])
					local origin_member = get_character(member_name)
					origin_member.Position = vector(-5 + i, 0, 9)
					character_util.set_direction(origin_member, 'left')
					character_util.set_anim(origin_member, { name = 'seat'})
				end
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.get_well_water then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_in(1))
				return true

			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.run_from_cat then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_in(1))
				return true
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village' then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_well(2))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.get_well_water then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_out(2))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.run_from_cat then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_out(2))
				return true
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village_entry' then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_out(1))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.run_from_cat then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_civil_out_mom())
				return true
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'above_tree' then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_tree_hole(1))
			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'cat_chasing_start' and self.current_progress == self.progress.get_well_water
				and not self.is_chasing then
			self.is_chasing = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cat_chasing_start, self)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'cat_chasing_end' and self.current_progress == self.progress.get_well_water
				and self.is_chasing then
			self.is_chasing = false
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cat_chasing_over, self)

		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:item_scale_down(drop_item, target, duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_scale = drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale.x

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local start_size = (target - start_scale) * (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration + start_scale

		drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_size
		drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_size

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if target == 0 then
		drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

function local_class:show_heal(fo)
	self.get_fx_heal():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)
	fo.SpineController:AddColor(fo.Name, unity_class.color.green, 1, 0)
	fo.SpineController:RemoveColor(fo.Name, 0.3)
end

return local_class

	self.quest_marker_name = 'fox_main'

	self.detect_event_name = 'fox_guard'
