end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 감옥에 갇힐 때, 주변에 꼬마가 없어야 해서 먼 곳으로 치워버림
	local good_kid = self.get_good_kid()
	good_kid.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_emotion(good_kid)
	character_util.remove_anim(good_kid)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(3.5, 0, 10))

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke()

	-- 스테이지에 재 진입한 경우, 나리를 플레이어 파티에 바로 합류시킴.
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		local nari = self.get_nari()
		party_util.add_member(nari)

		local cat_1 = get_character('cat_1')
		cat_1.Position = vector(-4, 0, 60)
		cat_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(i)
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(guard) then
			guard.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(i)
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(guard) then
			guard.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, {
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(1),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(2),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(3),
		self.get_civil_in_gate_guard(4),
	}) and not self.is_talked_with_guard then
		self.is_talked_with_guard = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_guard, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if not self.is_talked_with_guard then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'rat_hole_zone' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_in(1))
				return true

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_out(2))
				return true

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village_entry' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(3.5, 0, 10))
				return true

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'above_tree' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_tree_hole(1))
				return true
			end
		else
			if e.Zone.Name == 'beaten_zone' then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.beaten_by_guard, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:toggle_follow_user(fo, active, index)
	if active then
		fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(fo, user_party, index, 0, false)
		fo:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	else
		character_util.stop(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

		local nari = self.get_nari()
		party_util.add_member(nari)

		field:Tint('fox_night', CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.25, 0.3, 0.7, 1), 0)

		self:enable_observation()

		self.get_civil_in_guard(14).Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	else
		self.get_civil_sick(1).Position = vector(7, 0, 3.3)
		self.get_civil_sick(2).Position = vector(4, 0, 2)
		self.get_civil_sick(3).Position = vector(6.5, 0, 4.5)
		self.get_civil_sick(4).Position = vector(2, 0, 3.3)
		self.get_civil_sick(5).Position = vector(5.5, 0, 2.5)
		self.get_civil_sick(6).Position = vector(2.5, 0, 2.5)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_tree(1))
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_good_kid(), 'disabled')

	self.get_fx_field_fire()
	self.get_fx_heal()
	self.get_fx_time_travel()

function local_class:start()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 8 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'fox_stage_night' }))
end

function local_class:opening_routine()
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_pressing'})

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(vector(2, 0, 54),
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.monster_jump_delay = nil

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		return self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		return self:on_throw_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_3' and not self.last_fight_over then
		-- 유저가 무언가를 들고 있고, 들고 있는게 화약 이라면
		if self:is_holding_bomb() then
			self.last_fight_over = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_fight, self)
			return true
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nari_hurry, self))
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == 'gaeddong_speech' then
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.gaeddong_speech, self)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gaeddong_speech, self))

		return true

	elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village' then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < -46 then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(-16.5, 0, 42.5))
			return true
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_tree(1))
			return true
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == 'rat_hole_zone' then
		if self.is_guards_gone then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(-45.5, 0, 111))
			return true
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_in(3))
			return true
		end

	elseif e.Zone.Name == 'village_entry' then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rat_hole_out(1))

		return true

	elseif e.Zone.Name == 'above_tree' then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_tree_hole(2))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end
	if e.Zone.Name == 'rat_hole_zone' then
		if self.is_guards_gone then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, get_character('post_old'))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_name .. 3 and self.battle_3_over == false then
		self.battle_3_over = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.well_bomb, self)

		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_name .. self.current_wave then
		self.current_wave = self.current_wave + 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spawn_civil, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Target.Name == '[GIMMICK]gunpowderpot' then
			if not self.sneak_into_warehouse_over then
				self.sneak_into_warehouse_over = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.sneak_into_warehouse, self))
			end

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_well(2))
			return true
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if e.Target.Name == '[GIMMICK]gunpowderpot' and not self.is_guards_gone then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(-16.5, 0, 42.5))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'change_start' then
		self.is_transforming = true
		return true

	elseif e.Params[0] == 'change_end' then
		self.is_transforming = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_holding_bomb()
	local current_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target.Name == '[GIMMICK]gunpowderpot' then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--창고에 잠입해서 화약통과 인터랙트하면 이벤트 진행
function local_class:sneak_into_warehouse()
	local nari = self.get_nari()

	--이 정도 화약들이면 우물을 날려버리기엔 충분할 거야!
	character_util.normal_jump(nari, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_main_s9_0' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(nari)
end

function local_class:nari_hurry()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	while self.is_transforming do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local is_rat = lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, get_character('mouse_knight'))

	local nari = is_rat and get_character('mouse_nari') or self.get_nari()
	local pos_dif = vector(is_rat and -0.3 or -0.55, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_emotion(nari, {name = 'attack'})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(nari,
			{ waypoints = user_party.Leader.Position + pos_dif, speed = 3})

	character_util.set_direction(nari, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'walk'})
	character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'push', upper = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, false, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(nari, nari.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, false, false, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(nari, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(nari)

	character_util.look_at(nari, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, nari)
	character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'release'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, { key = 'fox_main_s9_0_0', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	if is_rat then
		local manual_touch_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
		-- 'attack', 'super', 'assassination', 'party_support_battle_action', 'throw', 'hold', 'interact'
		local controls_to_disable = CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack
			| CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination
			| CS.Oak.DisabledControls.PartySupportBattleAction | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw
			| CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact

		while manual_touch_state == nil or not lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) do
			manual_touch_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(user_party.Leader, controls_to_disable)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	character_util.set_direction(civil_in_guard_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(civil_in_guard_1, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_jump(civil_in_guard_1, true)
	character_util.set_anim(civil_in_guard_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civil_in_guard_1, { key = 'fox_main_s9_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civil_in_guard_1, { key = 'fox_main_s9_7', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.remove_anim(civil_in_guard_1)
	character_util.set_direction(civil_in_guard_1, 'left')

	self.current_wave = 1
	self:spawn_civil(function()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.look_at(nari, good_kid)
		character_util.set_emotion(nari, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_anim(nari, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nari, {key = 'fox_main_s9_8', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(nari)

		character_util.nod_twice(good_kid)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		character_util.set_anim(good_kid, { name = 'eat' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(nari)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_1', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_2', true))

		for i = 1, 6 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('last_battlegate_' .. i))
		end

	end)

	character_util.remove_anim(civil_in_guard_1)

	-- 전투 시작.
	character_util.convert_to_monster(civil_in_guard_1, self.battle_name .. self.current_wave, 'BATTLE_3')
	character_util.set_death_type(civil_in_guard_1, 'etherealprostrate')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(civil_in_guard_1, user_party_leader, 'battle')

	local rat_hole = self.get_rat_hole_out(2)
	self.cached_hole_interactable = rat_hole.Interactable
	rat_hole.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'combat'})
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
end

function local_class:spawn_civil(func_before_convert)
	local wait_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.monster_count_list[self.current_wave] do
		local civil = get_character('civil_in_wave_' .. self.current_wave .. '_' .. i)
		character_util.set_position(civil, self.monster_wp_list[i][1])
		civil.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, civil,
				{ waypoints = self.monster_wp_list[i],
				  speed = self.monster_appear_speed, play_sfx = (self.current_wave == 1) }))

		-- 제일 처음엔 배틀게이트들 열려있음
		if self.current_wave ~= 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				wait_for_sec(self.monster_jump_delay[i])
				character_util.jump(civil, 1.5, self.monster_jump_dur[i])
			end))
		end
	end

	if self.current_wave == 3 then
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
			name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_pressing', state = 'field'
		})
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true
	end

	wait_all(wait_list)

	if func_before_convert ~= nil then
		func_before_convert()
	end

	for i = 1, self.monster_count_list[self.current_wave] do
		local civil = get_character('civil_in_wave_' .. self.current_wave .. '_' .. i)
		civil.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.convert_to_monster(civil, self.battle_name .. self.current_wave, 'BATTLE_3')

		if self.current_wave == 3 then
			character_util.set_death_type(civil, 'etherealprostrate')
		end

		civil.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(civil, user_party_leader, 'battle')
	end
end

end

function local_class:bomb_blinking(fo, duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local mesh_renderer = fo.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_count_fast_01')
	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local x = unity_class.time.time - start_time
		local y = math.abs(math.sin(2 * x * (1 + x)))

		mesh_renderer.material.color = unity_color({1, y, y, 1})

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:enable_observation()
	for i = 3, 14 do
		self.get_civil_in_guard(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				self.get_civil_in_guard(i), nil, 2, 'fox_guard', 4, 60)
	end
end

function local_class:disable_observation()
	for i = 3, 14 do
		self.get_civil_in_guard(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	end
end

function local_class:show_heal(fo)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_magic_heal_01')
	self.get_fx_heal():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)
	fo.SpineController:AddColor(fo.Name, unity_class.color.green, 1, 0)
	fo.SpineController:RemoveColor(fo.Name, 0.3)
end

function local_class:rain(center_pos)
	self.screen_effect = self.get_fx_rain_screen():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.screen_effect.transform:SetParent(stage_camera.Transform.parent)
	self.screen_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.rain_effects = {
		self.get_fx_rain_ripple_ground():Instantiate(center_pos + vector(-10, 0, -10)),
		self.get_fx_rain_ripple_ground():Instantiate(center_pos + vector(-10, 0, 10)),
		self.get_fx_rain_ripple_ground():Instantiate(center_pos + vector(10, 0, -10)),
		self.get_fx_rain_ripple_ground():Instantiate(center_pos + vector(10, 0, 10)),
	}
end

function local_class:stop_rain()
	if self.screen_effect ~= nil then
		self.screen_effect:Dispose()
		self.screen_effect = nil
	end

	if self.rain_effects ~= nil then
		for _, v in pairs(self.rain_effects) do
			v:Dispose()
		end
		self.rain_effects = nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.reset_lala_position = controller.reset_lala_position
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	character_util.set_position(oni_girl, self.reset_lala_position)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)

function local_class:request_talk()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)

	local fairy = get_character('fairy_basic3')
	if fairy ~= nil and vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, fairy.Position) < 4 then
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.move_to(fairy, oni_girl.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, nil, true, true)
	end
	character_util.align_party(oni_girl, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	if fairy ~= nil and vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, fairy.Position) < 4 then
		character_util.set_direction(fairy,'right')
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(fairy, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	-- 안녕, 모험가!
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_2', skip = true})

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 응? 라이트닝 카운터 라나? 잘못 들었나 본데, 난...
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_3', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "victory_get", loop = false })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.15)
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.15)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 라이트닝 라이더 라라 야!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_4', skip = true})

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.15)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 신비한 나무 위까지 올라온 걸 보면, 내 적수가 되겠는걸?
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_5', skip = true })

	-- 그런 의미에서 나랑 달리기 시합하지 않을래?
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_6', skip = true })

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if is_accepted then
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)

		--floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_7', skip = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return false end
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_oni_girl()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.request_talk, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

		Comment = 라라의 내기 수락 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_oni_girl = controller.get_oni_girl
	self.race_finished = false
	self.player_race_won = false

	self.door_name = "onigirl_door"
	self.quest_marker_name = "oni_girl_racing"

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil
	self.race_coroutine = nil
	self.interact_coroutine = nil
	self.lana_run_coroutine = nil

	self.reset_lala_position = controller.reset_lala_position

	self.user_start_position = vector(-150, 0, -24.5)
	self.lala_start_position = vector(-150, 0, -27.5)

	self.race_start_position = vector(-150,0,-31)
	self.race_end_lb_position = vector(-99,0,-30)
	self.race_end_rt_position = vector(-92,0,-24)

	self.race_state = { ready = 1, racing = 2, won = 3, lose = 4, finished = 5 }
	self.current_race_state = self.race_state.ready
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return true end
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		self.race_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		self:setting_oni_girl()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.reset_lala_position = nil
	self.user_start_position = nil
	self.lala_start_position = nil

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil
	self.race_coroutine = nil
	self.interact_coroutine = nil
	self.lana_run_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:re_challenge()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(oni_girl)
	if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	local fairy = get_character('fairy_basic3')
	if fairy ~= nil and vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, fairy.Position) < 4 then
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.move_to(fairy, oni_girl.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, nil, true, true)
	end
	character_util.align_party(oni_girl, 'left', nil, 'arc')
	if fairy ~= nil and vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, fairy.Position) < 4 then
		character_util.set_direction('right')
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(fairy, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	local waited = true
	local accepted = false

	CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
		waited = false
		accepted = accepted_in
	end)

	while waited do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if accepted then
		self.race_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self))
	else
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(oni_girl)
		if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		self.interact_coroutine = nil
	end
end

-- 레이스 시작
function local_class:start_race()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	-- 그럼 시작하자!
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, {name = "smile", loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "shoot", loop = true})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_8', skip = true})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)
	-- 라나 출발 준비
	character_util.set_position(oni_girl, self.lala_start_position)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')
	oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local fairy = get_character('fairy_basic3')
	if fairy ~= nil and vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party.Leader.Position, fairy.Position) < 4 then
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		character_util.set_position(fairy, self.user_start_position + vector(-2, 0, 0), false)
		character_util.set_direction(fairy, 'right')
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(fairy, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		fairy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	-- 플레이어 출발 준비
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	user_party:PositionParty(self.user_start_position, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 0, "linear")

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	-- 준비됐어? 먼저 도착하는 사람이 이기는 거야!
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_8', skip = true })
	self:backup_and_mute_stage_music()

	-- 3… 2… 1… 출발!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'fox_onigirl_mother_talk_9', skip = true })
	self:play_race_bgm()

	-- 라라 출발
	self.lala_run_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lala_run, self))

	-- 플레이어 출발
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.current_race_state = self.race_state.racing

	local won = false

	while true do
		-- 플레이어가 트랙 밖으로 이탈하려 했을 때
		local is_run_away = user_party.Leader.Position.x <= self.race_start_position.x - 2
			and user_party.Leader.Position.z <= self.race_start_position.z

		if is_run_away then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stop_coroutine(self.lala_run_coroutine)
			character_util.stop(oni_girl)
			character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
			character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)

			camera_util.move(oni_girl.Position, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)


			local oni_direction_pos = (user_party.Leader.Position - oni_girl.Position):GetX0z()
			character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, oni_direction_pos:ToDirection())
			character_util.jump(oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl, { key = 'onigirl_10', skip = true })

			-- 경기장 이탈 시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			yield_return_func(self.give_up_race, self)
			break
		end

		local is_reach_end_point = user_party.Leader.Position.x >= self.race_end_lb_position.x
				and user_party.Leader.Position.z >= self.race_end_lb_position.z
				and user_party.Leader.Position.x <= self.race_end_rt_position.x
				and user_party.Leader.Position.z <= self.race_end_rt_position.z

		-- 플레이어가 승리했을 때
		if not won and is_reach_end_point then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			-- 승리 시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)

			won = true
		end

		-- 라나가 골 지점에 들어왔을 때
		local is_lana_reach_end_point = oni_girl.Position.x >= self.race_end_lb_position.x
		if is_lana_reach_end_point then
			character_util.stop(oni_girl)

			-- 플레이어가 졌다면
			if not won then
				character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, {name = "doyagao", loop = true})
				character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "success", loop = true})

				self.current_race_state = self.race_state.lose
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, {name = "tired", loop = true})
				character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, {name = "seat", loop = true})

				self.current_race_state = self.race_state.won
			end

			local qi = self.quest_progress.QuestId
			if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker(self.quest_progress.QuestId) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId, false, oni_girl)
			end

			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(oni_girl)

			self.player_race_won = won
			self.race_finished = true

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_race_bgm()

	oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	if oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.interact_coroutine = nil
	self.race_coroutine = nil
end

end

-- 레이스 전 Muted 상태로 BGM을 바꾸기 전에 기존 BGM 백업하는 과정
function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	-- 팡파레, 새로운 캐릭터 얻는 상태의 예외처리
	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare
			or music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 재생
function local_class:play_race_bgm()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_gun_shoot_01")

	music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_lana", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 중지 후 기존 BGM으로 복구
function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
	-- 이미 BGM이 중지되었다면 리턴
	if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= "bgm_lana" then
		return
	end

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	else
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_oni_girl()) then

			if self.current_race_state == self.race_state.won then
				self.current_race_state = self.race_state.finished

				self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))

			elseif self.current_race_state == self.race_state.lose then
				self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))

			elseif self.current_race_state == self.race_state.ready then
				self.interact_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.re_challenge, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FoxParasiteSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxParasite @
		Comment = 기생충 패러디 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 존 이름
	self.cave_parasite_zone_name = 'cave_parasite_zone'

	-- 스타 피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = controller.star_piece_name

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_cave_human = function() return get_character('cave_human') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_output_brazier = function(num) return get_field_object('parasite_output_brazier_' .. num) end
	self.get_input_brazier = function(num) return get_field_object('parasite_input_brazier_' .. num) end
	self.get_input_switch = function(num) return get_field_object('parasite_input_switch_' .. num) end
	self.get_cave_brazier = function(num) return get_field_object('parasite_cave_brazier_' .. num) end
	self.get_door = function() return get_field_object('parasite_door') end
	self.get_stair = function() return get_field_object('parasite_stair') end

	-- 스타 피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 화로와 스위치의 리스트
	self.output_brazier_list = nil
	self.input_brazier_list = nil
	self.input_switch_list = nil
	self.cave_brazier_list = nil

	-- 현재 불이 켜진 화로
	self.current_input_brazier = nil

	-- 플레이어가 화로를 켠 순서
	self.input_brazier_queue = nil

	-- 정답 순서
	self.brazier_password = { 1, 4, 2, 1, 3 }

	-- 정답을 맞춰서 문을 열었는지
	self.is_open_door = false

	-- 비밀 계단의 원래 Interactable 백업
	self.stair_interactable_backup = nil

	-- 메인 이벤트가 진행되는 동안, 횟불 점멸을 막아둔다.
	self.is_pause_output_brazier = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.output_brazier_list = {}
	self.input_brazier_list = {}
	self.input_switch_list = {}
	self.cave_brazier_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local output_brazier = self.get_output_brazier(i)
		local input_brazier = self.get_input_brazier(i)
		local input_switch = self.get_input_switch(i)
		local cave_brazier = self.get_cave_brazier(i)

		table.insert(self.output_brazier_list, output_brazier)
		table.insert(self.input_brazier_list, input_brazier)
		table.insert(self.input_switch_list, input_switch)
		table.insert(self.cave_brazier_list, cave_brazier)
	end

	self.input_brazier_queue = {}

	local door = self.get_door()
	door.Position = vector(58, 0, -93)

	local stair = self.get_stair()
	self.stair_interactable_backup = stair.Interactable
	stair.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	stair.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local cave_human = self.get_cave_human()
	cave_human.Position = vector(-49, 0, 50)
	character_util.set_direction(cave_human, 'up')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.output_brazier_pattern, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.output_brazier_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.output_brazier_list do
			self.output_brazier_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.output_brazier_list = nil
	if self.input_brazier_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.input_brazier_list do
			self.input_brazier_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.input_brazier_list = nil
	if self.input_switch_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.input_switch_list do
			self.input_switch_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.input_switch_list = nil
	if self.cave_brazier_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.cave_brazier_list do
			self.cave_brazier_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.cave_brazier_list = nil

	self.current_input_brazier = nil
	self.input_brazier_queue = nil
	self.brazier_password = nil

	self.stair_interactable_backup = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		return self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if e.IsTurningOn then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, user_party_leader) then
			for i = 1, #self.input_switch_list do
				local input_switch = self.input_switch_list[i]
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, input_switch) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.input_brazier, self, i))
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.cave_parasite_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_cave, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'pause_parasite_brazier' then
		self.is_pause_output_brazier = true
		return true
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'resume_parasite_brazier' then
		self.is_pause_output_brazier = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 밖의 화롯불이 점멸하는 패턴
function local_class:output_brazier_pattern()
	while true do
		for i = 1, #self.brazier_password do
			-- 메인 이벤트가 진행되는 동안, 횟불 점멸을 막아둔다.
			while self.is_pause_output_brazier do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			local index = self.brazier_password[i]
			local output_brazier = self.output_brazier_list[index]

			output_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
			command_util.execute_burn(nil, output_brazier, false)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', parent = output_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })

			wait_for_sec(1)

			command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, output_brazier)
			output_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
		end
		wait_for_sec(3)
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 스위치를 눌러서 화롯불을 켬
function local_class:input_brazier(index)
	local input_brazier = self.get_input_brazier(index)
	local prev_input_brazier = self.current_input_brazier

	if prev_input_brazier ~= nil then
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, prev_input_brazier)
		prev_input_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
	end

	input_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
	input_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.BurnLifeTime = 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', parent = input_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
	command_util.execute_burn(user_party_leader, input_brazier, false)

	self.current_input_brazier = input_brazier

	-- 이미 문을 열었으면 순서 체크는 하지 않는다.
	if self.is_open_door then
		return
	end

	-- 플레이어가 킨 화로의 순서를 queue로 등록한다.
	table.insert(self.input_brazier_queue, index)
	if #self.input_brazier_queue > 5 then
		table.remove(self.input_brazier_queue, 1)
	end

	local is_answer = self:check_password()
	if is_answer then
		-- 문이 열림
		local door = self.get_door()
		local stair = self.get_stair()

		self.is_open_door = true
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_door_down_01')
		stair.Position = vector(58, 0, -93)
		door:Shake(0.02, 2)
		character_util.move_to_async(door, door.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil)
		stair.Interactable = self.stair_interactable_backup
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 켠 화로의 순서와 정답이 일치하는지 확인
function local_class:check_password()
	if #self.input_brazier_queue ~= #self.brazier_password then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.input_brazier_queue do
		local user_num = self.input_brazier_queue[i]
		local password_num = self.brazier_password[i]

		if user_num ~= password_num then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 비밀 문을 통해서 동굴 안으로 들어간 후의 연출
function local_class:enter_cave()
	local cave_human = self.get_cave_human()

	party_util.align_to_target(vector(-49, 0, 49), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.5)

	-- cave_human 하던걸 멈춤
	self.is_brazier_pattern_on = false
	character_util.stop(cave_human)

	-- 남자, 화로 스위치를 밟으며 이상한 소리를 하고 있다.
	-- 우리 박 대감님, 항상 절 멕여주시고
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_5', skip = true })

	-- 재워 주시고… 너무나 고마워요-
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_6', skip = true })

	local prev_cave_brazier = nil
	for i = 1, #self.brazier_password do
		local index = self.brazier_password[i]
		local cave_brazier = self.cave_brazier_list[index]

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(cave_human, {
			vector(cave_human.Position.x, 0, 50),
			cave_brazier.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
			cave_brazier.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) }, 6, true, nil, nil, nil, true)

		if prev_cave_brazier ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, prev_cave_brazier)
			prev_cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
		end

		cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, cave_brazier, false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', parent = cave_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_switch_button_01', parent = cave_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		prev_cave_brazier = cave_brazier
	end

	character_util.set_direction(cave_human, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, prev_cave_brazier)
	prev_cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(cave_human, { vector(cave_human.Position.x, 0, 50), vector(-49, 0, 50) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	-- 반가워, 반가워.
	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_emotion(cave_human, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(cave_human, true)
	character_util.set_anim(cave_human, { name = 'clap' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_7', skip = true })

	clap_sfx:Stop()

	-- 다른 사람을 보는 건 얼마 만인지 기억도 나질 않네.
	character_util.remove_anim(cave_human)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_8', skip = true })

	-- 여기서 뭘 하는 거지? / 대체 당신은…?
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'fox_parasite_8_1', 'brutal' }, { 'fox_parasite_8_2', 'mercy' } })

	-- 빚에 쫓겨 능력 있는 대감님 집에 숨어 살고 있는 중이야.
	character_util.remove_emotion(cave_human)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_9', skip = true })

	-- 그 보답으로 이렇게 매일 감사의 뜻으로 화로를 켜고 있지.
	character_util.set_anim(cave_human, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_10', skip = true })

	-- 대감님, RESPECT!!!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.6)
	character_util.set_direction(cave_human, 'up')
	character_util.normal_jump(cave_human, true)
	character_util.set_anim(cave_human, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_11', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 아무튼 오랜만에 사람과 말하게 해줘서 고마워.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(cave_human, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(cave_human)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_12', skip = true })

	-- 자, 여기 선물이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_13', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(cave_human, { name = 'get', loop = false })

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(cave_human.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(cave_human)

	-- 그럼 난 바빠서 이만.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_14', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.set_direction(cave_human, 'up')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cave_brazier_routine, self))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

-- 남자가 동굴 안에서 이리저리 돌아다니면서 스위치를 누르고 있음.
function local_class:cave_brazier_routine()
	local cave_human = self.get_cave_human()

	local prev_cave_brazier = nil
	while true do
		-- 우리 박 대감님, 항상 절 멕여주시고
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_5' })

		-- 재워 주시고… 너무나 고마워요-
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cave_human, { key = 'fox_parasite_6' })

		for i = 1, #self.brazier_password do
			local index = self.brazier_password[i]
			local cave_brazier = self.cave_brazier_list[index]

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(cave_human, {
				vector(cave_human.Position.x, 0, 50),
				cave_brazier.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
				cave_brazier.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) }, 6, true, nil, nil, nil, true)

			if prev_cave_brazier ~= nil then
				command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, prev_cave_brazier)
				prev_cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
			end

			cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
			command_util.execute_burn(nil, cave_brazier, false)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', parent = cave_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_switch_button_01', parent = cave_brazier, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			prev_cave_brazier = cave_brazier
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(cave_human, vector(cave_human.Position.x, 0, 50), 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')

		command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, prev_cave_brazier)
		prev_cave_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = FoxReaper @
		Comment = 사신 유나를 발견해 대화함 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_reaper = function() return get_character('reaper') end

	self.enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 사신이 사라지는것을 봄
		ripper_fade = 1,
		--- 사신의 혼잣말
		ripper_monologue = 2,
		--- 사신과 대화함
		ripper_talk = 3,
	}

	self.progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	self.progress = self.enum.idle

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return end

	local reaper = self.get_reaper()
	character_util.set_position(reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_1').position)
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'left')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.get_reaper = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return false end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'reaper_pre_1' and self.progress == self.enum.idle then
		self.progress = self.enum.ripper_fade
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reaper_fade, self))
	elseif zone_name == 'reaper_pre_2' and self.progress == self.enum.ripper_fade then
		self.progress = self.enum.ripper_monologue
		local reaper = self.get_reaper()
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_1'})
		--하아… 이런 잡일이나 하려고 온게 아닌데...

		reaper.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_reaper()) then
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_request, self))
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.quest_request, self)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:reaper_fade()
	local reaper = self.get_reaper()
	reaper.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(reaper, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 4, false)
	reaper.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_position(reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_2').position)
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(reaper, {name = 'seat'})
	character_util.set_emotion(reaper, {name = 'tired'})
end

function local_class:quest_request()
	local reaper = self.get_reaper()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(reaper)

	local pos = field:GetMarker('reaper_2').position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.5)

	if self.controller:with_old_man() then
		local old_man = get_character('old_man')
		character_util.move_waypoint(old_man, pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
				4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	end

	party_util.align_party(pos, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.progress == self.enum.ripper_monologue then
		character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_2', skip = true})
		--왜? 나한테 볼 일 있어?

		local wait = true
		local ans = -1

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			--몸이 투명해지는걸 봤다.
			Text = game_string:GetString('fox_reaper_pre_3'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				ans = 1
			end
		})
		branches:Add({
			--유령이다!
			Text = game_string:GetString('fox_reaper_pre_4'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				ans = 2
			end
		})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(nil, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if ans == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'surprise'})
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'embarrassed'})
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(reaper, {name = 'surprise'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_5', skip = true})
		--너… 내가 보이는 거야?

		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(reaper)
		character_util.jump(reaper, 1, 0.7)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.5),
				1, false, nil, nil, 'left')

		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true})
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(reaper, {name = 'clap', count = 2})
		clap_sfx:Stop()

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_6', skip = true})
		--마침 잘 됐어. 딱 너 같이 감이 좋은 사람이 필요했거든.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_7', skip = true})
		--난 망자들을 저승으로 이끄는 저승사자 유나야.

		self.progress = self.enum.ripper_talk
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(reaper)
		character_util.jump(reaper, 1, 0.7)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.5),
				1, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(reaper, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_8', skip = true})
	--최근 망자들이 너무 많아지는 바람에, 과로로 쓰러질 지경이야.

	character_util.remove_emotion(reaper)
	character_util.set_anim(reaper, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_9', skip = true})
	--그래서 말인데… 내 업무 좀 도와주지 않겠어?

	local wait = true
	local ans = -1

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		--네
		Text = game_string:GetString('bt_yes'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false;
			ans = 1
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		--아니오
		Text = game_string:GetString('bt_no'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false;
			ans = 2
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(nil, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(reaper)

	if ans == 1 then
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)
		self.controller:init_wisp()

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_10', skip = true})
		--좋아, 저기 떠다니는 영혼들 보이지?

		self.controller:init_wisp()
		camera_util.move_async(field:GetMarker('reaper_wisp_1').position + vector(5, 0, -3), 1)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_11', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-250, -100)})
		--겁이 많아서 가까이 가면 다들 도망갈 거야.

		camera_util.move_async(field:GetMarker('reaper_wisp_1').position + vector(5, 0, -20), 1)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_12', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-250, 100)})
		--그러니까 네가 몰래 뒤로가서 한마리씩 시선을 끌어줘.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_13', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-250, 100)})
		--그럼 내가 마무리할게.

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		character_util.set_anim(reaper, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_14', skip = true})
		--한 명이라도 놓치면 실패니까, 조심해.
		character_util.remove_anim(reaper)

		reaper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(reaper, {name = 'tired'})

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper, {key = 'fox_reaper_pre_15', skip = true})
		--다른 일이 있나 보지?

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(reaper, 1, 0.7)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper, reaper.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0.5),
				1, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(reaper, {name = 'seat'})
	end

	if self.controller:with_old_man() then
		local old_man = get_character('old_man')
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(old_man, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		old_man:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end


end

local local_class = newclass('FoxReaperSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxReaper @
		Comment = 영혼을 모두 회수 한 후 스타피스 획득 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_reaper = function() return get_character('reaper') end

	self.wisp_count = 0

	self.see_fate = false

	self.is_catching = false
	self.is_reset = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then return true end

	local reaper = self.get_reaper()
	character_util.set_position(reaper, field:GetMarker('reaper_2').position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, 'left')
	reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_reaper_pre_14'

	self.controller:init_wisp()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.get_reaper = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)

	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate | CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party_leader) then
		for i = 1, self.controller.total_wisp_count do
			local wisp = get_character('reaper_wisp_' .. i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, wisp) then
				if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.catch_soul, self, wisp)
				elseif not self.is_catching and not self.is_reset then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_soul, self, wisp.Name)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == 'reaper_detected' and not self.is_catching and not self.is_reset then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_soul, self, e.Params[1])
		end
	end

	return false

end
--endregion

function local_class:catch_soul(wisp)
	self.is_catching = true
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_appear_01')

	local reaper = get_character('reaper')
	wisp.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	wisp.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local side_val = 1
	local side_str = 'left'
	if wisp.Position.x > -0.5 then
		side_val = -1
		side_str = 'right'
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_character_warp_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object'):Instantiate(wisp.Position + vector(1.5 * side_val, 0, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.set_position(reaper, wisp.Position + vector(1.5 * side_val, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(reaper, side_str)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(reaper, {name = 'attack'})

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_back_slash_02')
	local slash = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash'):Instantiate(reaper.Position)
	slash.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -90 * side_val, 0))
	slash.transform.localScale = vector(1 * side_val, 1, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(wisp.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(wisp.Position)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(wisp, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(wisp, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	character_util.shake(wisp, 0.1, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local duration = 0.5
	wisp:SetScale(vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), duration)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(wisp, 0.2, duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(wisp, reaper.Position, duration)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

function local_class:illusion_tint_process()
	local tint_name = 'illusion'
	local transition_time = 1.5

	local colors = {
		unity_color({ 0.2, 0, 0.4, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0.3, 0, 0.3, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0.3, 0, 0.3, 1 }),
	}

	local rotate_angle = 3
	local rotate_speed = 0.2

	local current_color_idx = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 1)
	local end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
	while self.see_fate do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * unity_class.time.time * rotate_speed)
		stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate_angle * sin_val, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / transition_time)
		local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, progress)
		if time_passed >= transition_time then
			time_passed = 0
			start_color = end_color
			current_color_idx = current_color_idx == #colors and 1 or current_color_idx + 1
			end_color = colors[current_color_idx]
		else
			field:Tint(tint_name, current_color, 0, 0.8)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	stage_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	field:RemoveTint(tint_name, 0.2)
end

return local_class
