local local_class = newclass('FoxSadakoVsKayakoSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxSadakoVsKayako @
		Comment = 링 vs 주온 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 존 이름
	self.ring_well_zone_name = 'ring_well_zone'
	self.toshio_zone_name = 'toshi_zone'
	self.sadako_toshio_fight_zone_name = 'sadako_toshio_fight_zone'
	self.ghost_reset_zone_name = 'ghost_reset_zone'
	self.ghost_sadako_reset_zone_name = 'ghost_sadako_reset_zone'

	-- 스타 피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = controller.star_piece_name

	-- TypingText 애셋 번들 이름
	self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name = 'ui/prologue'

	-- TypingText 애셋 이름
	self.typing_text_asset_name = 'typing_text'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_sadako = function() return get_character('sadako') end
	self.get_toshio = function() return get_character('toshio') end
	self.get_shaman = function() return get_character('shaman') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_well = function() return get_field_object('ring_well') end

	-- 스타 피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_sadako_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('sadako_position') end
	self.get_sadako_reset_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('sadako_reset_position') end
	self.get_toshio_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('toshio_position') end
	self.get_toshio_reset_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('toshio_reset_position') end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.water_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in') end
	self.slash_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SlashLine_Hit') end

	-- 이벤트 프로그레스
	self.sadako_progress = {
		none = 0,
		watch_sadako = 1,
		chase = 2,
		fight = 3
	}
	self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.none

	self.toshio_progress = {
		none = 0,
		stop_talk = 1,
		chase = 2,
		reset = 3,
		fight = 4
	}
	self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.none

	self.is_chasing_user = {}
	self.is_user_catch = false
	self.is_ready_to_fight = false

	self.tint_req_count = 0

	self.typing_text = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	local shaman = self.get_shaman()
	shaman.Position = vector(-29, 0, -105)
	shaman.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local toshio_position_marker = self.get_toshio_position_marker()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()
	toshio.Position = toshio_position_marker.position
	toshio.Direction = toshio_position_marker.direction
	toshio.SpineController:AddColor('toshio', unity_class.color(0.3647058823529412, 0.5215686274509804, 0.7647058823529412, 1), 1, 0.3)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.toshio_talk_alone, self))

	self.water_effect_pool()
	self.slash_effect_pool()

	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		resholder, self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name, self.typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
			self.typing_text = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
				stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

			self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 90, 1, 110);
			self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0;
			self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors();
			self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32;
		end)

	resholder:Dispose()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	local shaman = self.get_shaman()
	shaman.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local sadako = self.get_sadako()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(sadako.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		sadako.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.is_chasing_user = nil

	if self.typing_text ~= nil then
		self.typing_text:Dispose()
	end
	self.typing_text = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local well = self.get_well()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()
	local shaman = self.get_shaman()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, well) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sadako) then
		if not self.is_ready_to_fight then
			if self.current_toshio_progress < self.toshio_progress.chase then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sadako, self)
				return true
			end
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fight_sadako_vs_toshio, self)
			return true
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, shaman) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_shaman, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		local toshio = self.get_toshio()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.ring_well_zone_name and self.current_sadako_progress < self.sadako_progress.watch_sadako and self.current_toshio_progress < self.toshio_progress.chase then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sadako_appear, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.toshio_zone_name and self.current_toshio_progress == self.toshio_progress.none then
				if self.current_sadako_progress < self.sadako_progress.chase then
					self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.stop_talk
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(toshio)
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.ghost_reset_zone_name then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
				if self.current_sadako_progress == self.sadako_progress.chase then
					self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.reset

					local sadako = self.get_sadako()
					self.is_chasing_user[sadako] = false
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset, self, sadako, self.sadako_reset))
				end
				if self.current_toshio_progress == self.toshio_progress.chase then
					self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.reset

					self.is_chasing_user[toshio] = false
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset, self, toshio, self.toshio_reset))
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.ghost_sadako_reset_zone_name then
				if self.current_sadako_progress == self.sadako_progress.chase then
					self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.reset

					local sadako = self.get_sadako()
					self.is_chasing_user[sadako] = false
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset, self, sadako, self.sadako_reset))
					return true
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sadako_reset, self))
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, toshio) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.sadako_toshio_fight_zone_name then
				local well = self.get_well()
				well.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				self.is_ready_to_fight = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		local toshio = self.get_toshio()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.toshio_zone_name and self.current_toshio_progress == self.toshio_progress.stop_talk then
				self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.chase
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.toshio_chase, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, toshio) then
			local well = self.get_well()
			well.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			self.is_ready_to_fight = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 무당과 인터랙트 했을 때
function local_class:interact_shaman()
	local shaman = self.get_shaman()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(shaman)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(shaman, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_12', force_sfx = true })
end

-- 사다코 리셋
function local_class:sadako_reset()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()

	self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.none

	sadako.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.set_emotion(sadako, { name = 'empty' })
	character_util.remove_anim(sadako)
end

-- 우물에서 사다코가 나타나는 연출
function local_class:sadako_appear()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()
	local well = self.get_well()

	local duration = 0.5

	self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.watch_sadako

	sadako.Position = well.Position + vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(sadako, 'right')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sadako, 0, 0)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sadako, 1, duration)
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sadako, 0, duration)
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sadako, 1, duration)
	wait_for_sec(duration)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local sadako_position_marker = self.get_sadako_position_marker()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(sadako, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.move_to_async(sadako, sadako_position_marker.position, 0.3, nil, true, false)

	sadako.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
end

-- 사다코나 우물에 인터랙트 해서 쫓기는 연출
function local_class:interact_sadako()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()
	local well = self.get_well()

	-- 키야아아악!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_scream_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.2)
	character_util.normal_jump(sadako, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sadako, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	sadako.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	-- 플레이어 scared 뒤로 2칸 물러섬.
	yield_return_func(self.user_party_scared, self, sadako, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_agro_01')
	self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.chase
	local user_reset_position = self.get_sadako_reset_position_marker()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.following_user, self, sadako, 5, user_reset_position, self.sadako_reset))
end

-- 사다코가 가만히 있다가, 플레이어가 계속 남아있으면 플레이어를 향해 돌진함.
function local_class:sadako_waiting()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()

	local duration = 2
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		if self.current_sadako_progress ~= self.sadako_progress.watch_sadako then
			return
		end

		local distance = (user_party.Leader.Position - sadako.Position).magnitude

		if distance <= 3 then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		else
			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 키야아아악!
	camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.2)
	character_util.normal_jump(sadako, true)
	character_util.look_at(sadako, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sadako, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 플레이어 scared 뒤로 2칸 물러섬.
	yield_return_func(self.user_party_scared, self, toshio)

	self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.chase
	local user_reset_position = self.get_sadako_reset_position_marker()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.following_user, self, sadako, 5, user_reset_position, self.sadako_reset))

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 토시오 리셋
function local_class:toshio_reset()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()
	local toshio_position_marker = self.get_toshio_position_marker()

	self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.none

	toshio.Position = toshio_position_marker.position
	toshio.Direction = toshio_position_marker.direction
	character_util.set_anim(toshio, { name = 'seat' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.toshio_talk_alone, self))
end

-- 토시오가 혼자 야옹 야옹 하고 있음.
function local_class:toshio_talk_alone()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()

	while self.current_toshio_progress == self.toshio_progress.none do
		-- 야옹~
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_2' })

		wait_for_sec(2.5)
	end
end

-- 토시오가 괴성을 지르며 쫓아옴.
function local_class:toshio_chase()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()

	-- 키야아아악!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_scream_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_thriller', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.2)
	character_util.normal_jump(toshio, true)
	character_util.look_at(toshio, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(toshio, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.remove_anim(toshio)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 플레이어 scared 뒤로 2칸 물러섬.
	yield_return_func(self.user_party_scared, self, toshio)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.toshio_talk, self))

	local user_reset_position = self.get_toshio_reset_position_marker()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.following_user, self, toshio, 5, user_reset_position, self.toshio_reset))
end

-- 토시오가 세단어를 반복하며 쫓아온다.
function local_class:toshio_talk()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()
	local talk_count = 0

	while self.current_toshio_progress == self.toshio_progress.chase do
		-- 야마하! / 니콘! / 카시오!
		local talk_index = (talk_count + 3)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
		yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_' .. talk_index)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_' .. talk_index, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0 })
		yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

		talk_count = (talk_count + 1) % 3
	end
end

-- 플레이어 파티가 겁먹고 뒤로 물러섬.
function local_class:user_party_scared(fo, direction)
	-- 플레이어가 fo를 바라보고 물러서는 방향(4방향)
	if direction == nil then
		direction = vector_util.to_direction(fo.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)
	end
	local direction_vector = -direction_util.to_vector3(direction)

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })

	local move_coroutine_list = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		table.insert(move_coroutine_list, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, party, party.Position + (direction_vector * 2), 2, false))
		party.Direction = direction
		party.LockedDirection = party.Direction
	end

	wait_all(move_coroutine_list)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		party.Direction = party.LockedDirection
		character_util.set_locked_dir(party, 'none')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

-- 유저를 따라다니는 연출
function local_class:following_user(fo, speed, user_reset_marker, reset_callback)
	local distance = 0.5

	self.is_chasing_user[fo] = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_tint, self))

	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'run' })

	while true do
		if not self.is_chasing_user[fo] then
			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
			fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			if self.is_user_catch then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset, self, fo, reset_callback))
			end
			return
		end

		local direction = (user_party.Leader.Position - fo.Position)
		fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(direction.normalized)

		if direction.magnitude <= distance then
			break
		end

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(fo, direction.normalized, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for k, v in pairs(self.is_chasing_user) do
		if k ~= fo then
			self.is_chasing_user[k] = false
		end
	end

	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	yield_return_func(self.catch, self, fo, user_reset_marker, reset_callback)
end

-- 붙잡혔을 때 연출
function local_class:catch(fo, user_reset_position, reset_callback)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_user_catch = true

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })

	character_util.stop(fo)
	wp_util.move(fo, user_party.Leader.Position, nil, 2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1.5 })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_dark_magician_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	self.tint_req_count = self.tint_req_count + 1
	field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.5)

	character_util.stop(fo)

	-- 위치 변경 및 초기화
	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.position_party(user_reset_position.position, user_reset_position.direction, 'arc')

	yield_return_func(reset_callback, self)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fo)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	self.is_user_catch = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 포기하고 돌아가서 리셋하는 연출
function local_class:reset(fo, reset_callback)
	local duration = 1

	if not self.is_user_catch then
		self.tint_req_count = self.tint_req_count + 1
		field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.5)
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.stop(fo)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, duration)
	wait_for_sec(duration)

	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 위치 변경 및 초기화
	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 1, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(reset_callback, self))
end

-- 추격 당할 때 틴트
function local_class:chase_tint()
	local tint_color = { unity_class.color(0.1568627450980392, 0.2980392156862745, 0.4862745098039216, 1), unity_class.color(0.2392156862745098, 0.4117647058823529, 0.6784313725490196, 1) }
	local tint_index = 1
	local tint_req_count = self.tint_req_count + 1
	self.tint_req_count = self.tint_req_count + 1

	while tint_req_count == self.tint_req_count do
		field:Tint(nil, tint_color[tint_index], 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
		tint_index = (tint_index % 2) + 1
	end
end

-- 사다코와 토시오가 싸우는 연출
function local_class:fight_sadako_vs_toshio()
	local sadako = self.get_sadako()
	local toshio = self.get_toshio()
	local return_camera_to_leader = false

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sadako)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(toshio)
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	-- 사다코와 토시오 둘 다 쫓는 루틴을 멈춘 후 진행.
	self.is_chasing_user[sadako] = false
	self.is_chasing_user[toshio] = false

	character_util.remove_anim(sadako)
	character_util.remove_anim(toshio)

	self.current_toshio_progress = self.toshio_progress.fight
	if self.current_sadako_progress < self.sadako_progress.watch_sadako then
		-- 사다코가 우물밖으로 등장하지 않았다면, 등장 시킨다.
		local well = self.get_well()
		camera_util.move_async(well.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), 0.5)
		yield_return_func(self.sadako_appear, self)
		self.current_sadako_progress = self.sadako_progress.fight
		return_camera_to_leader = true
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 서로 위치를 잡고 대립함.
	if return_camera_to_leader then
		camera_util.move(vector(-32.5, 0, -105), 1, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
	end
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, sadako, vector(-35, 0, -108), 6, false, nil, nil, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, toshio, vector(-30, 0, -108), 6, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(party_util.align_to_target, vector(-32.5, 0, -106), 'up', 1, 'arc')
	})

	-- 플레이어 파티 놀라서 뒤로 넘어진다.(seat+scared)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'seat' })

	character_util.remove_anim(sadako)
	character_util.remove_anim(toshio)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local is_smash = false
	local attack_twice = function(fo, attack_anim, scale, duration)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = attack_anim, scale = scale })
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		if not is_smash then
			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		end
	end

	-- 요코하마!
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
	camera_util.move_async(sadako.Position, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.6)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(attack_twice, sadako, 'attack', 1, 1.6))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_scream_01')
	yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_7')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sadako, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_7', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	-- 홋카이도!
	camera_util.move_async(toshio.Position, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.6)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(attack_twice, toshio, 'boong_attack', 0.5, 1))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_scream_01')
	yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_8')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_8', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async((sadako.Position + toshio.Position) / 2, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 여자유령 뛰어서 꼬마 유령을 덮친다. + slash
	-- 꼬마유령도 달려들며 slash
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_ghost_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 0.25)
	character_util.jump(sadako, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(toshio, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(sadako, sadako.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, false)
	character_util.move_to(toshio, toshio.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, false)
	character_util.set_anim(sadako, { name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	character_util.set_anim(toshio, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	time_util.mod('sadako_vs_toshio', 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_critical_01')
	self.slash_effect_pool():Instantiate(((sadako.Position + toshio.Position) / 2) + vector(0, 1, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	time_util.unmod('sadako_vs_toshio')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(toshio, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	character_util.set_anim(sadako, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 덴뿌라…
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_ghost_01')
	yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_9')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_9', skip = true })
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	-- 스시…
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_10')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sadako, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_10', skip = true })
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	-- 사시미이이…….
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_agro_01')
	yield_return_func(self.show_subtitle, self, 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_subtitle_11')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(toshio, { key = 'fox_sadako_vs_kayako_11', skip = true })
	yield_return_func(self.hide_subtitle, self)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_disappear_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sadako, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(toshio, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_active_state(sadako, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(toshio, 'disabled')

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(sadako.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	self.tint_req_count = self.tint_req_count + 1
	field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

-- 화면 아래에 자막처럼 띄워준다.
function local_class:show_subtitle(key)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.typing_text:SetTypedText(game_string:GetString(key), 1000, 0, 9999))
end

-- 화면 아래에 자막을 지워준다.
function local_class:hide_subtitle()
	self.typing_text:ForceFinish()
end

return local_class

	self.hit_sfx = '02_hit_big_01'
	self.beam_fx = 'fx_common_event_transform'
	self.twinkle_fx = 'FX_Object_Twinkle'
	self.teleport_fx = 'FX_reset_object'

	self.zone_enter_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	self:startrek_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.red_crews = {}
	self.yellow_crews = {}
	self.event_state = 0
	self.zone_enter_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 플레이어가 호랑이면 아무 이벤트도 처리하지않음.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, get_character('tiger_player')) then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:startrek_setting()
	local red_position = {
		vector(-5, 0, 4),	--1
		vector(-5, 0, 3),	--2
		vector(-2, 0, 3),	--3
		vector(4, 0, 4),	--4
		vector(4, 0, 3),	--5
		vector(5, 0, 3),	--6
		vector(5, 0, -3),	--7
		vector(4, 0, -3),	--8
		vector(4, 0, -4),	--9
		vector(1, 0, -3)	--10
	}
	local red_direction = {
		'left',		--1
		'left',		--2
		'down',		--3
		'right',	--4
		'right',	--5
		'up',		--6
		'down',		--7
		'down',		--8
		'right',	--9
		'down'		--10
	}
	local yellow_position = {
		vector(-1, 0, 0),	--1
		vector(0, 0, 1),	--2
		vector(1, 0, 0)		--3
	}
	local yellow_direction = {
		'right',		--1
		'down',			--2
		'left'			--3
	}
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local crew = get_character('red_crew_' .. i)
		table.insert(self.red_crews, i, crew)
		crew.Position = self.center_pos + red_position[i]
		character_util.set_direction(crew, red_direction[i])
		crew.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour.Instance
		if i ~= 3 and i ~= 10 then
			crew.Interactable.Talk = self.startrek_talk_name .. 'pre_5'
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local crew = get_character('yellow_crew_' .. i)
		table.insert(self.yellow_crews, i, crew)
		crew.Position = self.center_pos + yellow_position[i]
		character_util.set_direction(crew, yellow_direction[i])
	end

	get_field_object(self.blocker_name).Position = self.center_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.1)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.beam_fx)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_fx)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.teleport_fx)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.event_state == 0 then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.bomb_zone_name then
			if self.zone_enter_coroutine ~= nil then
				stop_coroutine(self.zone_enter_coroutine)
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[1])
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[2])
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[3])
				self.yellow_crews[1].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_9'
				self.yellow_crews[2].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_10'
				self.yellow_crews[3].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_11'
			end
			self.zone_enter_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bomb_zone_enter, self))
			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.starpiece_zone_name then
			if self.zone_enter_coroutine ~= nil then
				stop_coroutine(self.zone_enter_coroutine)
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[1])
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[2])
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[3])
				self.yellow_crews[1].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_9'
				self.yellow_crews[2].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_10'
				self.yellow_crews[3].Interactable.Talk = 'fox_3_startrek_talk_11'
			end
			self.zone_enter_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starpiece_zone_enter, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.event_state == -1 then
		self.event_state = 0
		self.zone_enter_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_zone_enter, self))
		return true
	end
	if e.Zone.Name == self.fire_zone_name and not e.FullEnter and not lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject.CombustibleBehaviour, CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour) and self.event_state == 0 then
		if e.FieldObject.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
			self.event_state = 1
			self.zone_enter_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.startrek_event0, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.yellow_crews[3], {key = self.startrek_talk_name .. 'pre_3', skip = false, life_time = 1.5, force_sfx = true})

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	if e.Info.type == require_damage_type then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.red_crews[1]) and self.event_state == 1 then
			self.event_state = 2
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_scream_02')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.startrek_event1, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.red_crews[5]) and self.event_state == 2 then
			self.event_state = 3
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_scream_02')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.startrek_event2, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.red_crews[7]) and self.event_state == 3 then
			self.event_state = 4
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_scream_02')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.startrek_event3, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:startrek_event0()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow_crews[2])

end

	character_util.set_direction(self.red_crews[2], 'left')

	character_util.move_to(self.red_crews[2], self.red_crews[3].Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.25, nil)
	local timer = 0
	local duration = 0.8
	local token = false
	while timer < duration do
		self:update_dash_state(self.red_crews[1], vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if timer > 0.25 and timer < 0.4 and not token then
			token = true
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_sfx)
			self:startrek_death(self.red_crews[2], vector(-1, 0, 0))
			self:startrek_death(self.red_crews[3], vector(2, 0, 0))

	for i = 0, ifo_list.Count - 1 do

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, direction, 0.3, 0.3)

	card_pos_list:Add(vector(89.2, 0, -82.5))
	card_pos_list:Add(vector(90.8, 0, -82.5))

	for i = 1, self.card_num do

	end

function local_class:exit()

	if self.hogu ~= nil then
		self.hogu.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.hogu = nil
	end

	self.tazza = nil

	self.card_list = nil
	self.audience_list = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	-- 화투판 중심 카메라 위치
	self.center_camera_pos = vector(90, 0, -82)

	-- 타짜의 패 공개 카메라 위치
	self.tazza_card_camera_pos = vector(89.2, 0, -82.3)

	-- 호구의 패 공개 카메라 위치
	self.hogu_card_camera_pos = vector(90.8, 0, -82.3)

	-- 기타 상수
	self.card_num = 4
	self.audience_num = 8
	self.card_camera_size = 1

	-- NPC 이름
	self.hogu_name = 'hogu'
	self.tazza_name = 'tazza'
	self.card_name = 'card_'
	self.audience_name = 'tazza_audience_'
	self.bandit_name = 'tazza_bandit'

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'tazza_star_piece'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)

	self.hogu = get_character(self.hogu_name)
	self.hogu.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'tired' })

	self.tazza = get_character(self.tazza_name)

	self.bandit = get_character(self.bandit_name)
	self.bandit.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'executioner_twohand_sword')

	self.card_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.card_num do
		local cur_card = get_character(self.card_name..i)
		character_util.set_active_state(cur_card, 'disabled')

		self.card_list:Add(cur_card)
	end

	self.audience_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.audience_num do
		local cur_audience = get_character(self.audience_name..i)

		if i == 5 then
			character_util.set_anim(cur_audience, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			cur_audience.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_tazza_12'
		else
			character_util.set_anim(cur_audience, { name = 'clap' })
			character_util.set_emotion(cur_audience, { name = 'smile' })
		end

		self.audience_list:Add(cur_audience)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.hogu)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.hogu ~= nil then
		self.hogu.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.hogu = nil
	end

	self.tazza = nil

	self.card_list = nil
	self.audience_list = nil

	self.play_flower_card_routine = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if (event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hogu) then
		if self.defeat_tazza then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_flower_cards, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 섯다 시작, 플레이어 감시
function local_class:see_flower_cards()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.hogu)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	camera_util.move(self.center_camera_pos, 0.5)

	party_util.align_party(vector(91.5, 0, -82.5), 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.tazza)

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.hogu)

	for i = 0, self.audience_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.audience_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.audience_list[i])
	end

	self.play_flower_card_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.play_flower_cards, self))

	-- 패 나눠줄 때까지 대기
	while not self.is_give_card do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 선택지 등장
	local wait_for_branch = true

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("fox_tazza_13"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.tazza
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while wait_for_branch and self.is_give_card do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 시간 초과 시 선택지 그냥 눌러서 없애버림
	if not self.is_give_card then
		-- FIXME: 선택지의 SelectedAnswer를 초기화하려면 CancelCallback을 호출하는 방법 밖에 없음 -> Finish() 호출로도 SelectedAnswer가 초기화되도록 수정해야 함
		if choice_state ~= nil then
			choice_state.CancelCallback = function() end
			CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance:OnClickCirtain()
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 동작 그만!을 선택해서 중단된 경우
	if self.is_give_card then
		stop_coroutine(self.play_flower_card_routine)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.is_fake_card then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_final_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_05', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

		character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'mad' })

		character_util.jump(self.tazza, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'surprise' })

		character_util.set_direction(self.hogu, 'right')
		character_util.jump(self.hogu, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(self.hogu, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'surprise' })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'attack' })

		character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'tired' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_14', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		-- 선택지 등장
		wait_for_branch = true
		selection = 0

		branches:Clear()
		branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		talk_branch_1 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("fox_tazza_15"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		talk_branch_2 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("fox_tazza_16"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				selection = 1
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
		branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

		choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = self.tazza
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if selection == 1 then
			coroutine.yield(self:reset_card_game())
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'cast2' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'mad' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_17', skip = true })

			-- 선택지 등장
			wait_for_branch = true
			selection = 0

			branches:Clear()
			branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

			talk_branch_1 = {
				Text = game_string:GetString("fox_tazza_18"),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
				Callback = function()
					wait_for_branch = false
				end}

			talk_branch_2 = {
				Text = game_string:GetString("fox_tazza_19"),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
				Callback = function()
					wait_for_branch = false
					selection = 1
				end}

			branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
			branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

			choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
			choice_state.Branchs = branches
			choice_state.Talker = self.tazza
			ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

			while wait_for_branch do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

			if selection == 1 then
				coroutine.yield(self:reset_card_game())
			else
				-- 속임수가 아닌 경우
				if not self.is_fake_card then
					coroutine.yield(self:selection_wrong())
				else
					coroutine.yield(self:selection_correct())
				end
			end
		end
	-- 선택 시간이 끝나서 중단된 경우
	else
		-- 이벤트가 끝날 때까지 대기함
		while not self.is_card_game_finished do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		coroutine.yield(self:reset_card_game())
	end

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 타짜와 호구의 섯다 연출
function local_class:play_flower_cards()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_0', skip = true })

	-- 밑장 빼기를 실행할 카드 index를 결정
	local selected_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2)) * 2

	self.is_give_card = true

	-- 화투 분배
	for i = 0, self.card_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'dualgun_attack_left', loop = false, scale = 0.8 })

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.card_list[i], 0, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		character_util.set_position(self.card_list[i], self.tazza.Position + vector(0.3, 0.5, 0))
		character_util.set_active_state(self.card_list[i], 'enabled')

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local target_pos

		if i == 0 then
			target_pos = vector(89.2, 0, -82)
		elseif i == 1 then
			target_pos = vector(90.8, 0, -82)
		elseif i == 2 then
			target_pos = vector(89.2, 0, -82.5)
		elseif i == 3 then
			target_pos = vector(90.8, 0, -82.5)
		end

		local rotate

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			rotate = 90
		else
			rotate = -90
		end

		local duration

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			duration = 0.3
		else
			duration = 0.7
		end

		-- 카드 인덱스 업데이트
		self.cur_card_index = i

		-- 밑장빼기 한 경우 이 시점부터 이의제기하면 성공
		if i == selected_index then
			self.is_fake_card = true

			character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'cheat', loop = true })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.card_list[i], 1, 0)
		character_util.move_to(self.card_list[i], target_pos, duration, nil, false, false)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.tazza)

		wait_for_sec(1.5 - duration)

		-- 밑장빼기 판정 종료
		if i == selected_index then
			self.is_fake_card = false

			character_util.remove_emotion(self.tazza)
		end

		if i == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_1', skip = true })
		end
	end

	self.is_give_card = false

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'doyagao' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_2', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_china_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.tazza)

	-- 호구 화투 공개
	camera_util.resize_to(self.card_camera_size, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.hogu_card_camera_pos, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_evolve_result_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.card_list[1], { name = 'sakura', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

	character_util.set_anim(self.card_list[3], { name = 'sakura', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.hogu, { name = 'clap' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'smile' })

	for i = 0, self.audience_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.center_camera_pos, 0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hogu, { key = 'fox_tazza_3', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_china_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'cross_arm' })

	-- 타짜 화투 공개
	camera_util.resize_to(self.card_camera_size, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.tazza_card_camera_pos, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_evolve_result_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.card_list[0], { name = 'maple', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

	character_util.set_anim(self.card_list[2], { name = 'maple', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_05', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(self.hogu, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'surprise' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'clap' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'awesome' })

	for i = 0, self.audience_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.center_camera_pos, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_4', skip = true })

	-- 타짜가 호구 돈 가져옴
	character_util.set_anim(self.hogu, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'doyagao' })

	for i = 0, self.audience_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_emotion(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_drop_gold_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local gold = CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(self.hogu.Position, self.tazza.Position, 10000)
	gold.ConsumeTarget = self.tazza

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.hogu, { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hogu, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'clap' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'awesome' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_card_game_finished = true
	self.cur_card_index = 0
end

-- 화투 끝나면 카드 정리하고 NPC들, 플래그 초기화
function local_class:reset_card_game()
	-- 플래그 초기화
	self.is_card_game_finished = false
	self.is_give_card = false
	self.is_fake_card = false
	self.cur_card_index = 0

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.hogu)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	-- 카드 정리
	for i = 0, self.card_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.card_list[i], 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(self.card_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.card_list[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_anim(self.card_list[i], { name = 'idle' })
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- NPC 초기화
	character_util.remove_anim(self.tazza)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.tazza)

	character_util.set_direction(self.hogu, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.hogu)

	for i = 0, self.audience_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'clap' })

		if i ~= 4 then
			character_util.set_emotion(self.audience_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

-- 속임수가 아닌 판을 선택해서 실패한 경우 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:selection_wrong()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.tazza, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'attack' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.tazza, { key = 'fox_tazza_20', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(self.tazza, { name = 'doyagao' })

	-- 호구가 자리를 비키고 플레이어와 타짜가 마주보고 앉는다
	local hogu_waypoint = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	hogu_waypoint:Add(self.hogu.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_waypoint(
			self.hogu, hogu_waypoint, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 2, true, true)

	-- 선택하지 않은 카드들 중 필드에 올려진 카드 전부 날려버림
	coroutine.yield(self:remove_cards(false))

	-- 타짜 카드 앞으로 이동

-- 선택된 화투를 제외한 나머지를 제거하는 연출
function local_class:remove_cards(is_correct)
	local kicker

	if is_correct then
		kicker = user_party_leader

		local card_index_list = { 3, 1, 0, 2 }

		for i = 1, #card_index_list do
			local cur_index = card_index_list[i]

			if cur_index ~= self.cur_card_index and
					self.card_list[cur_index].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
				coroutine.yield(self:kick_out_card(cur_index, kicker))
			end
		end
	else
		kicker = self.tazza

		local card_index_list = { 2, 0, 1, 3 }

		for i = 1, #card_index_list do
			local cur_index = card_index_list[i]

			if cur_index ~= self.cur_card_index and
					self.card_list[cur_index].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
				coroutine.yield(self:kick_out_card(cur_index, kicker))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 카드를 발로 차서 날려버리는 연출
function local_class:kick_out_card(index, kicker)
	local cur_card = self.card_list[index]
	local dist = (cur_card.Position - kicker.Position)
	local deviate_pos

	if dist.x > 0 then
		deviate_pos = vector(0.25, 0, 0)

		character_util.move_to_async(kicker, cur_card.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 3, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(kicker, 'right')
	else
		deviate_pos = vector(-0.25, 0, 0)

		character_util.move_to_async(kicker, cur_card.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 3, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(kicker, 'left')
	end

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(kicker, deviate_pos, 0.2, 0.15)
	character_util.set_anim(kicker, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(kicker.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(kicker.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.air_spin(cur_card, { offset = deviate_pos * 4, speed = 1, stay_time = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim(kicker)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

local local_class = newclass('FullmetalAlchemistSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_younger_brother = function() return get_character('fullmetal_younger') end
	self.get_elder_after = function() return get_character('fullmetal_elder_after') end

	self.get_fx_magiccircle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle') end
	self.get_fx_magiccircle_cast = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_Cast') end
	self.get_fx_lasthit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_fx_explosion_boss = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss') end
	self.get_fx_tesla_idle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle') end

	self.star_piece_name = 'fullmetal_star_piece'

	self.is_bros_interactable = false

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadItemGetEvent()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

	self:toggle_bros_interactable(true)

	character_util.set_direction(self.get_elder_brother(), 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.get_elder_brother(), {name = 'eat'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.get_elder_brother(), {name = 'tired'})

	self.get_fx_magiccircle()
	self.get_fx_magiccircle_cast()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_explosion_boss()
	self.get_fx_tesla_idle()

	self:set_quest_icon(self.get_elder_brother(), 'notice')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	self:toggle_bros_interactable(false)

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if table_util.contain_value({ self.get_elder_brother(), self.get_younger_brother() }, e.Target) then
			if not self.is_talked_with_bros then
				self.is_talked_with_bros = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_bros, self)
			elseif self.is_got_stone then
				self:toggle_bros_interactable(false)
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_bros_2, self)
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'fullmetal_bros' and not self.is_bros_mumbling and not self.is_talked_with_bros then
				self.is_bros_mumbling = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bros_mumble, self))
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		if e.Item.ItemId == self.stone_id and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, user_party_leader) then
			self.is_got_stone = true

			if self.is_talked_with_bros then
				self:set_quest_icon(self.get_elder_brother(), 'cleared')
				self:toggle_bros_interactable(true)
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:toggle_bros_interactable(active)
	if active then
		if not self.is_bros_interactable then
			if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_elder_brother()) then
				self.get_elder_brother().Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			end
			if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_younger_brother()) then
				self.get_younger_brother().Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			end
		end
	else
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_elder_brother()) then
			self.get_elder_brother().Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_younger_brother()) then
			self.get_younger_brother().Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.is_bros_interactable = active
end

function local_class:set_quest_icon(fo, type)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(fo)

	if type == 'notice' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(fo)
	elseif type == 'cleared' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(fo)
	elseif type == 'accepted' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:bros_mumble()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_elder_brother(), { key = 'fullmetal_alchemist_1' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_younger_brother(),
			{ key = 'fullmetal_alchemist_2', skip = self.is_talked_with_bros})

end

function local_class:move_up_item(item, duration, height)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = item.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time <= duration do
		local normalized = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration)
		local y = math.sin(normalized * math.pi / 2)
		item.Position = start_pos + y * height * vector(0, 1, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:fade_npcs(list, alpha, duration)
	for _, v in pairs(list) do
		if type_util.is_string(v) then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(get_character(v), alpha, duration)
		else
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(v, alpha, duration)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_near_objects()
	local target_zone = field:GetZone('fullmetal_bros')
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local obj_table = {}

	--- 해당 존에 있는 모든 오브젝트를 순회
	for index = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		--- 개별 오브젝트
		local fo = list[index]
		--- 위치를 교체
		if not string.find(fo.Name, 'floor') and not lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
			if fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
				table.insert(obj_table, fo)
			end
		end
	end

	list:Dispose()

	return obj_table
end

function local_class:set_objects_active_state(obj_table, state)
	for _, v in pairs(obj_table) do
		v.ActiveState = active_state(state)
	end
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastle2BobLinda @

		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name_2 = "futurecastle_part2_1_2"
	self.stage_name_5 = "futurecastle_part2_1_5"

	-- 반지 아이템 이름
	self.ring_name = 'bob_wedding_ring'

	-- 밥 시체 가져오는 함수
	self.get_bob_dead_body = function() return get_character('bob_dead_body') end

	-- 밥 시체 위치 마커
	self.get_bob_dead_body_spawn = function() return field:GetMarker('bob_dead_body_respawn') end

	-- 반지 아이템
	self.ring_object = nil

	-- 상호작용 중인지
	self.is_interact = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_2 and stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_5 then
		return
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		self.ring_object = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = vector(999, 0, 999), itemid = 20261, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.5, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		self.controller:set_target_state(self.get_bob_dead_body(), self.get_bob_dead_body_spawn().position)
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		self.controller:set_linda_state()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_2 and stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_5 then
		return
	end
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		self:dispose_ring_object()
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_bob_dead_body(), self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.is_interact then
		return false
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		local bob_dead_body = self.get_bob_dead_body()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bob_dead_body) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_bob_dead_body, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		local linda_glasstube = self.controller.get_linda_glass_tube()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, linda_glasstube) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_linda_dead_body, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_bob_dead_body()
	self.is_interact = true
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local bob_dead_body = self.get_bob_dead_body()
	party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(bob_dead_body.Position, 'down', 0.8)

	-- 대답이 없다. 평범한 시체인 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_bob_linda_1' })

	-- 품에 수수한 반지를 꼭 쥐고 있다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_bob_linda_2' })

	-- 선택지
	-- 1. 반지를 가져간다. / 2. 그대로 놔둔다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_bob_linda_choose_1_1', 'mercy' }, { 'futurecastle_bob_linda_choose_1_2', 'normal' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 반지 아이템 획득 연출
		self.ring_object.Position = bob_dead_body.Position
		self.ring_object.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.item_get_event(self.ring_name, 'bob_wedding_ring_title', 'bob_wedding_ring_subtitle', 'bob_wedding_ring_desc')

		character_util.remove_relate_event(bob_dead_body, self.controller)
		self.ring_object = nil

		-- 다음 섹션으로
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 밥 시체가 페이드 아웃 된다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bob_dead_body, 0, 1.2)
		wait_for_sec(1.2)
		character_util.set_active_state(bob_dead_body, 'disabled')
	else
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	self.is_interact = false
end

function local_class:interact_linda_dead_body()
	self.is_interact = true
	-- 기괴한 시험관이다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_01')
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_bob_linda_3' })

	-- 안에 누가 있다…
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_bob_linda_4' })
	self.is_interact = false
end

function local_class:dispose_ring_object()
	if self.ring_object == nil then
		return
	end

	self.ring_object:ConsumeComplete()
	self.ring_object = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastle2IceStatueSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastle2IceStatue @
		Comment = 미래 부유성 파트 2 얼음상 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 스타 피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = controller.star_piece_name

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.star_piece_appear_zone_name = 'ice_block_star_piece_appear_zone'
	self.bomb_area_zone_name = 'ice_block_star_piece_bomb_area'

	-- 오브젝트 이름
	self.gunpower_object_name = '[GIMMICK]gunpowderpot'

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_ice_statue = controller.get_ice_statue

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece_effect = controller.get_star_piece_effect

	-- 이펙트
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	self.has_star_piece = false
	self.is_star_piece_appear = false
	self.is_bomb_into_area = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.has_star_piece = star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name)

	if self.has_star_piece then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.event_clear, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent) then
		return self:on_star_piece_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_star_piece_appear then
		return false
	end

	if e.FullEnter then
		local ice_statue = self.get_ice_statue(4)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, ice_statue) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.star_piece_appear_zone_name then
				self:hide_star_piece_hidden_effect()
				return true
			end
		elseif e.FieldObject.Name == self.gunpower_object_name then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.bomb_area_zone_name then
				self.is_bomb_into_area = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_star_piece_appear then
		return false
	end

	local ice_statue = self.get_ice_statue(4)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, ice_statue) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.star_piece_appear_zone_name then
			self:show_star_piece_hidden_effect()
			return true
		end
	elseif e.FieldObject.Name == self.gunpower_object_name then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.bomb_area_zone_name then
			self.is_bomb_into_area = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.is_star_piece_appear then
		return false
	end

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil and not self.is_star_piece_appear and self.is_bomb_into_area and e.FieldObject.Name == self.gunpower_object_name then
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)

		self:hide_star_piece_hidden_effect()
		star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, star_piece.Position)

		self.is_star_piece_appear = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_star_piece_get_event(e)
	if not self.has_star_piece and star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.event_clear, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:show_star_piece_hidden_effect()
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(vector(32, 0, 140))
end

function local_class:hide_star_piece_hidden_effect()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:event_clear()
	self.has_star_piece = true

	-- 클리어 처리
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

return local_class
