local local_class = newclass('FutureCastle2BobLindaSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastle2Ranpang @
		Comment = 란팡이 인베이더들을 암살하는 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_state = {
		-- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		-- 인베이더 대화 이벤트 발생
		see_invader_talk_event = 1,
		-- 란팡이 인베이더 암살
		ranpang_kill_invader = 2,
		-- 란팡이 방 나감
		get_out_ranpang = 3
	}

	-- 현재 진행도
	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name_4 = "futurecastle_part2_1_4"

	-- 메인 스크립트
	self.main_script_name = 'futurecastle_part2_ranpang_'

	-- 란팡
	self.ranpang = nil

	-- 감시 인베이더 리스트
	self.watch_invader_list = nil

	-- 플레이어가 발각되었는지
	self.is_detected = false

	-- 플레이어가 란팡 존에 있어서 다음 이벤트가 진행되는지 확인하는 플래그
	self.is_in_ranpang_zone = false

	-- 기타 상수
	self.watch_invader_num = 2

	-- 타일맵의 캐릭터 이름
	self.ranpang_name = 'ranpang'
	self.watch_invader_name = 'watch_invader_'

	-- 타일맵 마커 이름
	self.respawn_marker_name = 'ranpang_reset'

	-- 타일맵의 이벤트 존 이름
	self.ranpang_event_zone_name = 'ranpang'

	-- 틴트 키
	self.tint_key = 'futurecastle_part2_ranpang'

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 이름
	self.detected_event = 'detected_by_invader_ranpang'

	-- 이펙트 프리셋 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = 'FX_hit'
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name_4 then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.ranpang = get_character(self.ranpang_name)
	self.ranpang.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'dagger')

	self.watch_invader_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.watch_invader_num do
		self.watch_invader_list:Add(get_character(self.watch_invader_name .. i))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.ranpang = nil

	self.watch_invader_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.ranpang_event_zone_name then
		if not self.is_in_ranpang_zone then
			self.is_in_ranpang_zone = true
		end

		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_invader_talk_event then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_invader_talk_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.invader_talk_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.ranpang_event_zone_name then
		if self.is_in_ranpang_zone then
			self.is_in_ranpang_zone = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and self.current_progress < self.progress_state.get_out_ranpang then
		if e.Params.Length == 2 then
			if not self.is_detected and e.Params[0] == self.detected_event then
				self.is_detected = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.player_detected, self, e.Sender))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 인베이더들의 대화 이벤트, 중간에 발각될 경우 중단시켜야 함
function local_class:invader_talk_event()

	-- self.is_detected 가 false인지 확인해주면서 스피치 버블 출력다되도록 기다려주는 함수
	local wait_speech_bubble = function(str)
		local cur_str = game_string:GetString(str)
		local str_length = utf8.len(cur_str)

		local timer = 0.05
		local type_duration = 0.05
		local wait_time = str_length * type_duration + 2.25
		while not self.is_detected do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if timer >= wait_time then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local string_key = self.main_script_name .. 1
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[0], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[1], { name = 'tired' })

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 2
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'cross_arm' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[1])

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 3
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[0], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0])

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 4
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[0], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.ranpang, vector(7, 0, 53))
	character_util.set_anim(self.ranpang, { name = 'dagger_walk' })

	local waypoint = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint:Add(self.ranpang.Position + vector(8.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.ranpang, waypoint, 1.5, false, 'stop',
			'floor', 'right', false, 0, function()
				character_util.set_anim(self.ranpang, { name = 'dagger_idle' })
			end)

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.ranpang.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'attack' })

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 5
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[0], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.ranpang.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0])
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[0])

	character_util.set_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[1], { name = 'doyagao' })

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 6
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[1])

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 7
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[0], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	while not self.is_detected and self.ranpang.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.ranpang, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(self.ranpang, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'push' })
	--character_util.set_emotion(self.ranpang, { name = 'eyelight' })

	local timer = 0
	local duration = 0.1

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.ranpang.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_sword_attack_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.watch_invader_list[0].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.ranpang_kill_invader

	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 0.15)

	if self.is_in_ranpang_zone then
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)
	end

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.watch_invader_list[0])
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.watch_invader_list[0])
	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'embarrassed' })

	timer = 0
	duration = 0.15

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0.15)

	timer = 0
	duration = 0.7

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'embarrassed', scale = 0.5 })

	timer = 0
	duration = 1

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.ranpang.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.watch_invader_list[0], self.watch_invader_list[0].Position)
	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[0], { name = 'seat', loop = false })

	timer = 0
	duration = 0.5

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.ranpang.Position, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	local waypoint_1 = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_1:Add(self.ranpang.Position + vector(-8.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.ranpang, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.ranpang, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_anim(self.ranpang, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.ranpang, waypoint_1, 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	local waypoint_2 = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_2:Add(self.watch_invader_list[0].Position + vector(-8.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.watch_invader_list[0], 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.watch_invader_list[0], waypoint_2, 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	timer = 0
	duration = 2

	while not self.is_detected and timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[1], { name = 'bomb_idle' })

	string_key = self.main_script_name .. 8
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = string_key })
	wait_speech_bubble(string_key)
	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	while not self.is_detected and self.ranpang.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.ranpang, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.watch_invader_list[0], vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.get_out_ranpang

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.invader_end_event, self))
end

-- 인베이더 엔딩 이벤트
function local_class:invader_end_event()
	-- 플레이어가 존에 없을 경우 대기
	while not self.is_in_ranpang_zone do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	camera_util.move_async(vector(17, 0, 53), 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.set_position(self.watch_invader_list[1], self.watch_invader_list[1].Position)

	character_util.set_direction(self.watch_invader_list[1], 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.watch_invader_list[1])

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = self.main_script_name .. 9, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.jump(self.watch_invader_list[1], 1, 0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = self.main_script_name .. 10, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	character_util.set_direction(self.watch_invader_list[1], 'left')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.watch_invader_list[1], { key = self.main_script_name .. 11, skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(self.watch_invader_list[1], self.watch_invader_list[1].Position + vector(-8.5, 0, 0),
			3, nil, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_sword_attack_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 0.15)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0.15)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 플레이어가 순찰 중인 인베이더에게 발각 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:player_detected(detector)
	for i = 0, self.watch_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.watch_invader_list[i])

		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.ranpang_kill_invader or i == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.watch_invader_list[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		else
			character_util.stop(self.watch_invader_list[i])
		end
	end

	character_util.stop(self.ranpang)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.ranpang, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.ranpang)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.ranpang)

	local siren = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_siren_loop_01', loop = true })

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	field:Tint("alert_max", unity_class.color(1, 0, 0), 0.25)

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = "embarrassed", loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "damaged", loop = true })

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.jump(user_party[i], 0.3, 0.2)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.ranpang_kill_invader or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(detector, self.watch_invader_list[1]) then
		character_util.set_anim(detector, { name = "attack" })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(detector,
				{ key = "futurecastle_2_detected", skip = "true", bubble_type = "shout" })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drown_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.5, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	siren:FadeOut(0.5)

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key)
	field:RemoveTint("alert_max", 0)

	local respawn_marker = field:GetMarker(self.respawn_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, respawn_marker.position)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	local princess = get_character('princess')

	character_util.set_position(princess, respawn_marker.position +
			0.7 * CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(respawn_marker.direction)))
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	-- 란팡 초기화
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.ranpang, 'none')
	character_util.set_position(self.ranpang, vector(999, 0, 999))

	for i = 0, self.watch_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		if i == 0 and self.current_progress == self.progress_state.ranpang_kill_invader then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.watch_invader_list[i], 'none')
			character_util.set_direction(self.watch_invader_list[i], 'right')
			self.watch_invader_list[i].Position = self.watch_invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
			self.watch_invader_list[i].FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
					self.watch_invader_list[i], nil, 0, self.detected_event, 4, 120)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(self.watch_invader_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.watch_invader_list[i])
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(detector)
	character_util.remove_emotion(detector)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_detected = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleAkayukiSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.murasame_id = 20209

	self.get_akayuki = function() return get_character('akayuki') end

	self.get_fx_object_twinkle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle') end

	self.get_fx_akaoni_slashline = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_akaoni_slashline') end
	self.get_fx_akaoni_clone = function(num)
		local add_table = {'a', 'b', 'c'}
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_akaoni_clone_' .. add_table[num])
	end
	self.get_fx_akaoni_shadow = function(num)
		local add_table = {'a', 'b', 'c'}
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_akaoni_shadow_' .. add_table[num])
	end
	self.get_fx_akaoni_trans = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_akaoni_trans') end

	self.get_fx_turret_atk_red = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_turret_debuff_atk_red') end

	self.has_murasame = false

	self.build_up_started = false

	self.star_piece_name = 'akayuki_star_piece'

	self.current_target_swipe = nil
	self.current_swipe = nil
	self.is_playing_qte = false

	self.touch_event_types = {
		up = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp,
		right = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight,
		down = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown,
		left = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft,
	}

	self.is_played_dodge_once = false

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'futurecastle_1_4'

	-- 커스텀 스테이트 이름
	self.custom_state_key = 'got_murasame'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key) == 1
			or user:HasItem(self.murasame_id) then
		self.has_murasame = true
	end

	self.get_fx_explosion_boss()
	self.get_fx_object_twinkle()
	self.get_fx_akaoni_slashline()
	self.get_fx_akaoni_trans()
	self.get_fx_turret_atk_red()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		self.get_fx_akaoni_clone(i)
		self.get_fx_akaoni_shadow(i)
	end

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_akayuki(), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_statue(), self.controller)
	for i = 3, 5 do
		character_util.add_listener(self.get_soldier(i), self.controller)
	end

	self.get_akayuki().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	self.get_akayuki().Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	self.get_soldier(1).Position = vector(129, 0, -3.5)
	self.get_soldier(2).Position = vector(125.5, 0, -9)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_akayuki(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_statue(), self.controller)
	for i = 3, 5 do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_soldier(i), self.controller)
	end

	self.touch_event_types = nil
	self.current_target_swipe = nil
	self.current_swipe = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'akayuki_build_up' and self.build_up_started == false then
			self.build_up_started = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.build_up_routine, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_statue()) then
			if self.has_murasame then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.waking_up_akayuki, self)
				return true
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.salute_to_statue, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_akayuki()) then
			if not self.is_played_dodge_once then
				self.is_played_dodge_once = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_talk_with_akayuki, self, true)
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_talk_with_akayuki, self, false)
			end
			return true
		else
			for i = 3, 5 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_soldier(i)) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_salute, self, i))
					return true
				end
			end
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if self.is_playing_qte then
			for _, v in pairs(self.touch_event_types) do
				if e.TouchEventType == v then
					self.current_swipe = v
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:build_up_routine()
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)

	-- 아카유키 빌드업 방에 들어가면 병사들이 숨겨진 통로에서 나오는 모습이 보인다.
	-- 통로에서 나온 병사 2는 밖에서 기다리고 있는 병사2 에게 다가가 대사를 친다.

	soldier_2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(soldier_2, {waypoints = {
		vector(125.5, 0, -9),
		vector(125.5, 0, soldier_1.Position.z),
		soldier_1.Position + vector(-1.3, 0, 0)
	}, speed = 4, play_sfx = true})

	soldier_2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.look_at(soldier_2, soldier_1)
	character_util.look_at(soldier_1, soldier_2)

	-- 볼 일은 다 끝난건거?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, {key = 'futurecastle_akayuki_1', skip = false})

	character_util.nod_twice(soldier_2)

	-- 응. 떠나기 전에 위대한 전사의 석상에 경의를 표하고 왔지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_2, {key = 'futurecastle_akayuki_2', skip = false})

	soldier_1.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_akayuki_1'
	soldier_2.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_akayuki_2'
end

function local_class:soldier_salute(index)
	local soldier = self.get_soldier(index)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(soldier, self.controller)

	character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'salute', loop = false})

	local is_left = soldier.Position.x < 125.5
	local bubble_direction = is_left and 'rt' or 'lt'

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'futurecastle_akayuki_' .. index, skip = false, bubble_direction = bubble_direction})
	character_util.remove_anim(soldier)

	character_util.add_listener(soldier, self.controller)
end

function local_class:salute_to_statue()
	local statue = self.get_statue()

	for i = 3, 5 do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_soldier(i))
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(statue, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	--무라사메가 없을 경우, 주인공 salute 포즈
	--1~ 1.5초 정도 포즈 보여준 뒤, 나레이션박스가 출력된다.

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'salute', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--하지만 아무 일도 일어나지 않았다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'futurecastle_akayuki_18'})

	party_util.remove_animation()
end

function local_class:waking_up_akayuki()
	local akayuki = self.get_akayuki()
	local statue = self.get_statue()

	for i = 3, 5 do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_soldier(i))
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(statue, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	--무라사메가 있을 경우, 석상에 인터랙트 시
	--무라사메가 주인공 품에서 튀어 나와 아카유키 석상 앞으로 날아간다.

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to(3.7, 2.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.06, 0.5)
	local start_pos = user_party.Leader.Bounds.center
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_lights_01')
	local twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(start_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	character_util.shake(statue, 0.06, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--무라사메가 석상과 공명하기 시작한다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'futurecastle_akayuki_6'})

	--무라사메를 돌려주시겠습니까?
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'SetNarration',
			game_string:GetString('futurecastle_akayuki_6_1'), 0, 1.0, false)

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'futurecastle_akayuki_6_2', 'mercy'},
		{'futurecastle_akayuki_6_3', 'brutal'},
	})

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'HideAnimation')

	if result == 2 then
		twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local end_pos = statue.Position + vector(0, 1.3, 0)

	local murasame = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.murasame_id, pos = start_pos,
		notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	local start_scale = 0.3
	local target_scale = 1

	murasame.SpriteTransform.localScale = start_scale * unity_class.vector3.one
	murasame.ShadowTransform.localScale = start_scale * unity_class.vector3.one

	local angle = 42 - 90
	murasame.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
			unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))
	murasame.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
			unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))

	local move_duration = 0.4
	local spin_duration = 0.7

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)

	for i = 3, 5 do
		character_util.set_emotion(self.get_soldier(i), {name = 'surprise'})
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(move_duration)
	camera_util.move(end_pos, move_duration)

	local time_passed = 0

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_sword_attack_01')
	while time_passed < move_duration or time_passed < spin_duration do

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed < move_duration then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_duration)
			local progress_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local progress_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, target_scale, progress)

			murasame.Position = progress_pos
			twinkle_effect.transform.localPosition = progress_pos

			murasame.SpriteTransform.localScale = progress_scale * unity_class.vector3.one
			murasame.ShadowTransform.localScale = progress_scale * unity_class.vector3.one
		end

		if time_passed < spin_duration then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / spin_duration)
			local progress_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(angle, angle + 360 * 3, progress)

			murasame.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)

function local_class:play_qte(direction, duration)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(direction)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	self.current_swipe = nil
	self.is_playing_qte = true

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local success = false

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration or duration < 0 do
		if self.current_swipe == self.touch_event_types[direction] then
			success = true
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_playing_qte = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	return success
end

function local_class:akayuki_attack_to_pos(target_pos, callback)
	local akayuki = self.get_akayuki()
	local scale_offset = 1.5
	local center_offset = 0.35
	local slash_term = 0.08
	local radius = 1

	self.get_fx_akaoni_trans():Instantiate(akayuki.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, slash_term * 0.75)

	local duration = slash_term * 3
	local speed = radius * 2 * scale_offset / duration

	local dif = target_pos - akayuki.Position
	local angle_vector = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dif) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

	local init_pos = target_pos - radius * scale_offset * dif

	local rand_fx_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)

	local clone = self.get_fx_akaoni_clone(rand_fx_index):Instantiate(init_pos)
	local shadow = self.get_fx_akaoni_shadow(rand_fx_index):Instantiate(init_pos)

	local slash = self.get_fx_akaoni_slashline():Instantiate(init_pos, angle_vector, nil)

	if dif.x < 0 then
		clone.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
		shadow.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	local min_dist = dif.magnitude

	while time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local progress_pos = akayuki.Position + progress * duration * dif * speed

		local dist_to_target = (progress_pos - target_pos).magnitude
		if min_dist > dist_to_target then
			min_dist = dist_to_target
		elseif callback ~= nil then
			callback()
		end

		clone.transform.position = progress_pos
		shadow.transform.position = progress_pos
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(android.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		android.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent) then
		self:on_tesla_on_off_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(android, e.Target) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.android_check_message, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_tesla_on_off_event(e)
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, pushable) then
		if e.IsTurningOn and self.tesla_fx == nil then
			self.tesla_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle'):Instantiate(
					android.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, android.Transform)
		elseif not e.IsTurningOn and self.tesla_fx ~= nil and self.connected_count == 0 then
			self.tesla_fx:Dispose()
			self.tesla_fx = nil
		end

	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'android_teslacoil_zone') then
		self.player_in_zone = true
		if self.state == -2 then
			self.state = -1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_push_routine, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party_leader, 'android_teslacoil_zone') then
		self.player_in_zone = false
	end
end

function local_class:android_push_routine()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()

	android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	pushable.Position = android.Position
	local prev_pos = pushable.Position

	while true do
		self.connected_count = 0
		--pushable.Position = vector(pushable.Position.x, -0.6, pushable.Position.z)
		prev_pos = pushable.Position
		android.Position = vector(pushable.Position.x, 0, pushable.Position.z)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.ElectrocutableManager:IsConnectionValid(pushable, self.teslas[i]) and
					(pushable.Position - self.teslas[i].Position):GetX0z().magnitude <= 5.5 then
				self.connected_count = self.connected_count + 1
				if self.tesla_fx == nil then
					self.tesla_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle'):Instantiate(
							android.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, android.Transform)
				end
			end
		end
		if self.connected_count == 3 and self.player_in_zone then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if prev_pos ~= pushable.Position and self.push_sfx == nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pushable_sfx_routine, self, pushable))
		end
	end


	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tesla_effect_routine, self, nil, android, 1)

	character_util.move_to(pushable, vector(8.5, 0, 20), 0, nil)
	pushable.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	--pushable.Position = vector(8.5, 0, 20)
	android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

end

function local_class:pushable_sfx_routine(fo)
	local prev_pos = fo.Position
	self.push_sfx =	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01', type_priority = 'event' })
	repeat
		prev_pos = fo.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	until fo.Position == prev_pos
	self.push_sfx:Stop()
	self.push_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:tesla_effect_routine(from, to, duration)
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	local timer = 0

	local ray_fx = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local ray_effect = CS.Oak.TeslaRayEffect.GetOrCreate(android, self.teslas[i])
		ray_effect:SetRay(android.Position + unity_class.vector3.up, self.teslas[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.up, true)
		table.insert(ray_fx, ray_effect)
	end

	if self.tesla_fx ~= nil then
		self.tesla_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.tesla_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle'):Instantiate(android.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.shake(android, 0.02, 2)
	camera_util.move_async(to.Position, 1)
	character_util.set_emotion(android, {name = 'idle'})

	-- 전원 공급 확인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_2', skip = true })

	-- 충전을 시작합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matching_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_2_1', skip = true })

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end


	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create('android_teslacoil_1'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create('android_teslacoil_2'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create('android_teslacoil_3'))
	character_util.remove_emotion(android)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(android, {name = 'sweeper_cleaning'},{name = 'idle'})
	android.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	self.state = 0

	for i = 1, 3 do
		CS.Oak.TeslaRayEffect.Return(ray_fx[i])
	end
	ray_fx = {}

	if self.tesla_fx ~= nil then
		self.tesla_fx:Dispose()
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_04')
	wait_for_sec(1.05)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_04')
	-- 시스템 재부팅 완료.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_3', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	android.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:android_check_message()
	if self.state == -1 then
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_battery_out' })
		return
	end
	local android = self.controller:get_android()

	party_util.align_party(android.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_1_3', skip = true })


	local branches = {
		{ 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_branch_yes' },
		{ 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_branch_no' },
	}

	repeat
		if self.state == 0 then
			-- 3건의 미확인 우편이 있습니다. 확인하시겠습니까?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_5', skip = true })
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_6', skip = true })

				-- 발신자: 로레인
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_7' })

				-- 대체 어디간 거예요?
				-- 공주님이 얼마나 찾는지 아세요?
				-- 메시지 보면 어서 답장하세요.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_8' })

				self.state = self.state + 1
			else
				break
			end
		elseif self.state == 1 then
			-- 2건의 미확인 우편이 있습니다. 확인하시겠습니까?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_9', skip = true })
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)
			if result == 1 then
				-- 메시지를 재생합니다.
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_6', skip = true })

				-- 발신자: 밥
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_10' })

				-- 신참, 잘 지내지?
				-- 모두 사라졌다고 하지만, 난 네가 살아있다 믿고 있어.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_11' })

				-- 공주님이 많이 힘들어하셔.
				-- 안타깝지만 나와 린다로는 역부족이야.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_12' })

				-- 네가 돌아와준다면 참 기쁠 것 같아.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_13' })

				self.state = self.state + 1
			else
				break
			end
		elseif self.state == 2 then
			-- 1건의 미확인 우편이 있습니다. 확인하시겠습니까?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_14', skip = true })
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)
			if result == 1 then
				-- 메시지를 재생합니다.
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_6', skip = true })

				-- 발신자: 유즈
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_15' })

				-- 파트너, 안녕?
				-- 오늘 네가 나오는 꿈을 꿨어.
				-- 네가 돌아와서 모든 문제들을 해결해버리는 거 있지?
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_16' })

				-- 하지만… 넌 이제 없잖아.
				-- 그럼 내가 대신 사람들에게 행복을 나눠줘야겠지?
				-- 네가 그랬던 것처럼 말이야.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_17' })

				-- 파트너… 보고 싶어.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_18' })

				self.state = self.state + 1
			else
				break
			end
		elseif self.state == 3 then
			-- 남은 메시지가 없습니다.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_19', skip = true })

			party_util.remove_emotion()

			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
			break
		end
	until false
end


return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(android, e.Target) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.android_talk_repeat, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(pushable, e.FieldObject) and e.Zone.Name == 'android_star_piece_zone' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_04')
		self.in_star_zone = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if not e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(android, e.FieldObject) and e.Zone.Name == 'android_star_piece_zone' then
		self.in_star_zone = false
		self.zone_timer = 0
	end
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party_leader, e.FieldObject) and e.Zone.Name == 'android_teslacoil_zone' then
		if self.android_pushable then
			pushable.Position = field:GetMarker('android_reset_marker').position
		end
	end
end

function local_class:android_talk_repeat()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()

	party_util.align_party(android.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	if self.state == 0 then
		-- 어떻게 또 저를 이용해먹을 수 있을까 궁리하고 계신가요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_20', skip = true })
		self.state = self.state + 1
	elseif self.state == 1 then
		-- 당신만의 욕심을 충족시키 위해서 말이죠
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_21', skip = true })
		self.state = self.state + 1
	elseif self.state == 2 then
		-- 좋아요, 맘대로 하세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_22', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.controller)

		pushable.ActiveState = active_state('infield')
		pushable.Position = android.Position
		android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_sweep_routine, self))

	end
end

function local_class:android_sweep_routine()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	local pushable = self.controller.get_pushable()

	local prev_pos = pushable.Position

	while true do
		prev_pos = pushable.Position
		android.Position = pushable.Position
		if self.in_star_zone then
			self.zone_timer = self.zone_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		if self.zone_timer > 3 then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if prev_pos ~= pushable.Position and self.push_sfx == nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pushable_sfx_routine, self, pushable))
		end
	end

	pushable.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
	pushable.Position = vector(8.5, 0, 20)
	android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece.Position = android.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(android.Position))


	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android, { key = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_23', skip = true })
	android.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_android_teslacoil_23'

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:pushable_sfx_routine(fo)
	local prev_pos = fo.Position
	self.push_sfx =	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_01', type_priority = 'event' })
	repeat
		prev_pos = fo.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	until fo.Position == prev_pos
	self.push_sfx:Stop()
	self.push_sfx = nil
end

return local_class

		'futurecastle_aoba_28_2', -- 무사 아카유키님이 동상이 되어버렸어... 깨어나셔야 할텐데...

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PurpleCoinGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.lined_npcs = nil
	self.progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

end

function local_class:got_all_starpiece_n_purplecoin()
	local tilemap = field.Tilemap
	local owned_purple_coin = stage_progress[CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.PurpleCoin].Count
	local total_purple_coin = tilemap:GetNames(CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.PurpleCoin).Count - 1;
	local owned_starpiece = stage_progress[CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.StarPiece].Count
	local total_starpiece = tilemap:GetNames(CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.StarPiece).Count - 1;

	-- 스타피스는 아오바 것을 제외하고 다 먹었는지 체크
	return owned_purple_coin >= total_purple_coin and owned_starpiece >= total_starpiece - 1
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_aoba()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.interactable or self.current_progress == self.progress.interacting  then

			-- 6번 이상 말걸었으면 아오바가 소리지르는 연출 실행
			if self.current_talk_count + 1 >= 6 then
				self.current_progress = self.progress.shout
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.aoba_shout, self)
			else
				self.current_progress = self.progress.interacting
				self.current_talk_count = self.current_talk_count + 1
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_aoba, self)
			end

		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.delight_scene then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.clear
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rest_aoba, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:satisfy_ending_condition()
	return self.current_progress == self.progress.shout and
			not field:IsInCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, 'aoba_grid') and self:got_all_starpiece_n_purplecoin()
end

function local_class:check_ending_condition(_)
	if self:satisfy_ending_condition() then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.set_ending
		self:setup_ending()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress.none and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'aoba_entry_event') then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.entry_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.entry_event, self))
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.set_ending and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'aoba_delight') then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.delight_scene
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.delight_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

	elseif idx == 2 then
		return 'futurecastle_aoba_1' -- 아. 오랜만이네.
	elseif idx == 3 then
		return 'futurecastle_aoba_2' -- 지금 좀 바빠.
	elseif idx == 4 then
		return 'futurecastle_aoba_3' -- 이따 하면 안 될까?

function local_class:aoba_shout()
	local aoba = self.get_aoba()

	local align_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	party_util.align_to_target(aoba, direction_util.get_opposite(align_dir))

	-- 그만!! 그만!!! 그만!!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })
	character_util.look_at(aoba, user_party.Leader)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	aoba:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	aoba:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(aoba, '01_swing_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(aoba, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_4', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	aoba:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 넌 여기 이 사람들이 줄 선 모습이 안 보여?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_5', skip = true })

	-- 난 이 사람들의 목숨이 걸린 문제들을 해결하느라 바쁘다고!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_6', skip = true })
	aoba:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 넌 10년 동안 안 보이더니, 그동안 다른 사람 방해하고 괴롭히는 것만 훈련했냐?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_7', skip = true })

	-- 바쁜 건 알지만 너도 좀 쉬어야 해.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_aoba_8', 'mercy' } }, 'release')

	aoba:RemoveEmotion()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_9', skip = true })

	aoba.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 여기 이곳의 모든 문제가 해결될 때까지 쉴 수 없어. 내가 쉬면...

	aoba:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_10', skip = true })

	-- 내가 쉬어버리면...

	aoba:Shake(0.05, 999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_11', skip = true })

	-- 이 사람들은... 누가...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_12', skip = true })
	aoba:CancelShake()

	-- ...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'silent_comma', skip = true })

	-- ...이제 비켜줘.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aoba, { key = 'futurecastle_aoba_12_1', skip = true })

	-- -- 이곳의 모든 문제가 해결될 때까지 쉴 수 없어...
	aoba.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	aoba:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(aoba, self.controller)
	aoba.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_aoba_13'
end

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleArcadeMachineSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleArcadeMachine @
		Comment = 미래 부유성 파트2 아케이드 머신 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, _)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.arcade_machine_coin_event = 'arcade_machine_coin_break_event'
	self.get_coin = false

	self.get_coin_box = function() return get_field_object('coin_box') end
	self.get_arcade_machine = function() return get_field_object('arcade_machine') end
	self.get_arcade_knihgt = function() return get_character('arcade_knight') end
	self.arcade_knight_check = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_reset_object_big',
			'FX_levelup_new'
	)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params[0] == self.arcade_machine_coin_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_coin_item, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_arcade_machine()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_arcade_machine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject ~= self.get_arcade_knihgt() or not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if zone_name == 'arcade_end' and not self.arcade_knight_check then
		self.arcade_knight_check = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.arcade_knight_clear, self)
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.arcade_knight_clear, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_arcade_knihgt()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.arcade_knight_dead, self))
		return true
	end
end
--endregion

-- 코인 박스 부술 경우 코인 드랍
function local_class:drop_coin_item()
	local coin_box = self.get_coin_box()

	local coin = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = coin_box.Position, target = coin_box.Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			  itemid = 20007, notforinven = true, bounce = true, spr_scale = 2 })
	coin:SetSortingLayer(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	coin.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

	-- 코인 획득 처리
	self.get_coin = true
end

-- 아케이드 머신에 인터렉트 했을 때
function local_class:interact_arcade_machine()
	local arcade_machine = self.get_arcade_machine()
	local arcade_knight = self.get_arcade_knihgt()

	-- 코인이 없을 경우
	if not self.get_coin then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(arcade_machine, {key = "future_2_arcade_machine_1", type_speed = 0 })
		return
	end

	-- 코인을 가지고 있을 경우
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	party_util.align_party(arcade_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), 'down', 0.7, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(arcade_machine, {key = "future_2_arcade_machine_1", type_speed = 0 , skip = true})

	-- 코인을 넣는다 / 넣지 않는다.
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'future_2_arcade_machine_3', 'mercy' }, { 'future_2_arcade_machine_4', 'normal' } })

	if choose == 1 then
		-- 넣는다 이벤트 세팅
		self.get_coin = false
		-- 이후 아래 이벤트 진행되도록 함
	else
		-- 넣지 않는다 세팅
		-- 멈춤이벤 풀어주고 리턴
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	local appear_pos = arcade_machine.Position + vector(-1,0,0)

	character_util.set_direction(arcade_knight, 'down')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.get_arcade_knihgt(), 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')

	-- 뉴 챌린저 등장
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(arcade_machine, {key = "future_2_arcade_machine_2", type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'ct', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	character_util.set_position(arcade_knight, appear_pos)

	time_util.mod('arcade_machine', 0.65)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_levelup_new'):Instantiate(appear_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equip_finish_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_no_del_stage_entry_01')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(arcade_knight, 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	time_util.unmod('arcade_machine')

	character_util.set_emotion(arcade_knight, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(arcade_knight, {name = 'salute', loop = false})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(arcade_knight)

	character_util.move_to_async(arcade_knight, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.35, nil, true, true)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(arcade_knight, user_party, false)
end

-- 아케이드 기사 도착 시
function local_class:arcade_knight_clear()
	local arcade_knight = self.get_arcade_knihgt()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(arcade_knight)

	character_util.move_to(arcade_knight, vector(arcade_knight.Position.x + 1, 0, -1), 0.3, nil, true, true)
	party_util.align_to_target(arcade_knight.Position + vector(1,0,0), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(arcade_knight, {key = "future_2_arcade_machine_5"})

	character_util.set_direction(arcade_knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(arcade_knight, { name = 'salute', loop = false, speed = 0.7 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local appear_pos = arcade_knight.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object_big'):Instantiate(appear_pos)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(arcade_knight, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(arcade_knight, vector(999,0,999))

	-- 스타피스 등장
	local star_piece = get_field_object('arcade_star_piece')
	star_piece.Position = appear_pos
	message_system:SendSync(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(appear_pos))
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

-- 아케이드 기사 죽을 시
function local_class:arcade_knight_dead()
	local arcade_knight = self.get_arcade_knihgt()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(arcade_knight)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local appear_pos = arcade_knight.Position
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object_big'):Instantiate(appear_pos)
	character_util.move_to_async(arcade_knight, vector(999,0,999))
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleBrokenAndroidSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.star_piece_name = 'futurecastle_broken_android_starpiece'
	self.talked_with_android_flag = false

	self.get_android = controller.get_android
	self.get_waypoint = function() return get_field_object('waypoint_1') end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name) end

	self.is_fall_andriod = false
	self.is_head_banging = false
	self.is_interact_android = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent), 'on_waypoint_opened_event')

	local waypoint = self.get_waypoint()
	local android = self.get_android()
	android.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(waypoint.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(android, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour:HideHiddenEffect()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent), 'on_waypoint_opened_event')

	local android = self.get_android()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local android = self.controller:get_android()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(android, e.Target) then
		if self:dumble_all_gone() then
			android.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
			android.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.all_dumbles_removed, self)
		else
			if not self.is_interact_android then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_android, self)
			else
				-- 잡초..제거....청소...청소...
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android, { key = 'futurecastle_broken_android_3' })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_waypoint_opened_event(e)
	local waypoint = self.get_waypoint()
	local waypoint_center = waypoint.Bounds.center - vector(0, waypoint.Bounds.size.y / 2, 0)
	local waypoint_position = waypoint_center - vector(0, 0, 2)

	if not self.is_fall_andriod and e.WaypointPosition == waypoint_position then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_head_fall, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 웨이포인트를 가동시키면, 중앙에 있던 안드로이드 머리가 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:android_head_fall()
	local android = self.get_android()

	character_util.shake(android, 0.04, 2)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_to_async(android, android.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), 0.5, nil, false, false)

	character_util.spine_rotate(android, -110, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(android, android.Position + vector(0.2 + 0.1, 1, 0.2 + 0.5), 0.5, nil, false, false)

	local bound_callback = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crystal_01', parent = android, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', parent = android, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 16, android.Position.y, 3, bound_callback)

	local move_duration = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_position = android.Position
	local end_position = vector(100, 0, 3)

	character_util.spine_rotate(android, -335, move_duration)

	while time_passed < move_duration do
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, move_duration)
		android.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		if free_fall:IsDone() then
			y = 0
		end
		character_util.set_position(android, vector_util.get_x0z(android.Position, y), true)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_position(android, end_position, false)

	android.Position = end_position
	character_util.set_position(android, end_position, false)
	character_util.add_listener(android, self.controller)

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour:ShowHiddenEffect()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(android, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	self.is_fall_andriod = true
end

-- 안드로이드 머리가 좌우로 갸웃갸웃 거리게
function local_class:android_head_banging()
	local android = self.get_android()

	while self.is_head_banging do
		character_util.spine_rotate(android, -365, 0.25)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		character_util.spine_rotate(android, -335, 0.25)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end
end

-- 안드로이드 머리에 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_android()
	local android = self.get_android()

	self.is_interact_android = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_broadcast_01' })

	self.is_head_banging = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_head_banging, self))

	-- ....하늘 정원…. 청소….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_broken_android_1', skip = true })

	-- 임무…. 속행…. 해야….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_broken_android_2', skip = true })

	-- 잡초…. 제거……. 청소…. 청소….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_broken_android_3', skip = true })

	self.is_head_banging = false
end

function local_class:dumble_all_gone()
	local dumbles = self.controller:get_dumble()

	for i,_ in pairs(dumbles) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(i.ActiveState, CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled) then return false end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:all_dumbles_removed()
	local android = self.controller:get_android()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_glitch_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	character_util.shake(android, 0.1, 4)

	self.is_head_banging = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.android_head_banging, self))

	-- 하늘 정원…. 잡초 제거…. 확인….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = 'futurecastle_broken_android_4', skip = true })

	-- 임무 완료..

function local_class:android_activate_self_destruction()
    local duration = 1.2
    local timer = 0
    local android = self.get_builder_android()
    character_util.shake(android, 0.08, 0.2)
    android.SpineController:PulseFadeColor(unity_class.color.red, 0.7, 3, duration)

    local beep = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_bomb_count_fast_01',
                                              loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
    local shake = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_bomb_holdup_fail_01',
                                         loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

    while timer < duration do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    beep:Stop()
    shake:Stop()

    -- 반경 2의 범위만큼 폭발 데미지를 부여

    local meteor_pool = self.get_meteor_effect()
    local meteor_effect = meteor_pool:Instantiate(vector(20,0,42.5))
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_03')
    meteor_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero * 0.3
    local knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotKnockBackForce", 1.2)
    local hittable_targets = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(android.transform.position, 2)
    for i = 0, hittable_targets.Count - 1 do
        local target = hittable_targets[i]
        local knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(
                vector_util.to_direction(target.Position - android.Position))
        local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
        damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
        damage_info.sender = android
        damage_info.target = target
        damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.33)
        damage_info.noCritical = true
        damage_info.notMortal = true
        damage_info.shielded = 0
        damage_info.barriered = false
        damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
        damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
        damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * knockback_force
        command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
    end

    character_util.set_position(android, vector(999, 0, 999))

    wait_for_sec(3.5)

    yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

    hittable_targets:Dispose()
    meteor_effect:Dispose()
end


return local_class

    stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(android)

    character_util.move_to(android, vector(38, 0, 161), 1, nil,
            true, true)
    party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(vector(38, 0, 161),
            'down', 1,'arc')

    character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, android)
    character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')

    -- 안드로이드 - 박수 & smile
    -- 안드로이드 : 정말 고마워요 마스터.

    character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'smile' })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.bunny_script .. 4, skip = true })

    -- 안드로이드 : 잠시만 기다려 주세요. 비장의 특식을 준비해올게요..!
    character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'cross_arm' })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.bunny_script .. 5, skip = true })

    character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
    character_util.set_direction(get_character('princess'), 'right')

    character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'sing' })
    local waypoint_to_kitchen = {
        vector(42.5, 0, android.Position.z),
        vector(42.5, 0, 167)
    }


    -- (fo, waypointlist, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx,
    --                                        animtimescale, callback)
    character_util.remove_emotion(android)
    character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'walk' })
    character_util.move_waypoint(android, waypoint_to_kitchen, 2, true)
    --character_util.move_to(android, vector(43, 0, 162), 2, nil,
    --        true, true)

    wait_for_sec(4.5)

    -- 페이드 아웃 & 인 된 후 테이블위에 있는 음식들을 보여주는 연출
    local temp = function(controller, duration, wait_for)
        screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

        -- 파티 위치 세팅
        party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(vector(43, 0, 161), 'down', 0)

        -- 음식 오브젝트들 세팅
        controller:generate_foods()

        -- 버니걸 안드로이드 세팅
        local android = get_character(self.android_name)
        character_util.set_position(android, vector(43, 0, 162))
        character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
        character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'bunny_idle' })
        character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'smile' })

        for i = 1, #self.controller.foods do
            self.controller.foods[i].SpriteTransform.position = vector(self.controller.foods[i].Position.x,
                                                 1,
                                                        self.controller.foods[i].Position.z)
        end

        wait_for_sec(wait_for)

        screen_util.fade_in_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
    end

    local fade_duration = 0.5
    yield_return(temp(self.controller, fade_duration, 1))

    -- 안드로이드 : 준비됐어요, 마스터.
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.bunny_script .. 6, skip = true })

    -- 안드로이드 : 제 음식으로 행복해지셨으면 좋겠어요.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android, { key = self.bunny_script .. 21, skip = true })
    character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'doyagao' })

    -- 섹션 진행
    yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

    self.food_interactable = nil

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('microwave_interactable')) then

		return
	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_start_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		local specimen_1 = self.get_specimen(1)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.test_progress and e.Zone.Name == self.research_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_room, self)
				return true
			elseif not self.is_saw_invader_talk_1 and e.Zone.Name == self.invader_talk_zone_name .. 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.invader_talk_1, self))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_saw_invader_talk_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.invader_talk_zone_name .. 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.invader_talk_2, self))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_saw_invader_talk_3 and e.Zone.Name == self.invader_talk_zone_name .. 3 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.invader_talk_3, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.feed_the_super_invader and e.Zone.Name == self.hole_feed_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.feed_the_super_invader, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.coco_invader_talk and e.Zone.Name == self.coco_invader_talk_setting_zone_name then
				self:coco_invader_talk_setting()
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.coco_invader_talk and e.Zone.Name == self.coco_invader_talk_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.coco_invader_talk, self)
				return true
			elseif not self.is_battle_hole_feed_battle and e.Zone.Name == self.hole_feed_battle_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hole_feed_battle_setting, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.meet_coco_setting_zone_name then
				self:meet_coco_setting()
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.meet_coco and e.Zone.Name == self.meet_coco_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_coco, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.test_complete and e.Zone.Name == self.throw_to_hole_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_to_hole, self, e.FieldObject))
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, specimen_1) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.test_complete and e.Zone.Name == self.throw_to_hole_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_to_hole, self, e.FieldObject))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.test_complete and not self.is_leave_test_zone and e.Zone.Name == self.test_zone_name then
				self.is_leave_test_zone = true
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local drop_player_weapon = self.get_drop_player_weapon()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, drop_player_weapon) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_player_weapon, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.hole_feed_battle_group_name then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. i, true))
		end
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.coco_battle_group_name then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.defeat_coco, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'detected_invader' then
		self.is_detected = true

		local detected_invader_name = e:GetParamAt(1)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local invader = self.get_invader_guard(i)
			if invader.Name ~= detected_invader_name then
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader)
			end
		end
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'invader_rest_room_guard' then
		self.is_detected = true

		local detected_invader_name = e:GetParamAt(1)
		for i = 9, 12 do
			local invader = self.get_invader_guard(i)
			if invader.Name ~= detected_invader_name then
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader)
			end
		end
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'reset' then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'detected_invader' then
			self.is_detected = false
			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'invader_rest_room_guard' then
			self.is_detected = false
			return true
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'hole_feed_detect' then
		self.is_battle_hole_feed_battle = true

		for i = 1, 2 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. i))
		end

		local feed_invader = self.get_feed_invader(1)
		local super_invader = self.get_super_invader(1)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(feed_invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(super_invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if not self.is_battle_hole_feed_battle then
		self.is_battle_hole_feed_battle = true

		local feed_invader = self.get_feed_invader(1)
		local super_invader = self.get_super_invader(1)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(feed_invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(super_invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		return true
	end

	return false
end
