-- 신체검사
function local_class:physical_test()
	local researcher_1 = self.get_researcher(1)

	-- 연구원1 - 연구원이 말하는 방향을 바라봐야 한다.
	-- 시험
	local is_complete = false

	while not is_complete do
		-- 연구원1: 지금부터 내가 말하는 방향을 바라본다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_9', skip = true })

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		-- 바라봐야 할 방향 리스트
		local direction_list = {
			'down',
			'up',
			'left',
			'right',
			'up',
			'down'
		}

		is_complete = true

		local i = 1
		while i <= #direction_list do
			local direction = direction_list[i]

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(researcher_1, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_' .. direction, type_speed = 0 })

			local duration = 2
			local time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < duration and not self.is_leave_test_zone do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(researcher_1)

			-- 다른곳으로 가려 했을 경우
			if self.is_leave_test_zone then
				party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

				-- 연구원1: 뭐야, 너 어디가는 거야!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				character_util.look_at(researcher_1, user_party.Leader)
				character_util.set_anim(researcher_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_leave_test_zone', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

				character_util.set_direction(researcher_1, 'down')
				character_util.remove_anim(researcher_1)

				character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, researcher_1)
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * 2, 2)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				self.is_leave_test_zone = false

				party_util.reset_controllers()
			else
				if user_party_leader.Direction == self:string_to_direction(direction) then
					-- 성공
				else
					-- 실패
					local researcher_3 = self.get_researcher(3)

					field_ui_manager:Hide()
					party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

					character_util.look_at(researcher_1, user_party.Leader)
					character_util.look_at(researcher_2, user_party.Leader)
					character_util.look_at(researcher_3, user_party.Leader)

					-- 연구원1: 전정 기관이 고장났나…? 균형을 못 잡는군.

		character_util.set_direction(party, hole_marker.direction)
		character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(party, { name = 'damaged' })

		-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
		local freefall_character = function(character, fall_time, offset_y)
			local curtime = unity_class.time.time
			local falltime = fall_time
			local curpos = character.Position
			local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0);
			offset_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_y, 0)

			local shadow_offset_origin = character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition
			local shadow_offset = vector(0, -0.3, -0.1)

			while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
				freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

				local y = curpos.y + dist_y + offset_y
				if y < offset_y then
					y = offset_y
				end
				character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, y, curpos.z), true)
				character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin + shadow_offset + vector(0, -y + 1, 0)

				user_party.Leader.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, offset_y, curpos.z))
			character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin
			character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(freefall_character, party, fall_time, 1))

		wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay)
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(researcher_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(researcher_2, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(researcher_3, 'disabled')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local helper = self.get_research_helper(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(helper, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 무기를 다시 장착 시켜줌
	self:restore_player_weapon()

	-- 주인공 마법진을 통해 순간이동
	self.current_progress = self.progress.test_complete
end

function local_class:fall_into_hole(fo, pos)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fall_down_01')

	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'prostrate' })

	character_util.move_to_async(fo, pos, 0.5, nil, true)
end

function local_class:throw_to_hole(fo)
	message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	coroutine.yield()

	local hole = self.get_hole(1)

	-- 구멍에 떨어지는 연출
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 360 * 6, 1.5)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.zero, 1.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(fo, hole.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5), 0.5, nil, false, false, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:feed_the_super_invader()
	local feed_invader = self.get_feed_invader(1)
	local super_invader = self.get_super_invader(1)
	local feed_survivor_1 = self.get_feed_survivor(1)
	local feed_survivor_2 = self.get_feed_survivor(2)

	local is_battle = function()
		return not lua_helper.type_compare(feed_invader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState)
	end
	local reset_all = function()
		-- 무언가 들고 있으면 바닥에 내려놓게
		local current_state = feed_invader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local target = current_state.HoldTarget
			command_util.execute_throw(feed_invader, target, direction_util.to_vector3(feed_invader.Direction), feed_invader.Position, 4, false)
		end

		character_util.stop_shake(feed_invader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(feed_invader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(super_invader)
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress.feed_the_super_invader

	-- 강제 이벤트: 앞으로 가면 인베이더가 슈퍼 인베이더에게 사람을 사료로 주고 있는 모습

	-- 인베이더 옆에 쓰러진 이누이트 족이 몇 명 쓰러져있다.

	-- 인베이더: 자 오늘 간식이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	character_util.set_anim(feed_invader, { name = 'clap' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_47', skip = true })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	character_util.remove_anim(feed_invader)
	character_util.set_direction(feed_invader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더가 이누이트족을 들고 슈퍼 인베이더에게 던진다.
	feed_survivor_1.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	feed_survivor_1.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '02_hit_projectile_01'
	command_util.execute_holdup(feed_invader, feed_survivor_1, feed_invader.Position, 0.12, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.12)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	character_util.set_direction(feed_invader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	command_util.execute_throw(feed_invader, feed_survivor_1, direction_util.to_vector3(feed_invader.Direction), feed_invader.Position, 8, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 플레이어가 feed_survivor_1를 들어올렸다면, 떨어뜨림
	local current_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local target = current_state.HoldTarget

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(taqrget, feed_survivor_1) then
			command_util.execute_throw(user_party_leader, target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction), user_party_leader.Position, 4, false)
			message_system:SendSync(feed_survivor_1, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
			character_util.move_to(feed_survivor_1, vector_util.get_x0z(feed_survivor_1.Position), 0.5, nil, false, false)
		end
	end
	coroutine.yield()
	feed_survivor_1.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	character_util.move_to_async(super_invader, feed_survivor_1.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 4, true, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_npc_01",
								 play_pos = feed_survivor_1.Position, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	self.get_meat_part_effect():Instantiate(feed_survivor_1.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_super_invader_roar_03', parent = super_invader})
	character_util.set_anim(super_invader, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(feed_survivor_1, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if is_battle() then
		reset_all()
		character_util.set_active_state(feed_survivor_1, 'disabled')
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(feed_survivor_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_anim(super_invader)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 슈퍼 인베이더, 하트 이모티콘 띄운다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = super_invader})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(super_invader.Position + vector(0, 4, 0), nil, 'heart')

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더: 이누이트가 그렇게 좋아?
	character_util.set_anim(feed_invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_48', skip = true })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더: 녀석, 식성만 좋아져서는…
	character_util.set_anim(feed_invader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_49', skip = true })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 슈퍼 인베이더 우는 이모티콘 띄운다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', parent = super_invader})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(super_invader.Position + vector(0, 4, 0), nil, 'sweat')

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더: 에이, 그런 눈으로 보면 그냥 갈 수 없잖아!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(feed_invader, 0.04, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_50', skip = true })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더: 자, 여기 하나만 더 먹자!
	character_util.stop_shake(feed_invader)
	character_util.set_anim(feed_invader, { name = 'shoot' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', parent = feed_invader})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_51', skip = true })

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	character_util.remove_anim(feed_invader)
	character_util.set_direction(feed_invader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 인베이더가 이누이트족을 하나 더 던진다.
	feed_survivor_2.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	feed_survivor_2.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '02_hit_projectile_01'
	command_util.execute_holdup(feed_invader, feed_survivor_2, feed_invader.Position, 0.12, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.12)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	character_util.set_direction(feed_invader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	command_util.execute_throw(feed_invader, feed_survivor_2, direction_util.to_vector3(feed_invader.Direction), feed_invader.Position, 8, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 플레이어가 feed_survivor_2를 들어올렸다면, 떨어뜨림
	current_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local target = current_state.HoldTarget

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(taqrget, feed_survivor_2) then
			command_util.execute_throw(user_party_leader, target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction), user_party_leader.Position, 4, false)
			message_system:SendSync(feed_survivor_2, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
			character_util.move_to(feed_survivor_2, vector_util.get_x0z(feed_survivor_2.Position), 0.5, nil, false, false)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_npc_01",
										 play_pos = feed_survivor_2.Position, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })
		end
	end
	coroutine.yield()
	feed_survivor_2.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	self.get_meat_part_effect():Instantiate(feed_survivor_2.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_super_invader_roar_03', parent = super_invader})
	character_util.set_anim(super_invader, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(feed_survivor_2, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if is_battle() then
		reset_all()
		character_util.set_active_state(feed_survivor_2, 'disabled')
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(feed_survivor_2, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_anim(super_invader)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_battle() then reset_all() return end

	-- 슈퍼 인베이더 하트 이모티콘 띄우며 먹는다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = super_invader})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(super_invader.Position + vector(0, 4, 0), nil, 'heart')

	-- 플레이어가 접근하면 전투 시작
	-- 슈퍼 인베이더를 쓰러트리고 올라가면 아까 갈수 없었던 닫혀있던 방으로 나오게 된다.

function local_class:hole_invader_detect_routine()
	local feed_invader = self.get_feed_invader(1)
	local invader_list = {
		self.get_feed_invader(1),
		self.get_super_invader(1)
	}

	while not self.is_battle_hole_feed_battle do
		for i = 1, #invader_list do
			local invader = invader_list[i]

			local is_in_sight = self:is_in_sight(invader, user_party.Leader, 4, 160)
			if is_in_sight then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(guard, { 'hole_feed_detect' }))

				-- 누구냐!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(feed_invader, { key = 'futurecastle_coco_invader_fight', bubble_type = 'shout' })
				break
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
		CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:defeat_coco()
	local coco = self.get_coco()

	local prince_and_maco_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.prince_and_maco_quest_id)
	local is_coco_dead_route = true

	if prince_and_maco_quest_progress ~= nil and prince_and_maco_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		is_coco_dead_route = false
	end

	-- 전투 종료
	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.coco_battlegate_name .. i, false))
	end
	for i = 3, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.coco_battlegate_name .. i, true))
	end

	-- 보이스 대응 : 팡파레 & 보이스 봉인 해제
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	-- fade out - fade in
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(coco)
	coco.Position = vector(149.5, 0, -30.5)
	character_util.set_direction(coco, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(coco, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	user_party.Leader.Position = coco.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, 7 do
		local invader = self.get_coco_researcher(i)
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'unique/ice' })

--region util
function local_class:string_to_direction(direction_str)
	if type_util.is_string(direction_str) then
		if direction_str == 'left' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		elseif direction_str == 'right' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		elseif direction_str == 'up' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		elseif direction_str == 'down' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		elseif direction_str == 'none' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.None
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 터치 연타 함수
function local_class:turbo_tap(duration, count)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	local time_passed = 0

	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

-- 플레이어 무기 제거
function local_class:remove_player_weapon()
	if self.player_weapon_right == nil then
		self.player_weapon_right = user_party.Leader.Weapon1
	end

	if self.player_weapon_left == nil then
		self.player_weapon_left = user_party.Leader.Weapon2
	end

	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
end

-- 플레이어 무기 복구
function local_class:restore_player_weapon()
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, self.player_weapon_right)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, self.player_weapon_left)
end
--endregion

return local_class

    self.interactable_boxing_gloves_name = 'interactable_boxing_gloves'

    self.boxing_gloves_item = nil;
end

function local_class:enter()
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    local favi = get_character(self.controller.favi_name)

    local main_quest_id = 195
    local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

    character_util.add_listener(favi, self.controller)

    -- 복싱 글러브 생성
    local interactable_boxing_gloves = get_field_object(self.interactable_boxing_gloves_name)
    interactable_boxing_gloves.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
    self.boxing_gloves_item  = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = interactable_boxing_gloves.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.1),
                                                           itemid = self.controller.boxing_gloves_id, notforinven = true,
                                                           lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
    self.boxing_gloves_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.controller.boxing_glove_scale
    self.boxing_gloves_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

    local favi = get_character(self.controller.favi_name)
    character_util.remove_relate_event(favi, self.controller)
    quest_icon_util.remove(favi)

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

--region event related

function local_class:on_event(e)
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end

    if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    local favi = get_character(self.controller.favi_name)
    local interactable_boxing_gloves = get_field_object(self.interactable_boxing_gloves_name)

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, favi) then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.favi_talk, self)
    elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, interactable_boxing_gloves) then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_boxing_gloves, self)
    end
end

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleHalbalSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleHalbal @
		Comment = 할발 구하기 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.start_zone_name = 'halbal_zone'
	self.battle_zone_name = 'halbal_battle_zone'

	self.invaders_monster_group_name = 'invaders'

	self.star_piece_name = 'halbal_starpiece'

	self.seen_intro = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	--message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

-- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.start_zone_name and not self.seen_intro then
			self.seen_intro = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.halbal_intro, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.battle_zone_name then
			self:fight_with_invaders()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fight_with_invaders()
	local monsters = self.controller:get_invaders()
	local halbal = self.controller:get_halbal()
	local halbal_p = self.controller:get_halbal_party()

	for i, v in pairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(v, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	for i,_ in pairs(monsters) do
		character_util.set_direction(i, 'down')
		character_util.convert_to_monster(i, self.invaders_monster_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		character_util.set_death_type(i, "airspin")

		command_util.execute_monster_notice(i, user_party_leader, "battle")
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(user_party_leader, i, "battle")
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.invaders_monster_group_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_quest, self)
	end
end

--[[
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bomb = get_field_object('halbal_mouse_bomb')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bomb) then
		local jumptile = get_field_object('halbal_jump')

		jumptile.FieldObjectBehaviour.HorizontalSpeed = 10

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_jump, self, bomb))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--[[
function local_class:reset_jump(bomb)

	--[[
	if bomb.FieldObjectBehaviour. then

	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)
end

function local_class:halbal_intro()
	local halbal = self.controller:get_halbal()
	local halbal_p = self.controller:get_halbal_party()
	local invaders_i = self.controller:get_invaders()

	local invaders = {}
	for invader,_ in pairs(invaders_i) do
		table.insert(invaders, invader)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(halbal.Position, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })
	-- ...이 놈들이 마지막인가?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invaders[1], { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_1', skip = true })

	-- 빨리 끝내고 밥이나 먹자. 배고파.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invaders[2], { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_2', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })

	-- 다들 뒤돌아서 벽에 손대!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invaders[3], { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_2_1', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })

	for _, party_member in pairs(halbal_p) do
		local tmpos = party_member.Position
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(party_member, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'up')
		character_util.move_to(party_member, tmpos + 0.2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, nil, 0.6, false, false)
	end
	local tmpos = halbal.Position

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'up')
	character_util.move_to_async(halbal, tmpos + 0.2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, nil, 0.6, false, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01' })

	-- 제, 제발… 제발 살려주세요..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_3', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:end_quest()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local halbal = self.controller:get_halbal()
	local halbal_p = self.controller:get_halbal_party()

	halbal.Position = halbal.Position + unity_class.vector3.back

	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'down')
	for i,v in ipairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, 'down')
	end

	for id, party_member in ipairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(party_member, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		party_member.Position = halbal.Position + (id - 2) * unity_class.vector3.right + unity_class.vector3.forward
	end

	party_util.position_party(halbal.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.back, 'up', 'arc')

	local rocks = self.controller:get_rocks()
	for _,arock in pairs(rocks) do
		if arock ~= nil then
			arock.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move(halbal.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('halbal_door', false))
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 고, 고맙소...이 은혜는..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_4', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	-- ….!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_5', skip = true })

	for _, party_member in pairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(party_member, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })

	-- 너, 넌...크레이그랑 함께 있던…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_6', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(halbal)
	-- …..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_7', skip = true })

	for _, party_member in pairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(party_member)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(halbal)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 그 때는 정말 미안했네..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_8', skip = true })

	-- 크레이그에게도, 던전 왕국의 모두에게도 참 몹쓸 짓을 했어..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_9', skip = true })

	-- 모든걸 잃고 세상이 이 모양이 되서야 나를 돌아보게 되더군..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_10', skip = true })

	local branches = {
		{ 'futurecastle_halbal_11' }, -- 참회하고 싶다면 레지스탕스를 도와줘.
		{ 'futurecastle_halbal_12' } -- 빚은 갚아야지.
	}
	local i = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches, 'release')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'idle' })
	-- 대규모 인베이더 공습…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_13', skip = true })

	-- ….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_14', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
	-- 그 말은 우리도 그곳에서 함께 죽으라는 소리로 밖에는 들리지 않아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_15', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(halbal, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 목숨을 구해준건 고맙지만..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_16', skip = true })

	-- ...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_17', skip = true })

	-- 나는 역시 겁쟁이네..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_18', skip = true })

	-- 보답으로 이거라도 받게나.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_18_1', skip = true })

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece.Position = halbal.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(halbal.Position))

	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(halbal)

	for _,party_member in ipairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'right')
	end
	party_util.set_direction('right')

	local tmp = halbal.Position
	local wps = {
		tmp + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.right,
		tmp + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.back + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.right,
	}

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(halbal, { waypoints = wps, speed = 3, run = false })

	character_util.look_at(halbal, user_party_leader)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 미안하네..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'futurecastle_halbal_19', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(halbal, wps[2] + 7 * unity_class.vector3.right, nil, 3, true, true)

	for _,party_member in ipairs(halbal_p) do
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(party_member, { name = 'tired' })
	end
	party_util.set_direction('up')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	table.insert(wps, wps[2] + 7 * unity_class.vector3.right)
	wps[1] = wps[1] + 1 * unity_class.vector3.forward

	for _,party_member in ipairs(halbal_p) do
		wp_util.move_way_points(party_member, { waypoints = wps, speed = 3, run = false })
	end
	party_util.set_direction('right')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	wait_for_sec(4)

	self.controller:setting_post()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hyper,
				{ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_11', skip = true })

			-- 그런데… 왜이렇게 익숙한 거지?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hyper,
				{ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_12', skip = true })

			character_util.add_listener(hyper, self.controller)
		end)
		return true
	end
	return false

-- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

			wall_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_13', mintotalduration = 1 })

			wall_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 마지막 사당 폭발 연출 장면
function local_class:ending_scene()
	local terminal_invisible = get_field_object(self.terminal_invisible_name)
	local terminal = get_field_object(self.terminal_name)

	camera_util.move_async(terminal_invisible.Position, 1)

	-- 동력원 소실
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal, { key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_8', skip = true })

	-- 용사의 수면 유지 불가
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal, { key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_9', skip = true })

	-- 안전을 위해 사당 내 모든 인원을 긴급 배출합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal, { key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_10', skip = true })

	-- 터지는 이펙트 + 화이트 아웃
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 5.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
	local boss_die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	local explosion_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_effect_name)
	explosion_effect_pool:Instantiate(terminal_invisible.Position + vector(0, 2, -1))
	wait_for_sec(3.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')
	boss_die_sfx:Stop()
	screen_util.fade_out(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 장소 이동 및 세팅
	local hyper = get_character(self.hyper_name)
	local hyper_end_pos = field:GetMarker(self.hyper_end_marker_name).position

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyper)

	-- 하이퍼 세팅
	hyper.Position = hyper_end_pos
	character_util.set_direction(hyper, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(hyper, { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.set_anim(hyper, { name = 'prostrate' })

	-- 파티원 세팅
	party_util.align_party(hyper.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.left, 'left', 0, 'linear')
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'hurt' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'prostrate' })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.controller.in_event_zone = false
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 하이퍼, 파티원들 깨어남
	character_util.shake(hyper, 0.05, 1)
	party_util.shake(0.05, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyper)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party[i], 'right')
	end
	character_util.mario_jump_async(hyper, 'left')

	character_util.set_emotion(hyper, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 하이퍼 두리번 두리번
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_direction(hyper, direction_util.get_opposite(hyper.Direction))
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(hyper)

	character_util.set_anim(hyper, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	character_util.add_listener(hyper, self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

return local_class

	end

	self:stop_sleep_sfx()
end

-- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

-- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 단말기 상호작용
	local terminal_invisible = get_field_object(self.terminal_invisible_name)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, terminal_invisible) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.touch_terminal, self, terminal_invisible)
		return true
	end

	-- 하이퍼 총 상호작용
	local hyper_weapon_invisible = get_field_object(self.hyper_weapon_invisible_name)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, hyper_weapon_invisible) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			hyper_weapon_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			-- 어디선가 본적이 있는 듯한 총이다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_14', mintortalduration = 1 })

			hyper_weapon_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end)
		return true
	end

	local hyper = get_character(self.hyper_name)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, hyper) then
		self:start_sleep_sfx()
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hyper, { key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_1' })

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_sleep_sfx()
	self:stop_sleep_sfx()

	self.sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', parent = get_character(self.hyper_name),
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
end

function local_class:stop_sleep_sfx()
	if self.sleep_sfx ~= nil then
		self.sleep_sfx:Stop()
		self.sleep_sfx = nil
	end
end

-- StarPieceGetEvent
function local_class:on_starpiece_get_event(e)

	if star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.hyper_star_piece_name) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			if self.amb_scifi_sfx ~= nil then
				self.amb_scifi_sfx:FadeOut(2)
				self.amb_scifi_sfx = nil
			end
			self:stop_sleep_sfx()

			quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false,
				false, false)
		end))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.bgm_event_zone_name then
				self.amb_scifi_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_scifi_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', fade_in_time = 2 })
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 단말기 상호 작용 시 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:touch_terminal(terminal_invisible)
	terminal_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	party_util.align_party(terminal_invisible.Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
		'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 훗날, ‘재앙’이 부활하여 온 세상을 불태우리라.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_spell_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal_invisible,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_2', skip = true })

	-- 검의 선택을 받은 용사는 이에 맞설 때를 기다리며,
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal_invisible,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_3', skip = true })

	-- 깊은 상처를 회복하기 위한 잠에 빠져 있다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(terminal_invisible,
		{ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_4', skip = true })

	-- 신비한 석판 안쪽에 금빛으로 빛나는 돌이 보인다.
	-- 꺼내시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_5', mintortalduration = 1 })

	-- 플레이어 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 예
		{ 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_6', 'mercy' },
		-- 아니오
		{ 'futurecastle_hyper_shrine_7', 'brutal' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		terminal_invisible.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return
	end

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_candyshop_01')
	local start_piece = get_field_object(self.hyper_star_piece_name)
	start_piece.Position = terminal_invisible.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -2.5)
	message_system:SendSync(start_piece,
		CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(terminal_invisible.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.5)), false)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleInvaderReporterSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FutureCastleInvaderReporter @
		Comment = 미래 부유성 인베이더 기자 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 사진 찍는 존
	self.take_picture_zone = 'invader_reporter_zone_'
	-- 마커 포인트
	self.marker_point = 'invader_reporter_point_'
	-- 인베이더 기자
	self.get_invader_reporter = function() return get_character('invader_reporter') end

	-- 진행도
	self.reporter_progress = 1

	self.apper_reporter = false
	self.damaged_reporter = false
	self.game_over = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')

	-- 인베이더 기자 세팅
	local invader_reporter = self.get_invader_reporter()
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_point..1).position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(invader_reporter, start_pos)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(invader_reporter, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	local floor = get_field_object('invader_reporter_floor')
	floor.Position = floor.Position + vector(3,0,0)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))

	self.barrel_pos = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if e.Zone.Name == self.take_picture_zone..i and self.reporter_progress == i then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.take_picture, self, i))
				self.reporter_progress = self.reporter_progress + 1
				return true
			end
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
		return true

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) and e.FullLeave
			and e.Zone.Name == self.take_picture_zone..3
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		self.apper_reporter = false
		return true

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:interact_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local damate_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_field_object('reporter_gunpowder_' .. i)) and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_field_object('invader_reporter_floor')) then
		if e.Info.type == damate_type then
			if self.apper_reporter and not self.damaged_reporter then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reporter_damaged_event, self))
			end
		end
	end

	end
end

function local_class:interact_event(e)
	local invader_reporter = self.get_invader_reporter()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, invader_reporter) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reporter_talk, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local barrel = get_field_object('reporter_gunpowder_' .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, barrel) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_barrel, self, barrel, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(e)
	self.game_over = true
end
--endregion

-- 사진을 찍고 숨는 인베이더 기자
function local_class:take_picture(zone_number)
	local invader_reporter = self.get_invader_reporter()

	if zone_number == 1 then
		invader_reporter.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.set_direction(invader_reporter, 'left')
		local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_point..zone_number).position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_anim(invader_reporter, {name = 'run'})
		character_util.move_to_async(invader_reporter, start_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 0.7)
		character_util.set_anim(invader_reporter, {name = 'idle'})

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(invader_reporter, { name = 'unique/take_picture', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		if not self.game_over then
			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_01')
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		character_util.remove_anim(invader_reporter)
		character_util.set_direction(invader_reporter, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(invader_reporter, {name = 'run'})

		character_util.move_to_async(invader_reporter, start_pos + vector(40, 0, 0), 9)
		character_util.set_position(invader_reporter, vector(999, 0, 999))

		invader_reporter.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif zone_number == 2 then
		invader_reporter:SetGiantFactor('invader_reporter', 1.5)

		character_util.set_direction(invader_reporter, 'up')
		local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_point..zone_number).position
		character_util.set_position(invader_reporter, start_pos)

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleKarinaSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.shake_sfx = nil

	self.gaugeMax = 5
	self.star_piece_name = 'futurecastle_karina_starpiece'
end

function local_class:enter()
	local oldman = self.controller:get_oldman()
	oldman.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	self.controller:get_mummy_karina().CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.warningsfx = nil
	self.talk_with_oldman_flag = false

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blood_suck_timer, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.warningsfx = nil
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local oldman = self.controller:get_oldman()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(oldman.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		oldman.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local oldman = self.controller:get_oldman()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(oldman, e.Target) then
			self.talk_with_oldman_flag = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.oldman_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:is_looking_at(player, target)
	if player.Position.x > target.Position.x and player.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return true
	end
	if player.Position.x < target.Position.x and player.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return true
	end
	if player.Position.z > target.Position.z and player.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return true
	end
	if player.Position.z < target.Position.z and player.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- CharacterControllerVampireBadGirlState.cs 참조
-- 거리가 1일 경우 & 등을 보일경우 타이머 시작. 만약 아니라면 타이머 리셋. 타이머 다 완료되면 피를 빠는걸로 바뀜.
function local_class:blood_suck_timer()
	local karina = self.controller:get_karina()
	local karina_m = self.controller:get_mummy_karina()

	local playerSeeVampireGirl = false
	local attackQueueStarted = false
	local gaugeValue = 0
	local timeSinceLastSeen = 0
	local shakeMag = 0.006

	while true do
		if (user_party_leader.Position - karina.Position).magnitude < 1.5 then
			character_util.stop_shake(karina_m)
			-- character_util.shake(karina, shakeMag, 1)
			if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState )
					or not is_unity_null(stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party)) then
				if attackQueueStarted then
					character_util.hide_attack_timer(karina)
				end

				self:stop_warning_sfx()

				attackQueueStarted = false
				gaugeValue = 0
				timeSinceLastSeen = 0
			else
				timeSinceLastSeen = timeSinceLastSeen + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
				-- local dir = (karina.Position - user_party_leader.Position):ToDirection()
				if self:is_looking_at(user_party_leader, karina) then
					if attackQueueStarted then
						character_util.hide_attack_timer(karina)
					end
					self:stop_shake_sfx()
					self:stop_warning_sfx()

					attackQueueStarted = false
					gaugeValue = 0
					timeSinceLastSeen = 0

					playerSeeVampireGirl = true
				elseif gaugeValue < self.gaugeMax then
					if timeSinceLastSeen > 2.5 then
						character_util.stop_shake(karina_m)
						character_util.shake(karina_m, shakeMag * timeSinceLastSeen, 1)
						if self.shake_sfx == nil and timeSinceLastSeen <= 7.5 then
							self.shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
								sfx_name = '01_push_wagon_01', parent = karina_m, loop = true,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
							})
						end
					end
					if timeSinceLastSeen > 7.5 then
						character_util.stop_shake(karina_m)
						if not attackQueueStarted then
							attackQueueStarted = true
							character_util.show_attack_timer(karina, self.gaugeMax)
							character_util.stop_shake(karina_m)
							self:stop_shake_sfx()
							self.warningsfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
								sfx_name = '01_vampire_warning_01', parent = karina_m, loop = true,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
							})
						end

						gaugeValue = gaugeValue + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

						if gaugeValue >= self.gaugeMax then
							character_util.hide_attack_timer(karina)
							attackQueueStarted = false

							local e = CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(karina, { 'bloodsucking' } )
							message_system:Publish(e)

							self:stop_warning_sfx()

							break
						else
							--[[
							if gaugeValue > self.gaugeMax / 3 then
								self.warningsfx = music_player_util:play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_vampire_warning_01' })
							end
							--]]
						end
					else
						playerSeeVampireGirl = false
					end
				end
			end
		else
			character_util.stop_shake(karina_m)
			self:stop_shake_sfx()

			if (user_party_leader.Position - karina.Position).magnitude < 2 and not self.talk_with_oldman_flag then
				self.talk_with_oldman_flag = true

				field_ui_manager:Hide()
				user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

				local oldman = self.controller:get_oldman()
				-- 잠깐!
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oldman, { key = 'futurecastle_karina_0', screen_pos = vector(-130, -240), skip = true , bubble_type = 'shout' })

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.oldman_talk, self)
			elseif (user_party_leader.Position - karina.Position).magnitude < 3 then
				-- local tmp = (user_party_leader.Position - karina.Position).magnitude
				-- character_util.shake(karina, shakeMag/tmp, 1)
			end

			if attackQueueStarted then
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(karina)
			end

			self:stop_warning_sfx()

			attackQueueStarted = false
			gaugeValue = 0
			timeSinceLastSeen = 0
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	return
end

-- 사운드 중지
function local_class:stop_warning_sfx()
	if self.warningsfx ~= nil then
		self.warningsfx:FadeOut(1.5)
		self.warningsfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:stop_shake_sfx()
	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shake_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_explosion_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterGiveUpEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.opening_custom_event) ~= 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

				self:start_directional_entry_async()
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
			end))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterGiveUpEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.heavenhold_char_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.invader_list = nil

	if self.inn_obj_list ~= nil then
		self.inn_obj_list = nil
	end

	if self.thunder_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.thunder_effect)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MonsterGiveUpEvent) then
		self:on_monster_give_up_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.photo_target_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.photo_process then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.photo_target_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.success_photo_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.scream_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_thunder_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_thunder_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.thunder_harvester_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.fight_with_harvester then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.fight_with_harvester

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.refugee_runaway_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.refugee_runaway then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.refugee_runaway

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.refugee_runaway_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.resistance_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.resistance then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.resistance

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ignore_resistance_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.crashed_statue_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.crashed_statue_start then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.crashed_statue_start

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bombard_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.enter_shelter_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_shelter then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.enter_shelter

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_shelter_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.photo_target_event and e.Zone.Name == self.photo_zone_event_zone_name then
			if not self.is_out_of_photo_zone then
				self.is_out_of_photo_zone = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.out_of_photo_zone, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.heavenhold_camera) then
		self:interact_with_camera()
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.resistance_helper) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.resistance then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.resistance

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_resistance_event, self))
		elseif self.event_progress == EventProgress.crashed_statue_start then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.save_resistance, self))
		elseif self.event_progress == EventProgress.crashed_statue_end then
			if self.is_resistance_saved then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_up_resistance, self))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_dead_body, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 레지스탕스 일으켜 세움
function local_class:get_up_resistance()
	if not self.is_get_up_resistance then
		self.is_get_up_resistance = true

		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		character_util.align_party(self.resistance_helper.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'arc')

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'push' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.shake(self.resistance_helper, 0.04, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		character_util.normal_jump(self.resistance_helper, true)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.resistance_helper)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'hurt' })

		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	-- 고, 고마워...덕분에 살았어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_23' })
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.blocked_rock_list[0]) then
			self.stair_entrance.Interactable = self.stair_entrance_interactable
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_harvester, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_monster_give_up_event(e)
	if not is_unity_null(self.monster_harvester) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Monster, self.monster_harvester) then
		character_util.move_to(self.monster_harvester, vector(56.5, 0, 0.5), 2, nil, true, true)
	end
end

-- 게임 시작하면 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()

	-- 배경 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 0), 0))

	-- 비 내리는 이펙트, 사운드 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { self.deactivate_rain_custom_event }))

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 플레이어 파티 비활성화
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 0)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local typing_text_asset_bundle_name = "ui/prologue"
	local typing_text_asset_name = "typing_text"
	local text_resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local typing_text = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		text_resholder, typing_text_asset_bundle_name, typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
			typing_text = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
				stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

			typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 150, 1, 110);
			typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0;
			typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
			typing_text.Label.fontSize = 64
			typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
		end)

	-- I believe in my Guardian
	camera_util.move(vector(3000, 0, 0), 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

-- HeavenHold Object들과 플레이어의 z값을 비교해서 SortingOrder 설정
function local_class:check_heavenhold_obj()
	local add_z = 0.1

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.photo_target_event do
		for i = 0, self.inn_obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local a = user_party_leader.Position.z + add_z
			if user_party_leader.Position.z + add_z < self.inn_obj_list[i].transform.position.z then
				self.inn_obj_list[i].Order = 0
			else
				self.inn_obj_list[i].Order = 10
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 카메라 타이머 이벤트
function local_class:camera_timer_event()
	-- 됐어, 어서 와!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_8' })

	-- 3초간 플레이어가 제자리로 돌아가는지 확인
	local timer = 0
	local camera_duration = 3

	-- 카메라 게이지 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	character_util.show_attack_timer(self.heavenhold_camera, camera_duration)

	while timer < camera_duration and self.event_progress < EventProgress.photo_target_event do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 카메라 게이지 종료
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.heavenhold_camera)

	-- 3초가 지나도 제자리로 돌아가지 않은 경우 처리
	if self.event_progress < EventProgress.photo_target_event then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.heavenhold_char_list[3])

		-- 카메라 플래시
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_02')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		-- 최초 실패 시 플레이어 멈춰서고 실패했다는 대화 출력함
		if not self.is_fail_photo_event then
			self.is_fail_photo_event = true

			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

			character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, self.heavenhold_char_list[3])

			character_util.look_at(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], user_party_leader)
			character_util.set_anim(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { name = 'tired' })

			-- 윽...실패잖아.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_9', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { name = 'attack' })

			-- 다시 찍어야겠어, 한 번 더 해보자.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_10', skip = true })

			character_util.set_direction(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim(self.heavenhold_char_list[3])
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.heavenhold_char_list[3])

			user_party:ResetControllers()

			-- Party Reset을 하면 바로 State가 바뀌지 않으므로 몇프레임 뒤에 UI 세팅해준다.
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			self:hide_field_uis()
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			-- 2회 이상 실패한 경우 대사만 출력
		else
			-- 스마일!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.heavenhold_char_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_10' })
		end

		-- 카메라 Interact 가능하도록 설정
		self.heavenhold_camera.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		-- 퀘스트 마커 설정
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.heavenhold_camera)
	end
end

-- 번개와 하베스터 이벤트
function local_class:thunder_harvester_event()
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- scream event 존에 도착하면 그 때부터 quest marker, tracker를 설정
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(56.5, 0, 0.5))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throne_thunder_01', 1.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_harvester_prepare_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teatan_scream_01', 0.6)
	local harvester_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_harvester_idle_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1.5, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 번개 이펙트 생성
	self.thunder_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.thunder_effect.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform.parent
	self.thunder_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.thunder_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear', 'none', false)

	-- hero_statue 기믹 안의 hero_statue_broken 내부 애니메이션으로 인해 로드될 때 비활성화 상태로 로드됨.
	-- Field 에서 Tint를 먹일 Renderer를 GetComponentsInChildren로 불러 올 때, 비활성화 상태라 리스트에 포함되지 않아서
	-- Field:Tint 의 적용 대상에서 제외돼 혼자 틴트가 먹지 않는 현상이 발생함.
	-- 현재 수동으로 직접 material의 color를 바꾸는 걸로 처리함.
	local hero_statue = get_field_object(self.hero_statue_name)
	local mesh = hero_statue.transform:GetChild(0)
	local broken_obj = mesh.transform:GetChild(0)
	local renderers = broken_obj.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	renderers.sharedMaterial = CS.UnityEngine.Material(renderers.sharedMaterial)
	renderers.material.color = unity_color({ 0.5, 0.1015625, 0.1015625, 1 })

	-- 화면 틴트
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.7}), 0)

	-- Kid Girl들 잠시 비활성화
	for i = 0, self.kid_girl_list.Count - 1 do
		self.kid_girl_list[i].SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 1)
		character_util.set_position(self.kid_girl_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_in(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	-- 화면 밖에서 날아오는 하베스터들
	for i = 0, self.harvester_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.harvester_list[i],
				user_party_leader.Position + vector(-16, 0, -2) + vector(-2 * i, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.harvester_list[i], 'right')

		if i < 2 then
			character_util.set_position(self.kid_girl_list[i],
					self.harvester_list[i].Position + vector(0.4, 0.7, 0), true)
			character_util.set_direction(self.kid_girl_list[i], 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(self.kid_girl_list[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.kid_girl_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
			self.kid_girl_list[i].Transform:SetParent(self.harvester_list[i].Transform)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.harvester_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.harvester_list[i], vector(75, 10, 0),
				nil, 9, false, true)

		wait_for_sec(0.7)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)
	harvester_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.thunder_effect)
	self.thunder_effect = nil
end

-- 레지스탕스와 대화 이벤트
function local_class:resistance_event()
	character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 꾸물거릴 시간 없어, 언제 또 하베스터가 들이닥칠지 모른다고!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_14', skip = true })

	local wait_for_branch = true
	local selection = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 대체 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 거야?
	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s1_15"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	-- 잡혀간 여자 아이 둘을 구해야 해!
	local talk_branch_2 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s1_16"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			selection = 1
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.resistance_helper
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if selection == 0 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'attack' })

		-- 너 대체 무슨 잠꼬대를 하고 있는 거야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_17', skip = true })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'mad' })

		-- 이런 우라질, 하루에 당하는 사람이 몇인데 그런 꿈 같은 소리를 해?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_18', skip = true })

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'tired' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'shoot' })

		-- 너까지 죽고 싶어?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_19', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	-- 어서 대피소로 가야 해...따라 와!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.resistance_helper, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_20', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to_async(self.resistance_helper, self.resistance_helper.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, false, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = self.resistance_helper, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.resistance_helper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	character_util.set_position(self.resistance_helper, vector(38.3, 0, -16))
	character_util.set_direction(self.resistance_helper, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'damaged' })

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(37, 0, -15.5))

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 영웅 동상이 포격에 무너져서 대피소 입구를 막는 이벤트
function local_class:crashed_statue_event()
	-- 플레이어가 돌 밀기 시작하면 이벤트 시작됨
	local push_start = false

	while not push_start do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterUnitPushState) then
			for i = 0, self.blocked_rock_list.Count - 1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState.PushTarget, self.blocked_rock_list[i]) then
					push_start = true
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 돌 밀고 있을 때, 플레이어 표정 찡그리는 이벤트
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_player_emotion_push_rock, self))

	self.resistance_helper.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local hero_statue = get_field_object(self.hero_statue_name)

	local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1.5, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 동상에 폭격 시작
	coroutine.yield(self:bombard_shot(vector(33.5, 0, -15.5), self.attack_radius_for_event * 1.5, false))

	-- 폭격 맞은 동상 기울어짐
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local rotate_duration = 4.5

	local start_rotate = 0
	local end_rotate = -70

	local block_interact_resistance = false
	local block_interact_resistance_duration = 3

	camera_util.shake(0.2, rotate_duration)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < rotate_duration do
		local cur_rotate = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCirc(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotate, end_rotate, rotate_duration)

		hero_statue.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_rotate))

		if not block_interact_resistance and unity_class.time.time - cur_time > block_interact_resistance_duration then
			block_interact_resistance = true

			self.resistance_helper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 석상 땅에 충돌
	self.event_progress = EventProgress.crashed_statue_end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_02', play_pos = vector(35.5, 0, -15), type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	earthquake_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)
	self.big_smoke_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.big_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(35.5, 0, -15)

	if self.is_resistance_saved then
		--[[
		character_util.jump(self.resistance_helper, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'scared' })
		]]
	else
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {1, 0, 0},
				12000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, self.resistance_helper, knock_back_info, nil)

		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_list[i], { name = 'hurt' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_list[i], { name = 'tired' })
	end

	-- 플레이어가 피격 범위 내에 있었을 경우, 이벤트 처리
	if (user_party_leader.Position - vector(37.5, 0, -15.5)).magnitude < self.statue_damaged_range then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_damaged_by_statue, self))
	end

	-- 돌 파괴
	for i = 0, self.blocked_rock_list.Count - 1 do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
		damage_info.sender = hero_statue
		damage_info.target = self.blocked_rock_list[i]
		damage_info.damage = 100
		damage_info.notMortal = true

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1)

	if self.controller == nil then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local hero_statue_animator = hero_statue:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	hero_statue_animator:Play('hero_statue_broken')

	hero_statue.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- 파편 생성
	for i = 0, self.staute_breakable_list.Count - 1 do
