-- 공용 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot(pos, radius, attack_player)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local missile_height = 15
	local cur_y = stage_util.get_height(pos)

	local bombard_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(pos.x, cur_y + 0.1, pos.z), radius)

	bombard_range:Show()

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_preset):Instantiate(
			pos + vector(0, missile_height, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.5
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, missile_height, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		missile.transform.position = pos + vector(0, missile_height + freefall:GetDistance(), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_01', play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	missile:Dispose()

	local explosion = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_explosion_preset):Instantiate(pos)
	explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	bombard_range:Hide()

	if attack_player then
		if (user_party_leader.Position - pos).magnitude < radius then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
			damage_info.target = user_party_leader
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bombard_damage_per_hp)

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

-- 레지스탕스 구하는 이벤트
function local_class:save_resistance()
	self.is_resistance_saved = true

	self.resistance_helper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, self.resistance_helper.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, nil, true, true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'right')

	local party_crashbehaviour_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviour)

	local resistance_helper_knockback = function()
		self.resistance_helper.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.jump(self.resistance_helper, 0.5, 0.3)
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {1, 0, 0},
			20000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, self.resistance_helper, knock_back_info, nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_02', parent = self.resistance_helper, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {-1, 0, 0},
			10000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, user_party_leader, knock_back_info, nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = self.resistance_helper, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_04', parent = self.resistance_helper, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate((user_party_leader.Position + self.resistance_helper.Position) / 2)

		character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'damaged' })

		local knock_back_end = function()
			wait_for_sec(0.7)

			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'none')
			self.resistance_helper.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'hurt' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.resistance_helper, { name = 'confused' })
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(knock_back_end))
	end

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, self.resistance_helper)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party_leader, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.0667)

	resistance_helper_knockback()

	wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party_leader, 'throw') - 0.0667)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 플레이어가 석상 범위 내에 있었을 경우, 석상 맞고 튕겨나면서 데미지 입음
function local_class:player_damaged_by_statue()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local center_pos = vector(37.5, 0, -15.5)

	if (user_party_leader.Position - vector(37.5, 0, -15.5)).magnitude < self.statue_damaged_range then
		local dist = (center_pos - user_party_leader.Position).normalized

		-- dist가 zero인 예외 처리
		if dist == unity_class.vector3.zero then
			dist = vector(1, 0, 0)
		end

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {1, 0, 0},
				17000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, user_party_leader, knock_back_info, nil)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
		damage_info.target = user_party_leader
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.statue_damage)
		damage_info.notMortal = true

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(user_party_leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.04, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Direction)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

function local_class:enter_shelter_event()
	-- hero_statue 기믹 안의 hero_statue_broken 내부 애니메이션으로 인해 로드될 때 비활성화 상태로 로드됨.
	-- Field 에서 Tint를 먹일 Renderer를 GetComponentsInChildren로 불러 올 때, 비활성화 상태라 리스트에 포함되지 않아서
	-- Field:Tint 의 적용 대상에서 제외돼 혼자 틴트가 먹지 않는 현상이 발생함.
	-- 현재 수동으로 직접 material의 color를 바꾸는 걸로 처리함.
	local hero_statue = get_field_object(self.hero_statue_name)
	local mesh = hero_statue.transform:GetChild(0)
	local broken_obj = mesh.transform:GetChild(0)
	local renderers = broken_obj.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	renderers.sharedMaterial = CS.UnityEngine.Material(renderers.sharedMaterial)
	renderers.material.color = unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 })

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	-- 레지스탕스 NPC 초기화
	self.resistance_helper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	character_util.set_position(self.resistance_helper, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim(self.resistance_helper)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.resistance_helper)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.in_tent_event_zone_name then
		if not self.in_tent then
			self.in_tent = true

			-- 인베이더 공격 이벤트 발생 전 텐트 입장
			if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
						self.player_bed)
				-- 인베이더 공격 이벤트 발생 후 텐트 입장
			else
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
						self.tent_exit)

				-- 연기 제거
				if self.camera_smoke_effect ~= nil then
					self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()
					self.camera_smoke_effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.out_tent_event_zone_name then
		if self.in_tent then
			self.in_tent = false

			-- 인베이더 공격 이벤트 발생 전 텐트 퇴장
			if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
						self.player_tent)
				-- 인베이더 공격 이벤트 발생 후 텐트 퇴장
			else
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
						vector(114.5, 0, 49))

				-- 연기 추가
				if self.camera_smoke_effect == nil then
					self.camera_smoke_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_big_preset):Instantiate(
							stage_camera.transform.position + vector(-7, 0, 0))
					self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform
				end
			end
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.barricade_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.out_of_tent then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.enter_barricade

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.player_bed) then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_bed_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tent_exit) then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.sleep_and_wake then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.out_of_tent

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_out_of_tent_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_1 then
		if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_1, self))
		else
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.battle_1
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_2 then
		if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_2, self, 3))
		else
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.battle_2
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.battle_finish_flag == BattleFinishFlag.battle_1 then
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.none

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_1, self))
		elseif self.battle_finish_flag == BattleFinishFlag.battle_2 then
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.none

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_2, self, 1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.sohee_event_finished then
			-- 소히와 대화한 것 메인 퀘스트에 키로 저장
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
					self.controller.quest_progress, self.has_sohee_marian_blueprint, 1))
		end
	end
end

-- 침대에 상호작용 시 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_bed_event()
	party_util.align_party(self.player_bed.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 선택지
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local selection = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s10_0"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			selection = 0
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	local talk_branch_2 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s10_1"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			selection = 1
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = user_party_leader
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if selection == 0 then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		-- 커스텀 이벤트로 전투 지역에 있는 다른 이벤트들 전부 비활성화
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, {self.invader_attack_start_event}))

		self.event_progress = EventProgress.sleep_and_wake

		character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1.5, nil, true, true)

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 여유분 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		-- 플레이어 수면
		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "sleep" })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'sleep' })

		-- 이펙트 생성
		self.smoke_effect_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)

		local smoke_effect_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(82, 1, 27.5))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(92.5, 2, 27.5))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(90, 1, 16))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(106, 1, 22))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(111, 1, 20))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(109.4, 2, 27))

		for i = 0, self.smoke_effect_num - 1 do
			self.smoke_effect_list:Add(
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset):Instantiate(smoke_effect_pos_list[i]))
		end

		-- 인베이더 침공 설정

		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'up')

		wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
					1, nil, true, true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 플레이어 침낭 Interact 불가능하도록 수정
		self.player_bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				self.tent_exit)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'down')
	end
end

function local_class:enter_tent(cur_resistance, cur_refugee)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_resistance, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(cur_resistance, cur_resistance.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_refugee, 0, 0.5)

			0.5, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_resistance, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_position(cur_resistance, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_refugee, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_position(cur_refugee, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 레지스탕스가 안내하는 이벤트 1
function local_class:guide_resistance_1()
	local talker = get_character(self.resistance_camp_a_name..1)

	character_util.set_anim(talker, { name = 'cast2' })

	local timer = 0
	local talk_delay = 2

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_barricade do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= talk_delay then
			timer = 0

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s10_5_2', dialogue = false })
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 레지스탕스가 안내하는 이벤트 2
function local_class:guide_resistance_2()
	local talker_1 = get_character(self.resistance_camp_b_name..5)
	local talker_2 = get_character(self.resistance_camp_a_name..2)

	local timer = 1
	local talk_delay = 2
	local set_talker = 0

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_barricade do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= talk_delay then
			timer = 0

			if set_talker == 0 then
				set_talker = 1

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker_1, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s10_5_1', dialogue = false })
			else
				set_talker = 0

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker_2, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s10_5_1', dialogue = false })
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 자연스럽게 연기 이펙트 아래로 내려가서 사라지는 연출
function local_class:remove_big_smoke_effect()
	self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.parent = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_big_preset).Transform

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local remove_duration = 5

	local start_pos = self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition
	local z_diff = -18

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < remove_duration do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, z_diff, remove_duration)

		self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(start_pos.x, start_pos.y, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	self.camera_smoke_effect = nil
end

-- 버스터 터렛 공격
function local_class:buster_turret_attack(monster_list, damage_per_hp)
	local buster_turret = get_field_object(self.buster_turret_name)
	local center_pos = vector(119.5, 0, 46.2)

	local timer = 0
	local attack_delay = 2
	local attack_duration = 1
	local is_attack = false

	local effect_origin_length = 3.2
	local dist_limit = 10
	local angle_limit = 60

	local turret_angle_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	turret_angle_list:Add(0)
	turret_angle_list:Add(90)
	turret_angle_list:Add(180)
	turret_angle_list:Add(-90)

	local fire_effect_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(119.5, 1, 48.1))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(121, 1, 46.25))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(119.5, 1, 44.6))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(117.8, 1, 46.25))

	-- 타겟 조준 발사를 위한 변수
	local target_effect
	local target
	local last_angle = 0
	local angle = 0

	local turret_angle = 0
	local turret_dir = 'up'

	while self.is_battle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not is_attack and timer > attack_delay then
			timer = 0
			is_attack = true

			-- 플레이어 죽은 경우에는 소리 재생 X
			if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fox_ball_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_ready_effect_preset):Instantiate(buster_turret.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

			-- 근처에 있는 적 한 명 잡아서 타겟으로 지정
			local short_dist = 9999
			local cur_index = 0

			for i = 0, monster_list.Count - 1 do
				if not monster_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					local cur_dist = (buster_turret.Position - monster_list[i].Position).magnitude

					if cur_dist < short_dist then
						short_dist = cur_dist
						cur_index = i
					end
				end
			end

			target = monster_list[cur_index]
			angle = self:get_angle(target.Position, center_pos)

			if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
				turret_angle = 0
				turret_dir = 'up'
			elseif angle > 135 and angle < 225 then
				turret_angle = 270
				turret_dir = 'left'
			elseif angle > 225 and angle < 315 then
				turret_angle = 180
				turret_dir = 'down'
			else
				turret_angle = 90
				turret_dir = 'right'
			end

			-- 360도로 넘어가는 예외 처리
			if last_angle == 270 then
				if turret_angle == 0 then
					turret_angle = 360
				end
			end

			-- 0도에서 270도로 갈때 예외 처리
			if last_angle == 0 then
				if turret_angle == 270 then
					turret_angle = -90
				end
			end

			if last_angle ~= turret_angle then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.rotate_buster_turret, self, last_angle, turret_angle, turret_dir))
			end
		elseif is_attack and timer > attack_duration then
			timer = 0
			is_attack = false

			local target_dist = (target.Position - buster_turret.Position).magnitude
			local current_angle = self:get_angle(target.Position, center_pos)

			-- 적이 사정거리 안에 들어와 있고 플레이어와 적이 모두 살아 있는 경우 공격
			if target_dist < dist_limit and math.abs(current_angle - angle) < angle_limit and
					not target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
					not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lightning_strike_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

				local fire_effect_pos

				if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[0]
				elseif angle > 135 and angle < 225 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[3]
				elseif angle > 225 and angle < 315 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[2]
				else
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[1]
				end

				local effect_angle = 180 - self:get_angle(target.Position,
						vector(fire_effect_pos.x, 0, fire_effect_pos.z + 0.7))

				local dir = target.Position - fire_effect_pos
				local dist = dir.magnitude
				local scale = dist / effect_origin_length

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_fire_effect_preset):Instantiate(fire_effect_pos)

				target_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_effect_preset):Instantiate(
						target.Position + vector(0, 3, -2))
				target_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(effect_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
				target_effect.transform.localScale = vector(scale, 1, 1)

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = self.ally_list[AllyIndex.sohee]
				damage_info.target = target
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_per_hp)
				damage_info.direction = dir.normalized

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end

			if turret_angle ~= 360 then
				last_angle = turret_angle
			else
				last_angle = 0
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 이펙트 사라질 때까지 유예 기간
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if target_effect ~= nil then
		target_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	end
end

-- 2개의 벡터로 angle 구하기 (기준선은 x y 사분면에서 우측 좌표 x축이 0도, 시계 반대방향으로 증가)
function local_class:get_angle(target, start)
	local dir = vector(target.x - start.x, target.z - start.z)

	local sign
	if target.z < start.z then
		sign = -1
	else
		sign = 1
	end

	return unity_class.vector2.Angle(unity_class.vector2.right, dir) * sign
end

-- 버스터 터렛 회전
function local_class:rotate_buster_turret(start_angle, end_angle, dir)
	local sohee = self.ally_list[AllyIndex.sohee]
	local buster_turret = get_field_object(self.buster_turret_name)
	local buster_turret_axis = buster_turret.Transform:GetChild(0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local rotate_duration = 0.5

	local is_change_dir = false
	local change_dir_duration = 0.25

	local center_pos = vector(119.5, 0, 46.2)
	local length_x = 0.6
	local height = 1.2
	local length_z = 0.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < rotate_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / rotate_duration
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		buster_turret_axis.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, cur_angle, 0))

		local cur_x = center_pos.x - length_x * math.sin(cur_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
		local cur_z = center_pos.z - length_z * math.cos(cur_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

		character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(cur_x, height, cur_z))

		if not is_change_dir and unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= change_dir_duration then
			is_change_dir = true

			character_util.set_direction(sohee, dir)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local dest_angle = end_angle

	if dest_angle == 360 then
		dest_angle = 0
	elseif dest_angle == -90 then
		dest_angle = 270
	end

	buster_turret_axis.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, dest_angle, 0))

	local cur_x = center_pos.x - length_x * math.sin(dest_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
	local cur_z = center_pos.z - length_z * math.cos(dest_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

	character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(cur_x, height, cur_z))
end

-- 공주 방벽 생성하기 전에 하늘로 떠오르는 연출
function local_class:float_princess()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local float_duration = 2

	local start_pos = self.barrier_princess.Position
	local end_pos = vector(114.5, 6, 47)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < float_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, float_duration)

		character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, end_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 해당 인베이더가 반복해서 보호막 공격 하는 연출
function local_class:attack_barrier_repeat(attacker, x, is_push)
	local dest_z = 57.5

	-- 특정 z값까지 이동
	character_util.set_position(attacker, vector(x, 0, dest_z + 6))

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	if is_push then
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(x, 0, dest_z - 0.3))
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(x, 0, dest_z))
	end

	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(attacker, waypoint_list, 6, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	-- 공격 혹은 밀기 반복
	while true do
		if attacker.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
			if is_push then
				character_util.shake(attacker, 0.04, 9999)
				character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'push' })
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.attack_invader, self, attacker, 'attack', 0.3))
			end

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 인베이더 단순 공격 연출, 언제든지 1프레임만에 캔슬 가능하도록
function local_class:attack_invader(invader, attack_anim, remove_anim_delay, no_deviate)
	while self.is_battle do
		local no_deviate_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(no_deviate, false)

		if not no_deviate_val then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.3, 0.2)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = attack_anim, loop = false })

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local stop = false
		local duration = 0.3

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_light_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.barrier_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		stop = false
		duration = remove_anim_delay - 0.3

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(invader)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		stop = false
		duration = 0.2

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 강화 인베이더 쓰러트리면 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:defeat_invaders_2(wait_duration)
	self.is_battle = false

	local dark_magician = get_character(self.dark_magician_name)

	for i = 0, self.ally_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.ally_list[i])
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.ally_list[AllyIndex.future_princess])

	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	-- 카메라 설정
	camera_util.move_async(vector(114.5, 0, 49), 0)

	-- NPC 설정
	self:set_allies_last()

	-- 아군 회복
	for i = 0, self.ally_list.Count - 1 do
		-- 힐
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = self.ally_list[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.sender = self.ally_list[i]
		heal_info.target = self.ally_list[i]

-- 보호막 반복해서 강력하게 공격 받는 연출
function local_class:damaged_barrier_repeat_strong()
	local timer = 1
	local duration = 1

	while self.is_battle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damaged_barrier_with_tint_and_shake, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 보호막 공격 받는 연출
function local_class:damaged_barrier_with_tint_and_shake()
	field:Tint(self.tint_key_princess, unity_color({ 1, 0.4, 0.4, 1 }), 0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	character_util.shake(self.barrier_princess, 0.08, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.barrier_princess, vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.2, 0.1)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.barrier_princess, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.barrier_princess, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(self.barrier_princess, { name = 'unique/fly_damaged', loop = false, next_anim = 'unique/fly_idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_princess)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

	local dest_z = 58

	wait_for_sec(attack_delay)

	-- 특정 z값 위에 배치된 인베이더들은 아래로 내려감, 이미 특정 z값에 배치된 인베이더들은 일정시간 대기 후 공격 시작
	if invader.Position.z > dest_z then
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(invader.Position.x, 0, dest_z))

		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'walk' })
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader, waypoint_list, 6, false,
				'stop', 'floor', 'down')
	else
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack1', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	end

	local timer = 1
	local duration = 1

	local is_effect = false
	local effect_duration = 0.5

	-- 공격 반복
	while self.is_battle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0
			is_effect = false

			if mod == 0 then
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack1', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			else
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack2', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			end
		elseif not is_effect and timer >= effect_duration then
			is_effect = true

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.barrier_hit_big_effect_preset):Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.5))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.stop(invader)
end

function local_class:fall_down_sohee()
	local sohee = self.ally_list[AllyIndex.sohee]

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_linda_scream_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(sohee, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(sohee, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(sohee, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 소히 추락
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.5

	local start_pos = sohee.Position
	local end_pos = vector(124, 0, 49)

	-- 자유낙하 및 friction
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, sohee.Position.y, 0)
	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, sohee.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 5000, 0.3)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_x = friction:GetDistance()

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, fall_duration)

		character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(start_pos.x + cur_x, start_pos.y + cur_y, cur_z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_trip_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(sohee.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.shake(sohee, 0.04, 2)
	character_util.set_position(sohee, end_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'prostrate' })
end

-- 버스터 터렛 데미지 입는 연출
function local_class:damaged_buster_turret()
	local buster_turret = get_field_object(self.buster_turret_name)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	buster_turret:Shake(0.04, 1)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local push_duration = 0.7

	local start_pos = buster_turret.Position
	local end_pos = buster_turret.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < push_duration do
		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, push_duration)

		buster_turret.Position = vector(cur_x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local back_duration = 0.3

	end_pos = start_pos
	start_pos = buster_turret.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < back_duration do
		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, back_duration)

		buster_turret.Position = vector(cur_x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	buster_turret.Position = start_pos
end

function local_class:check_ally_death()
	local ally_lived_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 0, self.ally_list.Count - 1 do
		if i ~= AllyIndex.craig or i ~= AllyIndex.lavi then
			ally_lived_list:Add(self.ally_list[i])
		end
	end

	while self.is_battle and ally_lived_list.Count > 0 do
		-- 동료 확인해서 죽었을 경우
		for i = 0, ally_lived_list.Count - 1 do
			-- Immortal 상태라 피 1이면 죽은 것임
			if ally_lived_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.die_ally, self, ally_lived_list[i]))

				ally_lived_list:RemoveAt(i)

				break

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:game_over()
	-- 전투 종료
	self.is_battle = false

	local battle = stage.BattleManager:CreateBattleInstance()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent.Create(false, battle))

	for i = 0, self.monster_list_3.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.monster_list_3[i])
	end

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 1)

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 2, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	local gameover_ui = nil

			self.resholder, "ui/stage/gameover", "gameover_bg", function(prefab)
				gameover_ui = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				gameover_ui.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform.parent

				gameover_ui.transform.localPosition = vector(0, ydiff, 0)

		background_camera.orthographicSize = stage_camera.Size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_game_over', state = 'event' })

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameover_ui)

	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, false)

	coroutine.yield(self:just_dream())

		character_util.remove_anim(self.monster_list_1[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.monster_list_1[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.monster_list_2.Count - 1 do

		character_util.remove_anim(self.monster_list_2[i])

		character_util.set_position(self.monster_list_3[i], vector(999, 0, 999))

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.in_tent_event_zone_name then
		local tent_exit = get_field_object(self.tent_exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, tent_exit)
	elseif zone_name == self.out_tent_event_zone_name then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_intro_shivermore_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(162, 0, 48.5))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.stage_exit) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_exit, self))

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)  then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'battle_1_intro' and not self.battle_1_event_start then
			self.battle_1_event_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_event, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.battle_1_start and e.FullEnter then
			self.battle_1_start =true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_start_set, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'bn_event_1' and not self.refugee_bn_event_1_start and e.FullEnter then
			self.refugee_bn_event_1_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.refugee_bn_event_1, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'camp_wagon_event' and not self.camp_wagon_event_on and e.FullEnter then
			self.camp_wagon_event_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camp_wagon_event, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'camp_refugee_event' and not self.camp_refugee_event_on and e.FullEnter then
			self.camp_refugee_event_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camp_refugee_event, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'aisha_speech' and not self.aisha_event_start and e.FullEnter then
			self.aisha_event_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.aisha_event, self))

		end

	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.has_battle_1_over then
			self.has_battle_1_over = true
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'aisha', vector(46.5, 0.5, 32))

		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 총알 로드
function local_class:preload_bullet_async()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		  self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
			 custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			 custom_atlas:Initialize()
		  end)
	self.sniper_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 총알 리소스 해제
function local_class:dispose_bullet()
	if self.sniper_bullet ~= nil then
	   self.sniper_bullet:Dispose()
	   self.sniper_bullet = nil
	end
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
	   self.res_holder:Dispose()
	   self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 샷 연출
function local_class:shoot_to_target(start_pos, target, callback)
	local target_pos = target.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0.5)
	local bullet_speed = 100
	local effect_scale_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 1.1
	local effect_delay_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 0.5
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local end_pos = target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3
	local target_hit_hour = unity_class.vector3.Distance(start_pos, end_pos) / bullet_speed
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
		  * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	local fx_rotation_2 = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
	   if target_hit_hour > effect_delay_ratio then
		  wait_for_sec(target_hit_hour - effect_delay_ratio)
		  local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
				:Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.position, fx_rotation_2, nil)
		  smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
	   else
		  local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
				:Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation_2, nil)
		  smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
	   end
	end))
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
		  start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	if callback ~= nil then
	   callback()
	end
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
		  end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

-- 난민들 랜덤한 애니메이션/ 점프 구동 함수
function local_class:refugee_random_acting()
	local refugee_list = {}

	-- 병목현상 난민 npc 리스트
	for i = 1, 15 do
		local temp = get_character('refugee_bn_' .. i)
		table.insert(refugee_list, temp)
	end

	-- s18에서 이동하는 난민 npc 리스트
	for i = 1, 8 do
		if i ~= 4 or i ~= 5 then
			local temp = get_character('refugee_' .. i)
			table.insert(refugee_list, temp)
		end

	end

	local rand_refugee_1 = 1

	local double_jump = function(fo)
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		if rand == 1 then
			character_util.show_emoticon(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 'annoyed')
		elseif rand == 2 then
			character_util.show_emoticon(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 'angry')
		else
			character_util.show_emoticon(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 'sweat')
		end

		if self.get_holdup_status(fo) then
			character_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 0.5)
		else
			self:normal_double_jump(fo, true)
		end
	end

	local rand_r_1 = 1

	while self.refugee_rand_acting_on do
		rand_refugee_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #refugee_list)

		if rand_refugee_1 ~= rand_r_1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(double_jump, refugee_list[rand_refugee_1]))
		end
		rand_r_1 = rand_refugee_1
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

	end

end

-- 수레 회전 이동
function local_class:move_and_rot_wagon(fo, duration, start_pos, target_pos, start_rot, target_rot, stat)
	local time_passed = 0
	local wagon_ani = fo.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	if stat then
		wagon_ani:Play('wagon_roll_R')

	else
		wagon_ani:Play('wagon_roll')

	end

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		local rot = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rot, target_rot, time_passed / duration)
		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(rot)

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wagon_ani:Play('wagon_idle')

	fo.Transform.localRotation =  unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target_rot)
	fo.Position = target_pos
end

-- 수레만 움직이기
function local_class:move_wagon(fo, duration, start_pos, target_pos, stat)
	local time_passed = 0
	local wagon_ani = fo.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	if stat then
		wagon_ani:Play('wagon_roll_R')

	else
		wagon_ani:Play('wagon_roll')

	end

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wagon_ani:Play('wagon_idle')

	fo.Position = target_pos
end

-- 수레 회전
function local_class:rot_wagon(fo, duration, start_rot, target_rot)
	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		local rot = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rot, target_rot, time_passed / duration)
		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(rot)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	fo.Transform.localRotation =  unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target_rot)
end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_zone_enter_event, self, e))

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

		if e.Zone.Name == 'meet_aisha' and not self.see_aisha_over then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_aisha, self))

			self.battle_2_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_2_start, self))

		end
	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('aisha')) then
			if not self.aisha_talk_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_aisha, self))

function local_class:free_fall(character)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 1.2
	character_util.set_position(character, character.Position + vector(0, 10, 0), true)
	local start_pos = character.Position

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, character.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(character, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.heavenhold_obj_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_big_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					vector(37, 0, -15.5))
		-- 이전 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					vector(20.5, 0, -36.5))
		end

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

		-- 컨트롤러에서 처리하는 프로젝타일 발사 루틴 프리로드 (controller 리소스 로드 완료되면 진행되어야 하므로 여기서 실행)
		for i = 6, 9 do
			self.controller:preload_shooter(self.invader_list[i])
		end

		-- 이펙트 생성
		self.smoke_effect_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)

		local smoke_effect_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(54, 0, 29))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(58, 0, 24))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(73, 0, 31.5))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(69.5, 0, 17))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(70, 0, 3.5))
		smoke_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(74.5, 0, -4.5))

		for i = 0, self.smoke_effect_num - 1 do
			self.smoke_effect_list:Add(
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset):Instantiate(smoke_effect_pos_list[i]))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	if self.fire_sfx ~= nil then
		self.fire_sfx:Stop()
		self.fire_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.resistance_defense_list = nil
	self.invader_list = nil
	self.monster_list = nil
	self.invader_resistance_dict = nil

	self.resistance_defense_original_pos_list = nil

	-- 연기 제거
	if self.smoke_effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 0, self.smoke_effect_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.smoke_effect_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.smoke_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
			end
		end

		self.smoke_effect_list = nil
	end

	if self.camera_smoke_effect ~= nil then
		self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()

		self.camera_smoke_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.shelter_area_1_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.shelter_1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.shelter_1

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shelter_1_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_area_2_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.shelter_2 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.shelter_2

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shelter_2_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_area_3_event_zone_name then
		if self.fire_sfx ~= nil then
			self.fire_sfx:Stop()
			self.fire_sfx = nil
		end

		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.shelter_3 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.shelter_3

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shelter_3_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.battle then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.battle

			self:battle_event()
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(20.5, 0, -36.5))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

		-- 맵 전반부에는 전투 구역이 없어서 전투 음악 복구 안해도 무방하지만 혹시 이전 구역에 배틀 존 생길 수 있으니 추가함
		if self.off_battle_bgm then
			self.off_battle_bgm = false

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.return_battle_bgm, self))
		end

		if self.is_enter_war_zone then
			self.is_enter_war_zone = false

			self:leave_war_zone()
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.past_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(37, 0, -15.5))
	elseif zone_name == self.exit_shelter_event_zone_name then
		if self.fire_sfx ~= nil then
			self.fire_sfx:Stop()
			self.fire_sfx = nil
		end
		self.fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

		if not self.off_battle_bgm then
			self.off_battle_bgm = true

			music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
		end

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(76.5, 0, 0))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

		if not self.is_enter_war_zone then
			self.is_enter_war_zone = true

			self:enter_war_zone()
		end

		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.convert_monster then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.convert_monster

			-- 페이드 아웃 되는 시간 0.6초 뒤에 재생되도록
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.6)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_fight_01')
			end))

			-- 대피소 나오면 레지스탕스와 인베이더 전투 이벤트 전부 실행한다
			self:resistance_background_event()

			-- 레지스탕스 하나 날아가는 이벤트
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.resistance_knockback_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_bgm_on_zone_name then
		if self.off_battle_bgm then
			self.off_battle_bgm = false

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.return_battle_bgm, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_bgm_off_zone_name then
		if not self.off_battle_bgm then
			self.off_battle_bgm = true

			music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party_leader) and
		e.Info.type & (CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.WallHit) == CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
		for i = 0, self.invader_list.Count - 1 do
			if i ~= 8 and i ~= 9 and i ~= 15 and i ~= 16 then
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.invader_list[i]) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

					--- 유저의 영웅의 패시브 능력등을 추가로 발동시키지 않기 위해 패시브 플래그를 달아줌
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
					damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
					damage_info.target = self.invader_list[i]
					damage_info.damage = self.invader_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
					damage_info.direction = (self.invader_list[i].Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized

					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 레지스탕스들과 싸우고 있는 인베이더를 쓰러트린 경우, 레지스탕스 전투 종료 후 플레이어에게 감사 인사
	for i = 0, self.invader_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.invader_list[i]) then
			self:battle_finished_event(i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.ending

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders, self))
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정
function local_class:setting()
	-- 레지스탕스 NPC 설정
	for i = 1, self.resistance_body_num do
		local cur_body = get_character(self.resistance_body_name..i)
		local mod = i % 2

		if mod == 0 then
			-- ......
			cur_body.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_7'
		else
			-- 윽...
			cur_body.Interactable.Talk = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_8'
		end
	end

-- 마리아가 2구역 난민들에게 보급품 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:maria_throw_items()
	local maria = get_character(self.maria_name)

	while self.event_progress <= EventProgress.shelter_2 do
		local cur_item_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(1, #self.maria_item_id_list + 1))

		local cur_refugee_index = math.floor(
				unity_class.random.Range(self.shelter_refugee_2_num_start, self.shelter_refugee_2_num_end + 1))
		local cur_refugee = get_character(self.shelter_refugee_name_2..cur_refugee_index)

		character_util.look_at(maria, cur_refugee)
		character_util.set_anim(maria, { name = 'throw', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = maria.Position, target = cur_refugee.Position,
				  itemid = self.maria_item_id_list[cur_item_index], notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(maria)

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_get_drop_item_01', play_pos = cur_refugee.Position })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(cur_refugee.Position)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(drop_item)

		-- 아이템 이름 라벨을 띄워준다.
		local item_name = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(self.maria_item_id_list[cur_item_index]).Name
		CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(cur_refugee):JustPrintItemName(game_string:GetString(item_name))

		if self.event_progress > EventProgress.shelter_2 then
			break
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(maria, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(maria, { name = 'cast' })
end

-- 전투 지역 입장 시 이펙트, 틴트 등 추가
function local_class:enter_war_zone()
	-- 비 내리는 이펙트, 사운드 제거
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { self.deactivate_rain_custom_event }))

	-- 연기 추가
	self.camera_smoke_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_big_preset):Instantiate(
			stage_camera.transform.position + vector(-7, 0, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	-- 화면 틴트
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.7}), 0)
end

-- 전투 지역 퇴장 시 이펙트, 틴트 등 제거
function local_class:leave_war_zone()
	-- 연기 제거
	if self.camera_smoke_effect ~= nil then
		self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	end

	-- 화면 틴트 해제
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key)
end

-- 레지스탕스 오른쪽 그리드에서 날아오는 이벤트
function local_class:resistance_knockback_event()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local knockback_resistance = get_character(self.resistance_name..1)

	-- 으아아아악!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_victim_scream_02', parent = knockback_resistance, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(knockback_resistance,
			{
				key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s1_22',
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				screen_pos = vector(120, 300),
			})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	knockback_resistance.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(knockback_resistance, vector(59, 7, 26), true)
	character_util.set_anim(knockback_resistance, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(knockback_resistance, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 넉백
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {-1, 0, 0},
			20000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, knockback_resistance, knock_back_info, nil)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local freefall_duration = 0.7

	local start_pos = knockback_resistance.Position

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(freefall_duration, start_pos.y, 0)

	character_util.spine_rotate(knockback_resistance, 360, freefall_duration)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < freefall_duration do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(knockback_resistance, vector(knockback_resistance.Position.x, start_pos.y + cur_y, knockback_resistance.Position.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_01', parent = knockback_resistance, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_02', parent = knockback_resistance, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(knockback_resistance.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(knockback_resistance.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(knockback_resistance)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(knockback_resistance)
	character_util.set_position(knockback_resistance, vector(knockback_resistance.Position.x, 0, knockback_resistance.Position.z))
	character_util.set_anim(knockback_resistance, { name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	knockback_resistance.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:return_battle_bgm()
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat' })

	-- BGM 리셋했는데 플래그가 다시 꺼진 경우, BGM 리셋하는 동안 다시 BGM 제거 상태로 들어간 것이므로 다시 끈다.
	if self.off_battle_bgm then
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
	end
end

-- 전투 연출 중인 적을 쓰러트렸을 경우, 대상 적과 싸우고 있던 레지스탕스도 전투 종료하고 감사 표시
function local_class:battle_finished_event(index)
	local cur_invader = self.invader_list[index]

	-- 연출은 컨트롤러에서 하고 있는 관계로 컨트롤러에 연출 중지 요청
	self.controller:stop_battle(cur_invader.Name)

	-- index 기반으로 전투 중인 레지스탕스 찾아냄
	if self.invader_resistance_dict:ContainsKey(cur_invader.Name) then
		self:resistance_thank_to_player(
				CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(self.invader_resistance_dict, cur_invader.Name), false)
	end
end

-- 플레이어에게 감사를 표시하는 레지스탕스
function local_class:resistance_thank_to_player(cur_resistance_name, no_talk)
	local cur_resistance = get_character(cur_resistance_name)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(cur_resistance)
	character_util.stop_shake(cur_resistance)
	character_util.set_direction(cur_resistance, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(cur_resistance.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(cur_resistance, { name = 'success' })
	character_util.set_emotion(cur_resistance, { name = 'smile' })

	if not no_talk then
		local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))

		if rand == 0 then
			-- 감사합니다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cur_resistance, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_9' })
		else
			-- 고마워요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cur_resistance, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_10' })
		end
	end
end

-- BATTLE_2 구역에 입장하면 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:battle_event()
	if self.fire_sfx ~= nil then
		self.fire_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.fire_sfx = nil
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 전투 연출 종료
	for i = 0, self.invader_list.Count - 1 do
		-- 연출은 컨트롤러에서 하고 있는 관계로 컨트롤러에 연출 중지 요청
		self.controller:stop_battle(self.invader_list[i].Name)
	end
end

-- BATTLE_2 구역의 인베이더들을 전부 쓰러트리면 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:defeat_invaders()
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 비 내리는 이펙트, 사운드 추가
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { self.activate_rain_custom_event }))
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 3)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 연기 제거
	for i = 0, self.smoke_effect_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.smoke_effect_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.smoke_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	if self.camera_smoke_effect ~= nil then
		self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	end

	camera_util.move(vector(76.5, 0, 1), 0)

	party_util.align_party(vector(76, 0, 0.5), 'right', 0, 'arc')

	-- 불 제거
	for i = 1, self.fire_num do
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.fire_obj_name..i, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 레지스탕스 연출용 NPC들 설정
	local resistance_leader = get_character(self.resistance_name..1)

	local resistance_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 2, 5 do
		resistance_list:Add(get_character(self.resistance_name..i))
	end

	character_util.set_position(resistance_leader, vector(75, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(resistance_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'smile' })

	local resistance_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	resistance_pos_list:Add(vector(74.25, 0, 1.5))
	resistance_pos_list:Add(vector(74.5, 0, -0.5))
	resistance_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, 1))
	resistance_pos_list:Add(vector(74, 0, 0))

	for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(resistance_list[i], resistance_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(resistance_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim(resistance_list[i])
	end

	local invader_deco_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	invader_deco_pos_list:Add(vector(76, 0, -1))
	invader_deco_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, 3))
	invader_deco_pos_list:Add(vector(79, 0, 2))
	invader_deco_pos_list:Add(vector(72, 0, -1.5))

	for i = 1, self.invader_deco_num do
		local cur_invader = get_character(self.invader_deco_name..i)

		character_util.set_position(cur_invader, invader_deco_pos_list[i - 1])

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(cur_invader, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(cur_invader, 'left')
		end

		character_util.set_anim(cur_invader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_invader, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	-- 레지스탕스 NPC 설정
	for i = 1, self.resistance_body_num do
		local cur_body = get_character(self.resistance_body_name..i)
		character_util.set_active_state(cur_body, 'disabled')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(resistance_leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 당신...강하군요! 얼굴은 헤실헤실한데...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_11', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'sing' })
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'smile' })

	for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(resistance_list[i], { name = 'victory_extra' })
		character_util.set_emotion(resistance_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end

	-- 정말 고마워요, 덕분에 공습을 막아냈어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_12', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(resistance_leader, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(resistance_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_list[i])
	end

	-- ...우리 초면 맞죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_13', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'cast' })

	character_util.set_anim(resistance_list[3], { name = 'question', loop = false })

	-- 어디서 본 것 같기도 하고?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_14', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_leader)

	for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(resistance_list[i])
	end

	local wait_for_branch = true
	local selection = 0
	local select_num = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 여긴 어디? / 당신들은 누구?
	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s2_15"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			selection = 0
			select_num = select_num + 1
		end}

	local talk_branch_2 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s2_16"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			selection = 1
			select_num = select_num + 1
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

	while select_num ~= 2 do
		selection = -1
		wait_for_branch = true

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.refugee_partner, branches)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		if selection == 0 then
			character_util.jump(resistance_leader, 1, 0.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
			character_util.jump(resistance_leader, 1, 0.5)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
			character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'surprise' })

			-- ...농담하는 거죠?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_17', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'cast2' })
			character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'attack' })

			for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.remove_anim(resistance_list[i])
				character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_list[i])
			end

			-- 이 곳은 인류 최후의 방어선.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_18', skip = true })

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 비 내리는 이펙트, 사운드 제거
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { self.deactivate_rain_custom_event }))

			-- 부유성 전경 이펙트 로드
			local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
			local heavenhold_background = nil

			yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
					resholder, 'ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/theatre/theatre_heavenhold_future', 'theatre_heavenhold_future', function(prefab)
						heavenhold_background = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
						heavenhold_background.transform.localPosition = vector(-100, 0, 0)
						heavenhold_background.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

						-- 배경이 캐릭터 뒤로 가도록 레이어 설정
						CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(heavenhold_background.transform, "Default")

						-- 카메라는 Stage것을 사용할 것이므로 비활성화
						heavenhold_background.transform:GetChild(0):GetChild(0).gameObject:SetActive(false)
					end)

			local inn_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.heavenhold_obj_preset):Instantiate(vector(-105.6, 0, -8.5))
			local building = inn_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.InteractableBuilding))
			building:SetSprite('building_landmark_inn_lv1', 1)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(inn_obj.transform, "Default")
			inn_obj.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

			-- 카메라 설정
			camera_util.move_async(vector(-105.6, 0, -10), 0)
			camera_util.resize_to(8, 0)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
			camera_util.resize_to(15, 2)

			wait_for_sec(2)

			-- 헤븐홀드잖아요...!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader,
					{
						key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_19',
						bubble_type = 'shout',
						screen_pos = vector(-75, 100),
						scale = 4,
						skip = true
					})

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 비 내리는 이펙트, 사운드 추가
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { self.activate_rain_custom_event }))

			-- 부유성 전경 화면 종료
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(heavenhold_background)

			inn_obj:Dispose()

			resholder:Dispose()

			camera_util.move(vector(76.5, 0, 1), 0)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'shoot' })
			character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'attack' })

			-- 힘든 시기지만 머리가 헤실헤실해지면 끝이라구요!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_20', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_leader)

			-- 정신 바짝 차려요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_21', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(resistance_leader)

			branches:Remove(talk_branch_1)
		else
			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })
			character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'attack' })

			for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_anim(resistance_list[i], { name = 'salute', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' })
				character_util.set_emotion(resistance_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
			end

			-- 우리는 레지스탕스!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_22', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_leader)

			for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.remove_anim(resistance_list[i])
				character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_list[i])
			end

			-- 오래 전, 평화를 수호하던 가디언즈의 유지를 이어받아...
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_23', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(resistance_leader, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(resistance_leader, { name = 'attack' })

			for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_emotion(resistance_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
			end

			-- 인베이더와 맞서 싸우고 있는 최후의 저항군이죠.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_leader, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s2_24', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(resistance_leader)
			character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_leader)

			for i = 0, resistance_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.remove_anim(resistance_list[i])
				character_util.remove_emotion(resistance_list[i])
			end

			branches:Remove(talk_branch_2)
		end
	end

	wait_for_branch = true

	branches:Clear()
	branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 오늘 날짜가 어떻게 되죠?
	local talk_branch = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s2_25"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch)

	choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'zombie_scene' then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fight
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zombie_meet, self))
			end

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_3' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_fight, self))
		end
	end

	return false

function local_class:move_fx(fx_cast_name, fx_end_name, start_pos, target_pos, duration, endbool)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration
	local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_cast_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if endbool then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_end_name):Instantiate(target_pos)
	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:shoot_missile(start_pos, end_pos, duration, use_unscaledtime)

	local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local rot = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)

	-- 발사 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', play_pos = start_pos
	})

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Missile_small_Proj'):Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
	local trail = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Missile_small_Proj_contrail'):Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)

	local tp = 0
	while (tp < duration) do
		local progress = tp / duration

		missile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		trail.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		if use_unscaledtime then
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		else
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 타격 sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_explosion_02', play_pos = end_pos
	})

	missile:Dispose()
	trail:TriggeredDispose()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Missile_small_Explosion'):Instantiate(end_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

	local cb = function ()
		self.super_4.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		self.super_4.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)
	end

	cb()
end
