	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter then
		if zone_name == self.s21_event_zone_name and self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_craig_sohee
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self, true))
		elseif zone_name == 'section_21_crowd' and self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle and not self.crowd_sfx_zone_stat then
			self.crowd_sfx_zone_stat = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crowd_sfx, self))

		end

	end

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ally_list[AllyIndex.craig]) and self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_craig_sohee
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self, false))

	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_1 then
		if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_1, self))
		else
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.battle_1
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_2 then
		if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_2, self))
		else
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.battle_2
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.battle_finish_flag == BattleFinishFlag.battle_1 then
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.none

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_1, self))
		elseif self.battle_finish_flag == BattleFinishFlag.battle_2 then
			self.battle_finish_flag = BattleFinishFlag.none

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_2, self))
		end
	end
end

	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

function local_class:set_event_resistance_first()
	local first_pos = {
		vector(-46.5, 1, -2.5), vector(-57, 0, -3), vector(-30, 0, -3), vector(-30, 0, -4), vector(999, 0, 999),
		vector(-57, 0, -4), vector(-47.3, 0, -2), vector(-47.3, 0, -1), vector(-29, 0, 1.5), vector(-29, 0, -3),

	s21_box_1.Position = vector(-29, 0, -4)

	for i = 0, self.resistance_list.Count - 1 do

		elseif i == 2 then
			character_util.set_position(self.resistance_list[i], vector(999, 0 , 999))
			character_util.set_direction(self.resistance_list[i], 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_list[i], { name = 'push' })

		elseif i == 3 then
			character_util.set_position(self.resistance_list[i], first_pos[i+1])
			character_util.set_direction(self.resistance_list[i], 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_list[i], { name = 'eat' })

		elseif i == 4 then
			character_util.set_position(self.resistance_list[i], first_pos[i+1])
			character_util.set_direction(self.resistance_list[i], 'right')

		elseif i == 5 then

			character_util.set_direction(self.resistance_list[i], 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(self.resistance_list[i], { name = 'eat' })

		end

	end

function local_class:battle_event(zone_enter_flag)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.ally_list[AllyIndex.future_princess])

	if self.ally_list[AllyIndex.craig].Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.ally_list[AllyIndex.craig].Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	for i = 1, self.ally_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.ally_list[i])
	end
	local duration = 0.5

	if zone_enter_flag then
		for i = 6, self.resistance_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.remove_anim(self.resistance_list[i])

			if i <= 10 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.move_and_disappear, self, self.resistance_list[i], self.resistance_list[i].Position + vector(-7, 0, 1), 1, true))

		-- 공주님! 지금까지 어디에…!

		character_util.set_emotion(self.ally_list[AllyIndex.craig], {name = 'idle', loop = true})

		-- 힐
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = self.ally_list[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

-- 해당 인베이더가 반복해서 보호막 공격 하는 연출
function local_class:attack_barrier_repeat(attacker, x, is_push)
	local dest_z = 57.5 - 49

	-- 특정 z값까지 이동
	character_util.set_position(attacker, vector(x, 0, dest_z + 6))

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	if is_push then
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(x, 0, dest_z - 0.3))
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(x, 0, dest_z))
	end

	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(attacker, waypoint_list, 6, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	-- 공격 혹은 밀기 반복
	while true do
		if attacker.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
			if is_push then
				character_util.shake(attacker, 0.04, 9999)
				character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'push' })
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.attack_invader, self, attacker, 'attack', 0.3))
			end

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 인베이더 단순 공격 연출
function local_class:attack_invader(invader, attack_anim, remove_anim_delay, no_deviate)
	while self.is_battle do
		local no_deviate_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(no_deviate, false)

		if not no_deviate_val then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(invader, vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.3, 0.2)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = attack_anim, loop = false })

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local stop = false
		local duration = 0.3

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_light_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.barrier_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		stop = false
		duration = remove_anim_delay - 0.3

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(invader)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		stop = false
		duration = 0.2

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
			if not self.is_battle then
				stop = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 버스터 터렛 공격
function local_class:buster_turret_attack(monster_list, damage_per_hp)
	local buster_turret = get_field_object(self.buster_turret_name)
	local center_pos = vector(-38.5, 0, -2.8)

	local timer = 0
	local attack_delay = 2
	local attack_duration = 1
	local is_attack = false

	local effect_origin_length = 3.2
	local dist_limit = 10
	local angle_limit = 60

	local turret_angle_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	turret_angle_list:Add(0)
	turret_angle_list:Add(90)
	turret_angle_list:Add(180)
	turret_angle_list:Add(-90)

	local fire_effect_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(-38.5, 1, -0.9))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(-37, 1,  -2.75))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(-38.5, 1, -4.4))
	fire_effect_pos_list:Add(vector(-40.2, 1, -2.75))

	-- 타겟 조준 발사를 위한 변수
	local target_effect
	local target
	local last_angle = 0
	local angle = 0

	local turret_angle = 0
	local turret_dir = 'up'

	while self.is_battle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not is_attack and timer > attack_delay then
			timer = 0
			is_attack = true

			-- 플레이어 죽은 경우에는 소리 재생 X
			if not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fox_ball_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_ready_effect_preset):Instantiate(buster_turret.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

			-- 근처에 있는 적 한 명 잡아서 타겟으로 지정
			local short_dist = 9999
			local cur_index = 0

			for i = 0, monster_list.Count - 1 do
				if not monster_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					local cur_dist = (buster_turret.Position - monster_list[i].Position).magnitude

					if cur_dist < short_dist then
						short_dist = cur_dist
						cur_index = i
					end
				end
			end

			target = monster_list[cur_index]
			angle = self:get_angle(target.Position, center_pos)

			if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
				turret_angle = 0
				turret_dir = 'up'
			elseif angle > 135 and angle < 225 then
				turret_angle = 270
				turret_dir = 'left'
			elseif angle > 225 and angle < 315 then
				turret_angle = 180
				turret_dir = 'down'
			else
				turret_angle = 90
				turret_dir = 'right'
			end

			-- 360도로 넘어가는 예외 처리
			if last_angle == 270 then
				if turret_angle == 0 then
					turret_angle = 360
				end
			end

			-- 0도에서 270도로 갈때 예외 처리
			if last_angle == 0 then
				if turret_angle == 270 then
					turret_angle = -90
				end
			end

			if last_angle ~= turret_angle then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.rotate_buster_turret, self, last_angle, turret_angle, turret_dir))
			end
		elseif is_attack and timer > attack_duration then
			timer = 0
			is_attack = false

			local target_dist = (target.Position - buster_turret.Position).magnitude
			local current_angle = self:get_angle(target.Position, center_pos)

			-- 적이 사정거리 안에 들어와 있고 플레이어와 적이 모두 살아 있는 경우 공격
			if target_dist < dist_limit and math.abs(current_angle - angle) < angle_limit and
					not target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
					not user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lightning_strike_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

				local fire_effect_pos

				if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[0]
				elseif angle > 135 and angle < 225 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[3]
				elseif angle > 225 and angle < 315 then
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[2]
				else
					fire_effect_pos = fire_effect_pos_list[1]
				end

				local effect_angle = 180 - self:get_angle(target.Position,
						vector(fire_effect_pos.x, 0, fire_effect_pos.z + 0.7))

				local dir = target.Position - fire_effect_pos
				local dist = dir.magnitude
				local scale = dist / effect_origin_length

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_fire_effect_preset):Instantiate(fire_effect_pos)

				target_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_effect_preset):Instantiate(
						target.Position + vector(0, 3, -2))
				target_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(effect_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
				target_effect.transform.localScale = vector(scale, 1, 1)

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = self.ally_list[AllyIndex.sohee]
				damage_info.target = target
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_per_hp)
				damage_info.direction = dir.normalized

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end

			if turret_angle ~= 360 then
				last_angle = turret_angle
			else
				last_angle = 0
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 이펙트 사라질 때까지 유예 기간
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if target_effect ~= nil then
		target_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	end
end

-- 2개의 벡터로 angle 구하기 (기준선은 x y 사분면에서 우측 좌표 x축이 0도, 시계 반대방향으로 증가)
function local_class:get_angle(target, start)
	local dir = vector(target.x - start.x, target.z - start.z)

	local sign
	if target.z < start.z then
		sign = -1
	else
		sign = 1
	end

	return unity_class.vector2.Angle(unity_class.vector2.right, dir) * sign
end

-- 버스터 터렛 회전
function local_class:rotate_buster_turret(start_angle, end_angle, dir)
	local sohee = self.ally_list[AllyIndex.sohee]
	local buster_turret = get_field_object(self.buster_turret_name)
	local buster_turret_axis = buster_turret.Transform:GetChild(0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local rotate_duration = 0.5

	local is_change_dir = false
	local change_dir_duration = 0.25

	local center_pos = vector(-38.5, 0, -2.8)
	local length_x = 0.6
	local height = 1.2
	local length_z = 0.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < rotate_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / rotate_duration
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		buster_turret_axis.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, cur_angle, 0))

		local cur_x = center_pos.x - length_x * math.sin(cur_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
		local cur_z = center_pos.z - length_z * math.cos(cur_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

		character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(cur_x, height, cur_z))

		if not is_change_dir and unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= change_dir_duration then
			is_change_dir = true

			character_util.set_direction(sohee, dir)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local dest_angle = end_angle

	if dest_angle == 360 then
		dest_angle = 0
	elseif dest_angle == -90 then
		dest_angle = 270
	end

	buster_turret_axis.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, dest_angle, 0))

	local cur_x = center_pos.x - length_x * math.sin(dest_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)
	local cur_z = center_pos.z - length_z * math.cos(dest_angle * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad)

	character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(cur_x, height, cur_z))
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.object_setting, self))
	self:stew_event_setting()

end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.evacuateRefugee ~= nil then
		self.evacuateRefugee.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('event_resistance_9').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('event_resistance_9').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('kantabury_refugee_1').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('kantabury_refugee_1').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('headache_soldier').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('headache_soldier').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('headache_soldier_2').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('headache_soldier_2').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('root_resistance_4').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('root_resistance_4').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(get_character('root_resistance_5').Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		get_character('root_resistance_5').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	for i = 7, 8 do
		local customer = get_character('stew_customer_'..i)
		local resi = get_character('event_resistance_'..i)
		if lua_helper.type_compare(customer.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			customer.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

			resi.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	if self.siren ~= nil then
		self.siren:Dispose()
		self.siren = nil
	end

	self.siren_sound = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'meet_favi_lavi' and not self.meet_favi_lavi_over then
			self.meet_favi_lavi_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_favi_lavi, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'innuit' and self.progress == self.progress_enum.lavi and not self.zone_in_list[1] then
			self.zone_in_list[1] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_raid_zone_in, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus' then
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.first and not self.zone_in_list[2] then
				self.zone_in_list[2] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_raid_zone_in, self))
			elseif self.succubus_event_over == false and self.progress <= self.progress_enum.first then
				self.succubus_event_over = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.succubus_zone_stage, self))
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'shen' then
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.second and not self.zone_in_list[3] then
				self.zone_in_list[3] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shen_raid_zone_in, self))
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'desert' and self.progress == self.progress_enum.second and not self.zone_in_list[4] then
			self.zone_in_list[4] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.desert_raid_zone_in, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'fourth_raid_zone' then
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third and not self.zone_in_list[5] then
				self.zone_in_list[5] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fourth_raid_zone_in, self))
			elseif self.progress < self.progress_enum.third and not self.kanterbury_event_over then
				self.kanterbury_event_over = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kanterbury_refugee_event, self))
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'resistance_says_dont_go' and not self.resistance_saying then
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.fourth then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_over, self))
			elseif not self.resistance_saying then
				self.resistance_saying = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.resistance_says_dont_go, self))
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'training_zone' then
			if not self.training_zone_in then
				self.training_zone_in = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.training_zone_event, self))
			end
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third and not self.zone_in_list[5] then
				--타임 체크 늘리기
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_time_over_when_kanterbury, self))
			end

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'headache_soldier_zone' and not self.headache_soldier_event then
			self.headache_soldier_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_patient, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'resistance_camp_b_zone' then
			if not self.resistance_camp_b_event then
				self.resistance_camp_b_event = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.resistance_camp_b_emergency, self))
			end
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third and not self.zone_in_list[5] then
				--타임 체크 늘리기
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_time_over_when_kanterbury, self))
			end

        elseif e.Zone.Name == 'square_zone' and not self.square_event then
            self.square_event = true
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.square_zone_event, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'stew_zone' and not self.see_stew_zone_event then
			self.see_stew_zone_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stew_event, self, event_type))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' then
			if not self.BATTLE_1_in then
				self.BATTLE_1_in = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.BATTLE_1_start, self))
			end

			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third and not self.zone_in_list[5] then
				--타임 체크 늘리기
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_time_over_when_kanterbury, self))
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'innuit' then
			if self.progress == self.progress_enum.lavi then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_raid_clear, self))
			elseif self.progress == self.progress_enum.first then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_raid_clear, self))
			elseif self.progress == self.progress_enum.second then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.third_raid_clear, self, 'shen'))
			end

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'desert' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.third_raid_clear, self, 'desert'))

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.BATTLE_1_clear, self))

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'training_zone' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.training_zone_clear, self))

		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('square_refugee_kid')) then
			if not self.grandma_talk_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fourth_raid_clear, self))
				return true
			end
		else
			self:check_interact_event(e.Target)
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.IsComplete
			and e.TimerId == CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.time_over, self))
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_player_revive, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_player_destroyed, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		self:main_grid_in_out_event(e.CameraGrid.name, true)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'stew_grid' and self.see_stew_grid_event == false then
			self.see_stew_grid_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stew_event, self, event_type))
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'shen_grid' and self.shen_move_1 == false and self.progress <= self.progress_enum.first then
			self.shen_move_1 = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shen_refugee_move, self, event_type))
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'succubus_grid' and self.succubus_zone == false and self.progress <= self.progress_enum.lavi then
			self.succubus_zone = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.succubus_zone_event, self, event_type))
		elseif e.CameraGrid.name == 'siren_grid' and self.siren_sound == nil then
			self.siren_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_02', loop = true,
			fade_in_time = 2, fade_out_time = 2})
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		self:main_grid_in_out_event(e.CameraGrid.name, false)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'siren_grid' and self.siren_sound ~= nil then
			self.siren_sound:Stop()
			self.siren_sound = nil
		end
	end


	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.evacuateRefugee ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.evacuateRefugee.gameObject)
		self.evacuateRefugee = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:character_spine_force_update(character)
	character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

end

function local_class:section_over()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	self.fire_loop_sound:Stop()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('last')
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

end

		self.soldier_talk1=true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_save1, self))

		if  get_character('stew_customer_8').Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			get_character('stew_customer_8').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end

			get_character('event_resistance_8').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stew_save, self, 8))

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('event_resistance_9')) then
		if target.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			target.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_refugee_talk_anim_go_up, self,
		target, true, 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_65', 'victory_extra', 'smile', {vector(-117.06, 0, -49.27), vector(-109.06, 0, -49.27)}, 1, true))

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('root_resistance_4')) then

		target, true, 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_65', 'victory_extra', 'smile', vector(-44, 0, -63), 1, true))

--인터랙트 하면 말 한마디 하고, 죽는다.
function local_class:interact_refugee_talk_and_die(character, talk_key)

	character_util.shake(character, 0.02, 999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, { key = talk_key, skip = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	character.SpineController:AddColor(character.Name, self.die_color, 1, 1)

	character_util.stop_shake(character)
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false, scale = 10 })

end

--인터랙트 하면 말 한마디 하고, 애니메이션 하나 하고, 정해진 동선을 따라 퇴장하고, 난민 OR 병사 게이지 올라가는 NPC 함수
function local_class:interact_refugee_talk_anim_go_up(character, is_healing, talk_key, anim_key, emo_key, pos_list, number, is_soldier)
	character_util.stop_shake(character)
	if is_healing then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
		local first_aid = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = 20099, notforinven = true, pos = user_party.Leader.Position, target = character.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})

		wait_for_sec(1)

		first_aid.ConsumeTarget = character

		character.SpineController:HealGreenPulse()
		music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '02_magic_heal_02', loop = false, playPosition = character.Position})
		local heal_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a'):Instantiate(character.Position)
		heal_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		heal_fx:Dispose()
	end

	character_util.mario_jump_async(character, character.Direction, 0.5, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	character_util.look_at(character, user_party_leader)

	if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		if character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state.Data.SkeletonData:FindAnimation(anim_key..'_back') == nil then
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = anim_key, loop = true })
		end
	elseif character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		if character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state.Data.SkeletonData:FindAnimation(anim_key..'_front') == nil then
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = anim_key, loop = true })
		end
	else
		if character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state.Data.SkeletonData:FindAnimation(anim_key..'_side') == nil then
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = anim_key, loop = true })
		end
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(character, {name = emo_key, loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, { key = talk_key, skip = false, type_speed = 0})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_waypoint(character, pos_list, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	if is_soldier then
		self:increase_soldier_count(number)
	else
		self:increase_save_count(number)
	end
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.stop(character)
	character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0)

end

function local_class:settingEvacuateRefugee()

		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/ui/stage', 'EvacuateRefugee'), function(p)
			local gaugeObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)

-- 타이머 시간 초과 시에 불림
function local_class:time_over()
	-- FadeOut 위치 초기화 및 기타 세팅 되돌리는 부분
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil then
	   local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
	   for i = 0, battle.Enemies.Count - 1 do
		  local monster = battle.Enemies[i].Character
		  character_util.stop(monster)
	   end
	   for i = battle.Allies.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		  local ally = battle.Allies[i].Character
		  character_util.stop(ally)
	   end
	   stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
	end

	self:show_evacuation(false)
	self:stop_timer()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 2.2)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_dark_magician_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.red, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.time_out, self))

end

function local_class:innuit_attacked()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.7, 2)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--세팅
	self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform
	self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(-7, 0, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-48, 0, -110.5), 0, {ignorecameragrids = true})
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0)

	local invader_dir = {'left', 'up', 'right', 'left', 'right', 'left', 'down', 'down', 'right', 'down'}

	--공격당하는 장면
	for i = 1, self.innuit_raid_num do

		character_util.set_position(invader, self.invader_innuit_pos[i] + vector(0, 100, 0))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_direction(invader, invader_dir[i])

		 self.invader_innuit_is_killing[i], i, invader))

	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local innuit = get_character('innuit_refugee_'..i)

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'seat', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
		else
			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
		end
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(innuit, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		if i % 3 == 0 then
			character_util.shake(innuit, 0.03, 999)
			if i == 3 then
				character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'down')
			end

		elseif i % 3 == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'left')
		end
	end

	get_field_object('innuit_fire_5').transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_fight_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.innuit_soldier_coming, self))

	--세팅

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	user_party:ResetControllers()

function local_class:character_invader_fight(character, invader, zone_num)
	local rand = 0
	local fx = nil

	rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.5, 2)
	wait_for_sec(rand)

	character_util.look_at(character, invader)
	character_util.look_at(invader, character)

	local dir_vec = nil

	if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		dir_vec = vector(1, 0, 0)

	elseif character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		dir_vec = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		dir_vec = vector(0, 0, -1)
	elseif character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		dir_vec = vector(0, 0, 1)
	end

	local count = 0

	while self.grid_in_list[zone_num] == true and self.zone_in_list[zone_num] == false do
		rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 1)
		if count < 2 then
			character_util.normal_jump(character)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 1})
			character_util.move_to(character, invader.Position - dir_vec * 0.4, 0.2, nil, false, false)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			if self.grid_in_list[zone_num] == false and self.zone_in_list[zone_num] == true then
				character_util.remove_anim(character)
				character_util.remove_anim(invader)
				break
			end
			character_util.move_to(invader, invader.Position + dir_vec * 0.4, 0.2, nil, false, false)
			fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

			invader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			invader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

			character_util.set_anim(invader, {name = 'damaged', loop = true, scale = 1})

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			character_util.remove_anim(invader)
			character_util.remove_anim(character)
			fx:Dispose()
			count = count + 1
		else
			character_util.normal_jump(invader)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.set_anim(invader, {name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 1})
			character_util.move_to(invader, character.Position + dir_vec * 0.4, 0.2, nil, false, false)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			if self.grid_in_list[zone_num] == false and self.zone_in_list[zone_num] == true then
				character_util.remove_anim(character)
				character_util.remove_anim(invader)
				break
			end
			fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			character_util.move_to(character, character.Position - dir_vec * 0.4, 0.2, nil, false, false)
			character.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			character.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

			character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'damaged', loop = true, scale = 1})
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			character_util.remove_anim(invader)
			character_util.remove_anim(character)
			fx:Dispose()
			count = count + 1
			if count > 3 then
				count = 0
			end
		end
		wait_for_sec(rand + 1)
	end
end

function local_class:innuit_attacking_invader(iskilling, number, character)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local fx = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.25 * number)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_invader_beam_01')
	if number == 3 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_02')
	end
	fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Event_InvaderBeam'):Instantiate(vector(character.Position.x, 0, character.Position.z))
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_position(character, character.Position + vector(0, -100, 0))
	local innuit = nil
	if iskilling> 0 then
		innuit = get_character('innuit_refugee_'..iskilling)
		character_util.look_at(character, innuit)
		character_util.look_at(innuit, character)
		character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		if iskilling % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'scared', loop = true})
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'surprise', loop = true})
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	if iskilling > 0 then

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if number == 7 then
			character_util.stop_shake(innuit)
			character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'spear_attack3', loop = false, scale = 1})
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')

			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'physics', true, vector(0, 0, -1), 15000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

			local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(innuit, knock_back_info)

			innuit.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			innuit.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

			local invader = get_character('invader_common_8')
			character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(innuit, {vector(invader.Position.x + 0.7, 0, invader.Position.z),

			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 1})
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')

			invader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			invader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
			character_util.set_anim(invader, {name = 'damaged', loop = true, scale = 1})

			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_direction(invader, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(invader, {name = 'cast2', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.normal_double_jump(invader)

		elseif number == 9 then
			character_util.set_anim(innuit, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'surprise', loop = true})

			character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'spear_attack3', loop = false, scale = 1})
			wait_for_sec(0.25)

				'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 15000, 0.05,

			local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(innuit, knock_back_info)

			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'damaged', loop = true})

--불 사이즈 키우는 함수
function local_class:fire_size_up(key)
	local fire = get_field_object(key)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = 1.5
	local start = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local target = vector(2, 2, 2)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fire.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start, target, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--두번째 상황 진입
function local_class:second_raid_zone_in()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveEmergencyMarker('second_emergency')
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('second')
	for i = 1, 5 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('succubus_gate_'..i, true))
	end

	for i = 1, self.succubus_raid_num do
		local invader = get_character('invader_common_'..i)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		character_util.remove_anim(invader)
	end

	while stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() == nil do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 2, 6 do
		local succubus = get_character('succubus_refugee_'..i)
		character_util.set_immortal(succubus, true)
		character_util.remove_anim(succubus)
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(succubus)
	end

end

--두번째 상황 클리어 시 함수
function local_class:second_raid_clear()
	self:stop_timer()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	local succubus_1 = get_character('succubus_refugee_1')
	local succubus_2 = get_character('succubus_refugee_2')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, 5 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('succubus_gate_'..i, true))
	end

	local succubus_1_pos = succubus_1.Position

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, succubus_1_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0))

	local succubus_pos = {vector(0.7, 0, 0), vector(0, 0, 1), vector(-1, 0, 0.6), vector(-1, 0, -0.6), vector(0, 0, -1)}
	for i = 2, 6 do
		local succubus = get_character('succubus_refugee_'..i)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(succubus)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus)
		character_util.set_position(succubus, succubus_1_pos + succubus_pos[i-1])

		if succubus_pos[i - 1].x > 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'left')
		elseif succubus_pos[i - 1].x < 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'right')
		elseif succubus_pos[i - 1].x == 0 then
			if succubus_pos[i - 1].z < 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'up')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'down')
			end
		end
		character_util.remove_anim(succubus)
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
	end

	character_util.set_anim(succubus_2, {name = 'seat', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_2, {name = 'tired', loop = true})

	camera_util.move_async(succubus_2.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0), 1)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')

	self:show_evacuation(false)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--마야… 그곳에서도 좋은 꿈만 꾸기를…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, {key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_25', skip = true})

	--어서 대피소로 가야해!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_26', 'mercy' }})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	--그래… 네 말이 맞아.
	character_util.set_anim(succubus_2, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_2, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, {key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_27', skip = true})

	local succubus_pos = {vector(0.3, 0, 0.2), vector(-0.3, 0, 0.2), vector(-0.3, 0, -0.2), vector(0.3, 0, -0.2)}
	--주변으로 이동.
	for i = 3, 6 do
		local succubus = get_character('succubus_refugee_'..i)
		character_util.remove_anim(succubus)
		if succubus_pos[i-2].x > 0 then
			if i == 6 then
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(succubus, succubus_1_pos + succubus_pos[i-2], 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
			else
				character_util.move_waypoint(succubus, succubus_1_pos + succubus_pos[i-2], 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
			end
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(succubus, succubus_1_pos + succubus_pos[i-2], 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
		end
	end
	--시체를 들어올리는 서큐버스들
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	for i = 3, 6 do
		local succubus = get_character('succubus_refugee_'..i)

		character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'right')
	end

	character_util.move_to(succubus_1, succubus_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 7), nil, 3, false, false)

function local_class:smoke_effect_off()
	self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.parent = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_big_fc').Transform

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local remove_duration = 5

	local start_pos = self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition
	local z_diff = -18

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < remove_duration do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, z_diff, remove_duration)

		self.camera_smoke_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(start_pos.x, start_pos.y, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	self.camera_smoke_effect = nil

end

--몬스터 전부 리바이브 시키기
function local_class:revive_check_for_monster(zone_name)
	if zone_name == 'innuit' then
		for i = 1, self.innuit_raid_num do
			local invader = get_character('invader_common_'..i)
			self:revive_monsters(invader, self.invader_innuit_pos[i], self.invader_innuit_dir[i])
		end
		local soldier_pos = {vector(-47.12, 0, -108.45), vector(-45.74, 0, -109.58), vector(-43.73, 0, -109.98), vector(-41.47, 0, -111.22), vector(-41.22, 0, -108.74)}

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local soldier = get_character('soldier_innuit_'..i)
			character_util.set_position(soldier, soldier_pos[i])
		end

		-- 해당 전투 그리드 내에 있던, 없던 초기화 해야 함.
		self.zone_in_list[1] = false

	elseif zone_name == 'succubus' then
		for i = 1, self.succubus_raid_num do
			local invader = get_character('invader_common_'..i)
			self:revive_monsters(invader, self.invader_succubus_pos[i], self.invader_succubus_dir[i])
		end

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local succubus = get_character('succubus_refugee_'..i)
			character_util.set_position(succubus, self.succubus_refugee_pos[i])
		end

		-- 해당 전투 그리드 내에 있던, 없던 초기화 해야 함.
		self.zone_in_list[2] = false

	elseif zone_name == 'shen' then
		for i = 1, self.shen_raid_num do
			local invader = get_character('invader_common_'..i)

			self:revive_monsters(invader, self.invader_shen_pos[i], self.invader_shen_dir[i])
		end

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local shen = get_character('china_refugee_'..i)
			character_util.set_position(shen, self.shen_refugee_pos[i])
		end

		-- 해당 전투 그리드 내에 있던, 없던 초기화 해야 함.
		self.zone_in_list[3] = false
		self.shen_clear = false

	elseif zone_name == 'desert' then
		for i = 1, self.desert_raid_num do
			local invader = get_character('invader_desert_'..i)
			self:revive_monsters(invader, self.invader_desert_pos[i], self.invader_desert_dir[i])
		end

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local desert = get_character('desert_refugee_'..i)
			character_util.set_position(desert, self.desert_refugee_pos[i])
		end

		-- 해당 전투 그리드 내에 있던, 없던 초기화 해야 함.
		self.zone_in_list[4] = false
		self.desert_clear = false
	end

	if not self.BATTLE_1_eliminated and self.BATTLE_1_in then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_1_gate_'..i, true))
		end
		--배틀1 존 들어갔지만 처치는 다 못 한 상황이므로, 배틀1 존에서 타임오버 된 상황임을 알 수 있다.
		local training_pos = {vector(-72.5, 0, -72.5), vector(-74.5, 0, -72.5), vector(-70.5, 0, -72.5), vector(-73, 0, -73.5), vector(-71.5, 0, -73.5)}
		local training_dir = {'up', 'up', 'up', 'up', 'up'}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local invader = get_character('battle_1_'..i)

			self:revive_monsters(invader, training_pos[i], training_dir[i])
		end
		local resi_pos = {vector(-74.06, 0, -70.3), vector(-72.24, 0, -70.34), vector(-70.66, 0, -70.16)}
		local resi_dir = {'down', 'down', 'down'}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local resi = get_character('battle_1_refugee_'..i)
			resi.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			if i == 1 then
				character_util.set_position(resi, resi_pos[i])
				character_util.set_direction(resi, resi_dir[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(resi, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
				character_util.set_anim(resi, { name = 'release' })
			else
				character_util.set_position(resi, resi_pos[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(resi, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
				character_util.set_direction(resi, resi_dir[i])
				character_util.remove_anim(resi)
			end
		end
		self.BATTLE_1_in = false

	elseif not self.training_zone_eliminated and self.training_zone_in then
		for i = 1, 6 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('training_gate_'..i, true))
		end
		--트레이닝 존 들어갔지만 처치는 다 못 한 상황이므로, 트레이닝 존에서 타임오버 된 상황임을 알 수 있다.
		local training_pos = {vector(-44, 0, -50.5), vector(-41, 0, -50.5), vector(-42.5, 0, -50.5), vector(-46, 0, -49.5), vector(-39, 0, -49.5)}
		local training_dir = {'left', 'right', 'up', 'left', 'right'}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local invader = get_character('training_zone_'..i)

			self:revive_monsters(invader, training_pos[i], training_dir[i])
		end
		local resi_pos = {vector(-44, 0, -47), vector(-46, 0, -48), vector(-45, 0, -49)}
		local resi_dir = {'down', 'right', 'up'}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local resi = get_character('running_resistance_'..i)
			resi.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			if i == 1 then
				character_util.set_position(resi, resi_pos[i])
				character_util.set_direction(resi, resi_dir[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(resi, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
				character_util.set_anim(resi, { name = 'release' })
			else
				character_util.set_position(resi, resi_pos[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(resi, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
				character_util.set_direction(resi, resi_dir[i])
				character_util.remove_anim(resi)
			end
		end

		self.training_zone_in = false
	end

end

--몬스터 리바이브 관련 함수
function local_class:revive_monsters(monster, pos, dir)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = monster
	heal_info.target = monster
	heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
	monster.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(monster, pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
	character_util.set_direction(monster, dir)
end

--플레이어 리바이브 시
function local_class:on_player_revive()
	if self.progress == self.progress_enum.lavi then
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		self:show_refugee(true)
		self:stop_timer()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
		self:start_single_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_1'), self.innuit_timer)
	elseif self.progress == self.progress_enum.first then
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		self:show_refugee(true)
		self:stop_timer()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
		self:start_single_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_2'), self.succubus_timer)
	elseif self.progress == self.progress_enum.second then
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		self:show_refugee(true)
		self:stop_timer()
		if self.shen_clear then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
			self:start_single_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_4'), self.shen_desert_timer)
		elseif self.desert_clear then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
			self:start_single_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_3'), self.shen_desert_timer)
		else
			self:start_dual_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_3'), game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_4'), self.shen_desert_timer)
		end
	elseif self.progress == self.progress_enum.third and not self.zone_in_list[5] then
		self:show_evacuation(true)
		self:show_refugee(true)
		self:stop_timer()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
		self:start_single_area_timer(game_string:GetString('futurecastle_main_a_s22_refugee_name_5'), self.kantabury_timer)
	end
end

function local_class:on_player_destroyed()
	self:show_evacuation(false)
	self:show_refugee(false)
	self:stop_timer()
	self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
end

--훈련장 : 같이 싸우는 식으로?
function local_class:training_zone_event()

	for i = 1, 6 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('training_gate_'..i, true))
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local invader = get_character('training_zone_'..i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end

	while stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() == nil do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local resi = get_character('running_resistance_'..i)
		character_util.set_immortal(resi, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(resi)
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(resi)
	end
end

function local_class:training_zone_clear()
	for i = 1, 6 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('training_gate_'..i, true))
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local resi = get_character('running_resistance_'..i)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(resi)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(resi)
		resi.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		if i == 3 then
			character_util.look_at(resi, user_party_leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(resi, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
			character_util.set_anim(resi, {name = 'cast', loop = true, scale = 1})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resi, {key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_65', skip = false, type_speed = 0})
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local resi = get_character('running_resistance_'..i)

function local_class:kanterbury_panic(character)
	local rand = 0
	while true do
		rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
		character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(character, character.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 4 + rand, false, 'stop', nil, 'right')
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
		wait_for_sec(rand)
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
		wait_for_sec(rand)
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(character, character.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 4 + rand, false, 'stop', nil, 'left')
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
		wait_for_sec(rand)
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
		wait_for_sec(rand)
		if self.progress == self.progress_enum.third then
			return
		end
	end

end

function local_class:stew_refugee_resi_after_save(character, is_customer)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	if is_customer then
		self:increase_save_count(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(character)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(character, {vector(-76.8, 0, character.Position.z), vector(-76.8, 0, -90.5), vector(-96, 0, -90.5),
	vector(-96, 0, -85.5)}, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		character_util.move_waypoint(character, character.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.stop(character)
		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0)

	else
		self:increase_soldier_count(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(character)
		if character.Position.z < -71 then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(character, {vector(-74, 0, character.Position.z), vector(-74, 0, -79.5)}, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(character, {vector(-71, 0, character.Position.z), vector(-71, 0, -79.5)}, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint(character, character.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.stop(character)
		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0)
	end
end

-- 스튜 방 이벤트 사전 세팅
function local_class:stew_event_setting()
	-- 스튜방 이벤트 불리언
	self.see_stew_zone_event = false
	self.see_stew_grid_event = false

	-- 스튜 고객(난민) 세팅
	self.stew_cus_list = {}

	for i = 1, 6 do
		if i == 1 or i == 3 or i == 5 then
			--더미 캐릭터
			table.insert(self.stew_cus_list, get_character('favi'))
		else
			local temp = get_character('stew_customer_' .. i)
			table.insert(self.stew_cus_list, temp)
			self.stew_cus_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.remove_anim(self.stew_cus_list[i])

			if i > 2 then
				-- 도망갈 얘들
				character_util.set_emotion(self.stew_cus_list[i], {name = 'tired'})

			else
				-- 업혀갈 얘들
				character_util.set_emotion(self.stew_cus_list[i], {name = 'damaged'})
				character_util.set_anim(self.stew_cus_list[i], {name = 'prostrate', loop = true})
				character_util.set_direction(self.stew_cus_list[i], 'left')

			end
		end
	end

	-- 스튜 레지스탕스 세팅
	self.stew_res_list = {}
	local res_pos = {
		vector(-77, 0 , -90.5), vector(-79, 0 , -89), vector(-73, 0 , -88.5), vector(-71.5, 0 , -88.5)
	}
	for i = 4, 6 do
		local temp = get_character('event_resistance_'.. i)
		table.insert(self.stew_res_list, temp)

		character_util.remove_anim(temp)
		if i % 2 == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(temp, 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(temp, 'right')
		end

		if i <= 5 then
			character_util.set_position(temp, res_pos[i - 1])
			character_util.set_emotion(temp, {name = 'tired'})
			character_util.set_anim(temp, {name = 'eat', loop = true})
			temp.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		else
			character_util.set_position(temp, res_pos[i - 4])
			character_util.set_anim(temp, {name = 'release', loop = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(temp, {name = 'attack'})

		end

	end

end

-- 스튜 존 엔터 이벤트 세팅
function local_class:stew_event(event_type)
    local holdup_refugee = function(res_1, res_2, ref)
        local duration = 0.3
        -- local time_passed = 0
        character_util.set_anim(res_1, {name = 'hold_loop', loop = true, upper = true})
        character_util.set_anim(res_2, {name = 'hold_loop', loop = true, upper = true})
        character_util.move_to(res_1, res_1.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), duration, nil, false, false, false)
        character_util.move_to(res_2, res_2.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), duration, nil, false, false, false)
        character_util.move_to(ref, ref.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), duration, nil, false, false, false)
        wait_for_sec(duration)
        character_util.set_direction(res_1, 'left')
        character_util.set_direction(res_2, 'left')
    end
    local move_holdup_refugee = function(res_1, res_2, ref, loot, dur)
        character_util.move_to(res_1, loot + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), dur, nil, true, true, false)
        character_util.move_to(res_2, loot + vector(0.25, 0, 0), dur, nil, true, true, false)
        character_util.move_to(ref, loot + vector(0, 1, 0), dur, nil, false, false, false)
    end
    local fade_move_holdup_ref = function(res_1, res_2, ref, loot, dur)
        character_util.move_to(res_1, loot + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), dur, nil, true, true, false)
        character_util.move_to(res_2, loot + vector(0.25, 0, 0), dur, nil, true, true, false)
        character_util.move_to(ref, loot + vector(0, 1, 0), dur, nil, false, false, false)
        character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(res_1, 0, dur)
        character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(res_2, 0, dur)
        character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ref, 0, dur)
        wait_for_sec(dur)
        character_util.set_active_state(res_1, 'disabled')
        character_util.set_active_state(res_2, 'disabled')
        character_util.set_active_state(ref, 'disabled')
        character_util.set_direction(res_1, 'right')
        character_util.set_direction(res_2, 'right')
    end
    local move_to_shelter = function(fo, loot_list, dest_list, speed)
        character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, loot_list, speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
        character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, dest_list[1], speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
        character_util.move_to(fo, dest_list[2], 0.5, nil, true, true, false)
        character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, 0.5)
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
        character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
    end
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        -- 여러분, 이 쪽으로 대피하십시오!
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.stew_res_list[3], {
            key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s22_stew_1',
            skip = false,
        })
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
            holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2]))
        wait_for_sec(1)

        local holdup_move_2 = function ()
            local loot_list_2 = {
                vector(-77, 0, -88.5),
                vector(-77, 0, -90.5),
                vector(-96, 0, -90.5),
                vector(-96, 0, -87),
                vector(-96, 0, -85.5),
                vector(-95, 0, -85.5)
            }
            local dur = 0.6
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                move_holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[1], dur))
            wait_for_sec(dur)
            dur = 0.4
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                move_holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[2], dur))
            wait_for_sec(dur)
            dur = 2.5
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                move_holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[3], dur))
            wait_for_sec(dur)
            dur = 0.5
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                move_holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[4], dur))
            wait_for_sec(dur)
            dur = 0.3
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                move_holdup_refugee, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[5], dur))
            wait_for_sec(dur)
            dur = 0.3
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
                fade_move_holdup_ref, self.stew_res_list[1], self.stew_res_list[2], self.stew_cus_list[2], loot_list_2[6], dur))
        end
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(holdup_move_2))
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
        local loot_ref_2 = {
            vector(-76, 0, -93.29), vector(-76, 0, -91), vector(-96, 0, -91)
        }

        local loot_ref_4 = {vector(-96, 0, -90)}
        local dest_pos= {
            vector(-96, 0, -85.5),
            vector(-95, 0, -85.5)
        }

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
            move_to_shelter, self.stew_cus_list[4], loot_ref_2, dest_pos, 5))

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
            move_to_shelter, self.stew_cus_list[6], loot_ref_4, dest_pos, 5))
    end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local dark_magician = get_character(self.dark_magician_name)

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.barricade_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fight
				--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders_2, self))
			end

		end
	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_end, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dark_magician) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_talk, self))
		end

	end

	return false
end

-- 방벽 확장
function local_class:grow_barrier()

	--[[
	-- 방벽 생성
	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(-43.5, 0, -2)
	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.princess_barrier_obj:SetActive(true)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local make_barrier_duration = 0.25

	local start_z = -2
	local end_z = 8

	local start_scale = 0
	local end_scale = 1.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < make_barrier_duration do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_z, end_z - start_z, make_barrier_duration)

		local cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_scale, end_scale - start_scale, make_barrier_duration)

		self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(-43.5, 0, cur_z)
		self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(-43.5, 0, end_z)
	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * end_scale

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	shrink_barrier_duration = 1

	start_scale = 1.5
	end_scale = 1

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < make_barrier_duration do
		local cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_scale, end_scale - start_scale, make_barrier_duration)

		self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	]]


	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(-43.5, 0, 8)
	self.princess_barrier_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1
	self.princess_barrier_obj:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:civil_run_inv6(target)
	local x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-12, 12)
	local y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-10, 10)
	local num = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-15, 15)
	local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-2, 2)

	x = x/10.0 + 0.25
	y = y/10.0 + 1

	if target ~= self.ally_list[AllyIndex.craig] and target ~= self.ally_list[AllyIndex.lavi] then
		character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-43.5 + rand, 0, target.Position.z), nil, 7)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-43.5 + rand, 0, 0.5), nil, 8, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-40.5, 0, 0.5), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-40.5, 0, 1), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(target)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.move_to_async(target, self.monster_list_3[6].Position + vector(x, y, 0), 0.3, nil)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'sword_attack_dash' })
	character_util.spine_rotate(target, num, 0)

	if x > 0.25 then
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
	end
	character_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999)


	--target.Transform:SetParent(self.monster_list_3[6].Transform)
	while self.battle_end do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(self.monster_list_3[6].Position + vector(x, y, 0))

		wait_for_sec(0.75)

function local_class:float_princess()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local float_duration = 2

	local start_pos = self.barrier_princess.Position
	local end_pos = vector(-43.5, 4, -2)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < float_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, float_duration)

		character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, end_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 강화 인베이더들이 내려가서 공격하는 이벤트
function local_class:go_down_strengthen_invader(invader, attack_delay, mod)
	local dest_z = 8.5

	wait_for_sec(attack_delay)

	-- 특정 z값 위에 배치된 인베이더들은 아래로 내려감, 이미 특정 z값에 배치된 인베이더들은 일정시간 대기 후 공격 시작
	if invader.Position.z > dest_z then
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(invader.Position.x, 0, dest_z))

		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'walk' })
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader, waypoint_list, 6, false,
				'stop', 'floor', 'down')
	else
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack1', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	end

	local timer = 1
	local duration = 1

	local is_effect = false
	local effect_duration = 0.5

	-- 공격 반복
	while self.is_battle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0
			is_effect = false

			if mod == 0 then
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack1', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			else
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'attack2', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
			end
		elseif not is_effect and timer >= effect_duration then
			is_effect = true

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.barrier_hit_big_effect_preset):Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.5))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.stop(invader)
end

-- 방어막 깨져서 공주가 추락하는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_princess()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 1

	local start_pos = self.barrier_princess.Position

	-- 자유낙하
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, self.barrier_princess.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.barrier_princess.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.set_position(self.barrier_princess, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
end

-- 아이언 티탄 걷는 함수. IronTeatans.March() 참조
function local_class:ironteatan_move(wps, speed, angular_speed, playerjump)
	local getcomponent_generic = xlua.get_generic_method(CS.UnityEngine.GameObject, 'GetComponent')
	local getcomponent_anim = getcomponent_generic(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	local animator = getcomponent_anim(self.iron_teatans.gameObject)
	--yield_return(animator, 'SetBool', 'walk', true)

	---[[
	local tmp = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	tmp.sfxName = '02_iron_teatan_walk_01'
	tmp.loop = true
	tmp.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event
	tmp.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc
	local audioSourceHolder = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(tmp)
	--]]

	local walker = 0;
	local currentPoint = self.iron_teatans.Position
	local nextPoint = wps[walker]
	local radSpeed = math.rad(angular_speed)
	while true do
		local moveSfxOnce = false
		local currentDir = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.AngleAxis(self.iron_teatans.YAngle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward

		local dir = (nextPoint - currentPoint)
		local distance = dir.magnitude
		dir:Normalize()
		if not moveSfxOnce then
			moveSfxOnce = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_turn_01' })
		end
		---[[
		while not currentDir:AlmostCloseTo(dir) do
			currentDir = unity_class.vector3.RotateTowards(currentDir, dir, radSpeed * CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime, 0)
			local rad = math.acos(-currentDir.x * 0.9999)
			if currentDir.z < 0 then
				rad = rad * -1
			end
			if rad == nil then
				CS.Debug.LogError('Acos returned NaN: ' + currentDir.ToString('F3'))
			end

			self.iron_teatans:SetYAngle(math.deg(rad) - 90)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
--]]

		local duration = distance / speed
		local timePassed = 0
		local wholesecs = 0.25

		local first = true

		while (timePassed < duration) do
			if timePassed > wholesecs then
				wholesecs = wholesecs + 1.05
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)
				party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

				if playerjump then
					-- party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)
					if first then
						first = false
						--party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
						camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.IronTeatans.MarchCameraSize, 3)
					end
				end
			end
			timePassed = timePassed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

			local progress = math.min(1, timePassed / duration)
			self.iron_teatans.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(currentPoint, nextPoint, progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		walker = walker + 1
		if walker >= wps.Count then break end

		currentPoint = wps[walker - 1]
		nextPoint = wps[walker]
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	audioSourceHolder:FadeOut(0.1)
	--yield_return(animator, 'SetBool', 'walk', false)
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.rain_screen_effect = nil
	self.rain_ground_effect = nil


	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "futurecastle_1_5"

	self.die_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

	self.dark_magician_portal_name = 'fx_boss_darkmagician_teleport_hurricane'
	self.dark_magician_portal_disappear_name = 'fx_boss_darkmagician_dark_ball_explosion'

end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
	   quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			self.dark_magician_portal_name,
			self.dark_magician_portal_disappear_name
	   )
		-- 비 이펙트 로드
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.resholder, 'effects/stage/weather', 'fx_env_rain_screen_fx', function(prefab)
					self.rain_screen_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.rain_screen_effect.transform:SetParent(stage_camera.Transform.parent)
					self.rain_screen_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
				end)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.resholder, 'ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/effects/futurecastle', 'fx_futurecastle_rain_ripple_1_1', function(prefab)
					self.rain_ground_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.rain_ground_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
				end)

		self.rain_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_rain_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		self:deactivate_rain_effect_and_sound()
	end
end



function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self:on_load_resource()


		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	end

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self:object_setting()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_fight, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
		if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil and self.controller.experimental_destroy_character then
			load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
			self.optimized_npcs = nil
		end


		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s24_ending_scene, self, true))
		end
	end

	return false
end
