function local_class:boss_fight()

	local dark_magician = get_character('dark_magician')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.princess, user_party, true)

	camera_util.move(vector(-170.5, 0, -18), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(-171, 0, -19))
	character_util.set_position(self.princess, vector(-170, 0, -19))
	character_util.set_position(dark_magician, vector(-170.5, 0, -17))

	character_util.remove_anim(dark_magician)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(dark_magician, 'down')

	character_util.remove_emotion(dark_magician)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)

	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')


	field:Tint('tint_key', unity_color({ 0.7, 0.4, 0.4, 1 }), 0)
	field:Tint('tint_key_princess', unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 }), 0)



	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	screen_util.show_boss_title('futurecastle_dark_magician_boss_title', 'futurecastle_dark_magician_boss_subtitle', 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(dark_magician))
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0})

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 1, {use_unscaledtime = false, ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = user_party.Leader})

	character_util.convert_to_monster(dark_magician, 'BATTLE_2')
	-- 보스몬스터로 등록할수 있도록 추가
	CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.BattleManager:AddBossMonsterList(dark_magician)

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(dark_magician, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.rain_screen_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.rain_screen_effect)
		self.rain_screen_effect = nil
	end

	if self.rain_ground_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.rain_ground_effect)
		self.rain_ground_effect = nil
	end

	if self.heavenhold_background ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.heavenhold_background)
		self.heavenhold_background = nil
	end

	if self.rain_sfx ~= nil then
		self.rain_sfx:Stop()
		self.rain_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then

local local_class = newclass('FutureCastleMainPartASection3')

	self.inn_interactable_name = 'inn_entrance'
	self.door_name = 'section_3_door_'

	-- 존 이름
	self.shelter_event_zone_name = 'shelter'
	self.shelter_exit_zone_name = 'section_2_exit_shelter'
	self.shelter_past_event_zone_name = 'section_2_resistance_1'
	self.shelter_next_event_zone_name = 'section_2_resistance_1'
	self.inn_event_zone_name = 'section_3_inn'

	-- 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "futurecastle_main_part_a"
	self.quest_tracker_name_1 = "futurecastle_main_a_s3_tracker_0"
	self.quest_tracker_name_2 = "futurecastle_main_a_s3_tracker_1"

	-- 타임 스케일 키
	self.time_scale_key = 'futurecastle_main_part_a'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"
	self.smoke_effect_preset = "FX_Env_BigRock_lv2_destroy"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					vector(37, 0, -15.5))
		-- 이전 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					self.inn_interactable)
		end

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.inn_interactable)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.mad_panda_list = nil

	self.inn_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.shelter_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
		vector(20.5, 0, -36.5))
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_next_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(118, 0, -36.5))
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_exit_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				self.inn_interactable)
	elseif zone_name == self.inn_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.inn_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.inn_event

			stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.inn_interactable) then
		if self.door_knock_num == 0 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_panda_event_1, self))
		elseif self.door_knock_num == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_panda_event_2, self))
		elseif self.door_knock_num == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_panda_event_3, self))
		elseif self.door_knock_num == 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_panda_event_4, self))
		end

		self.door_knock_num = self.door_knock_num + 1
	end
end

-- 플레이어 파티가 여관 문에 맞고 넉백되서 날아가는 연출
function local_class:knockback_user_party()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = 2

	local start_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		start_pos_list:Add(user_party[i].Position)
	end

	local end_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	end_pos_list:Add(vector(117.5, 0, -38))
	end_pos_list:Add(vector(117.5, 0, -40.5))
	end_pos_list:Add(vector(118.2, 0, -40))
	end_pos_list:Add(vector(116.8, 0, -40))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 720, move_duration)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	-- 이동
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos_list[i].x,
					end_pos_list[i].x - start_pos_list[i].x, move_duration)

			local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos_list[i].y,
					end_pos_list[i].y - start_pos_list[i].y, move_duration)

			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos_list[i].z,
					end_pos_list[i].z - start_pos_list[i].z, move_duration)

			character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z), true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], end_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'confused' })
	end
end

-- 매드팬더 용병단의 플레이어 공격 연출
function local_class:mad_panda_attack()
	local timer = 0.3
	local mad_panda_index = 0
	local delay = 0.3

	local deviate_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	deviate_pos_list:Add(vector(0, 0, -1))
	deviate_pos_list:Add(vector(1, 0, 0))
	deviate_pos_list:Add(vector(-1, 0, 0))

	while self.is_mad_panda_attack do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer > delay then
			timer = 0

			mad_panda_index = mad_panda_index + 1

			if mad_panda_index > 2 then
				mad_panda_index = 0
			end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.attack_routine, self, self.mad_panda_list[mad_panda_index], user_party_leader,
					deviate_pos_list[mad_panda_index]))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 매드 팬더 용병단 공격 세부 연출
function local_class:attack_routine(attacker, victim, deviate_pos)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(attacker, deviate_pos * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, deviate_pos * 0.3, 0.2, 0.1)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
end

end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					vector(37, 0, -15.5))
		-- 이전 섹션에서 시작한 경우
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					self.mad_panda_list[0])
		end

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.mad_panda_list = nil
	self.big_pet = nil

	if self.chain_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.chain_effect)

	end

	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.mad_panda_list[0]) and
			e.Zone.Name == self.throw_item_end_event_zone_name then
		if self.is_throw_item then
			self.is_throw_item = false
		end
	end

	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.shelter_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(20.5, 0, -36.5))
	elseif zone_name == self.shelter_exit_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			self.mad_panda_list[0])
	elseif zone_name == self.chase_start_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.chase_start then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.chase_start

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_start_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		self.is_player_enter_battle_zone = true

		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_battle_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_battle_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
			self.is_player_enter_battle_zone = false
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_use_qte then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.is_qte_success = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'boss_battle' then
			self.is_player_enter_battle_grid = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'boss_battle' then
			self.is_player_enter_battle_grid = false
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.event_progress < EventProgress.end_battle_event then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party_leader) and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.big_pet) then

			if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() < self.big_pet.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.pet_battle_end_hp_per then
				self.event_progress = EventProgress.end_battle_event

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_pet, self))
			end

			return true
		end
	end
end

-- 도망가는 트리오 쫓기 시작하는 이벤트
function local_class:chase_start_event()
	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('section_3_door_' .. i))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trio', state = 'event' })

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop_shake(self.mad_panda_list[i])
		character_util.jump(self.mad_panda_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'scared' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 도망쳐!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.mad_panda_list[0],
			{
				key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_1',
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				screen_pos = vector(150, 200)
			})

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'run' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })

		local mad_panda_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		mad_panda_pos_list:Add(self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(64.5, 0, 0))

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.mad_panda_list[i], mad_panda_pos_list, 7, true,
				'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 물건 던지는 연출 시작
	self.is_throw_item = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_items, self))

	local waited = 0
	while waited ~= self.mad_panda_list.Count do
		waited = 0

		for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.mad_panda_list[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while not self.is_player_enter_battle_grid do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local move_waypoint_list = {
	}
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(move_waypoint_list, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.mad_panda_list[i],
			self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(12, 0, 0), 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true))
	end
	wait_all(move_waypoint_list)

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.normal_jump(self.mad_panda_list[i], true)
		character_util.move_to(self.mad_panda_list[i], self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.3, nil, true, false)
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = self.mad_panda_list[0], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.is_trio_fall_down = true
end

-- 도망치는 트리오가 아이템 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:throw_items()
	self.drop_item_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_drop_items, self))

	local timer = 0
	local throw_delay = 0.5

	while self.is_throw_item do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= throw_delay then
			timer = 0

			local item_id
			local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))

			if rand == 0 then
				item_id = self.cactus_item_id
			else
				item_id = self.banana_item_id
			end

			local rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
			local cur_thrower = self.mad_panda_list[rand_index]

			local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-1.5, 1.5)
			local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-1, 1)

			local rand_pos = vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = cur_thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			local cur_drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = cur_thrower.Position, target = cur_thrower.Position + rand_pos, itemid = item_id,
					  markforpick = false, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

			self.drop_item_list:Add(cur_drop_item)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 드롭 아이템들 거리 확인해서 플레이어가 아이템에 충돌했는지 검출
function local_class:check_drop_items()
	local item_dist_limit = 0.5

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_battle_event do
		if not self.get_item then
			for i = 0, self.drop_item_list.Count - 1 do
				if (user_party_leader.Position - self.drop_item_list[i].Position).magnitude < item_dist_limit and
					self.drop_item_list[i] ~= nil then
					if self.drop_item_list[i].ItemPlaceholder.ItemId == self.cactus_item_id then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
								stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_cactus_event, self))
					elseif self.drop_item_list[i].ItemPlaceholder.ItemId == self.banana_item_id then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
								stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_banana_event, self))
					end

					self.drop_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()

					self.drop_item_list:RemoveAt(i)

					break
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 아이템 전부 제거
	for i = 0, self.drop_item_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.drop_item_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.drop_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:battle_event()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('section_3_door_' .. i))
	end

	-- 주인공 다가가면 앉은 자세로 변환 - 벌벌 떨며 주저앉아 뒷걸음질 치며

		character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.shake(self.mad_panda_list[i], 0.04, 9999)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'walk4legs' })

		if i == self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mad_panda_list[i], self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, false)
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(self.mad_panda_list[i], self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, false)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0 })
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'walk4legs' })

		if i == self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mad_panda_list[i], self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(self.mad_panda_list[i], self.mad_panda_list[i].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0 })
	end

	-- 뭐, 뭐야!! 우리한테 무슨 원한이 있다고 이러는데?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[0], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_1', skip = true })

	-- 니가 죽어서도 못생긴게 우리 탓이야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[1], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_2', skip = true })

	-- 그게 무슨 말이야?! / 난 영원히 살아있어. 너희들 가슴에
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_3', 'intellect' }, { 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_4', 'mercy' } })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })

	-- 넌 죽었잖아! <b>10 년 전 라제국</b>에서!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[0], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_5', skip = true })

	-- 니가 죽은게 아니라면...리더는 뭐가 돼?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[1], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_6', skip = true })

	-- 그 쬐끄만게 널 얼마나 찾아다녔는데…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[1], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_6_1', skip = true })

	-- (이 시점 흰둥이가 오른쪽 수풀 사이에서 고개를 내밀고 덮칠 준비를 한다)
	local is_big_pet_ready_to_pounce = false
	local big_pet_ready_to_pounce = function()
		self.big_pet.Position = vector(223, 1, -37)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.big_pet, self.big_pet.Position + vector(-4.5, 0, 0), 2, false)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.big_pet, { name = 'pounce_ready', count = 1 })
		character_util.set_anim(self.big_pet, { name = 'pounce_ready_loop' })
		is_big_pet_ready_to_pounce = true
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(big_pet_ready_to_pounce))

	-- 리더라니..? / 쬐끄만거라니..?
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_7', 'intellect' }, { 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_8', 'mercy' } })

	-- 이 유령이 보자보자하니까 진짜..
	character_util.stop_shake(self.mad_panda_list[1])
	character_util.stop_shake(self.mad_panda_list[0])
	character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[1], { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[0], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mad_panda_list[0], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_2_9', skip = true })

	-- (흰둥이 습격 - QTE 가 뜬다. 뒤로 스와이프 하면 기사 뒤로 펄쩍. 놓치면 휜둥이 찍기 공격에 당해 뒤로 한바퀴 뒤로 돌며 넉백 / 쓰러짐. 이 경우 잠시 부르르 떨다가 일어남).
	-- 흰둥이가 위치를 다 잡기 전까진 진행이 되지 않게 함.
	while not is_big_pet_ready_to_pounce do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.big_pet, { name = 'pounce', loop = false, scale = 1.3 })
	character_util.move_to(self.big_pet, vector(211, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z), 0.7, nil, true, false)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	end))

	-- 배틀게이트 닫음
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i))
	end

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, 'qte')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')

	local duration = 0.3
	local time_passed = 0
	self.is_use_qte = true
	self.is_qte_success = false

	while time_passed < duration and not self.is_qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_use_qte = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })

	if self.is_qte_success then

-- 펫과의 전투에서 승리한 뒤 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:defeat_pet()
	local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)

	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	-- 배틀게이트 열림
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. i))
	end

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.big_pet)

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.mad_panda_list[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	camera_util.move_async(vector(208, 0, -35.5), 0)

	party_util.align_party(vector(207, 0, -36), 'left', 0, 'arc')

	character_util.set_position(self.big_pet, vector(212, 0, -36))
	character_util.set_direction(self.big_pet, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.big_pet)

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.mad_panda_list[i], vector(213, 0, -34 - 3 * i))
		character_util.set_direction(self.mad_panda_list[i], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.mad_panda_list[i], { name = 'hurt' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready_loop', scale = 0.2 })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.big_pet, { name = 'shout' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.big_pet, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 크르르릉...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_growl_wolf_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.big_pet, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_4', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(self.big_pet, self.big_pet.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
		1.8, nil, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.big_pet)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.big_pet)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.big_pet, nil, 'question')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.big_pet, self.big_pet.Position + vector(-1.8, 0, 0),
			1.8, nil, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.big_pet, { name = 'pat' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local wait_for_branch = true
	local selection = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s4_5"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
		end}

	local talk_branch_2 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("futurecastle_main_a_s4_6"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			selection = 1
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.big_pet
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 쓰다듬는다 / 공격한다
	if selection == 0 then
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				0.5, nil, true, true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.5, 'big_pet')
		camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 1, true)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'smile' })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('big_pet')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.5, self.time_scale_key)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				0.5, nil, true, false)

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod(self.time_scale_key)
	end

	-- 속박 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throne_chain_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_wolf_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_01')
	self.chain_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.chain_effect.transform.localPosition = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local float_duration = 0.3

	local start_pos = user_party_leader.Position
	local float_y = 1.8

	camera_util.move(vector(206.5, 0, -35), float_duration)
	camera_util.resize_to(3, float_duration)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_player, self))

	character_util.set_anim(self.big_pet, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.jump(self.big_pet, 1, 0.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < float_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / float_duration

		character_util.set_position(
				user_party_leader, start_pos + vector(0, float_y * normalized, 0), true)

		self.chain_effect.transform.localPosition = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.big_pet)
	character_util.move_to(self.big_pet, self.big_pet.Position + vector(3.8, 0, 0),
			1.5, nil, false, true)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(208.5, 0, -35.5), 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_appear, self))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	character_util.set_direction(future_princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'sing' })

	-- 괜찮아 흰둥아?
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.big_pet)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(future_princess, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_7', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(future_princess, future_princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'push' })

	-- 팬더 녀석들은 그렇다 치고 널 몰아붙이다니..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(future_princess, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_8', skip = true })

	-- 대체 어떤 녀석이길…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(future_princess, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_9', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(future_princess)
	character_util.set_direction(future_princess, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- ! 이모티콘.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(future_princess, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(future_princess, nil, 'notice')

	-- 주인공 앞으로 달려와 위를 올려다봄.
	character_util.remove_emotion(future_princess)
	character_util.move_to_async(future_princess, future_princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			1, nil, false, true)

	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'nod' })
	wait_for_sec(0.10825)
	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'nod', scale = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.remove_emotion(future_princess)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- ...너….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(future_princess, { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_11', skip = true })

	-- (잠시 딜레이)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (뒷걸음질)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		character_util.shake(future_princess, 0.02, 0.3)
		character_util.move_to_async(future_princess, future_princess.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1, false, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- ...{주인공이름}...?
	character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			future_princess, { key = { 'futurecastle_main_a_s4_12', user.Name }, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_clear_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--yield_return_func(self.chapter_end_theatre, self)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	-- 다음 스테이지로 이동
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap('exit_next_stage', "passage_10_1", nil, true, nil)
	--CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

function local_class:chapter_end_theatre()
	-- 챕터완료 프리팹 풀이 로드가 되있지않은 상태라면 로드할때까지 기다려준다.
	local curtain_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('theatre_chapter_cleared_curtain')

	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitUntilLoaded(curtain_pool))

	-- UI동작을 막는다.
	ui_scene_manager:SetUIEventReceive(false)

	local curtain = curtain_pool:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)

	curtain.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro)).text = game_string:GetString('chapter_ending_to_be_continue')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_chapter_clear_01')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	-- 챕터 완료 연출 대기
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 챕터 완료 연출 종료
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	curtain:Dispose()

	-- UI동작을 다시 가능하게 해준다.
	ui_scene_manager:SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

-- 플레이어 회전하는 연출
function local_class:rotate_player()
	local angle = 20

	character_util.spine_rotate(user_party_leader, 20, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	while true do
		angle = angle * -1

		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party_leader, angle, 2)

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

-- 공주 등장 연출
function local_class:princess_appear()
	local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)

	-- 화면 틴트
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holy_02')
	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.princess_appear_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(208.5, 0, -36)

-- 걷기 무한 반복
function local_class:walk_loop()
	local speed = 2

	local walker_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	walker_list:Add(user_party_leader)
	walker_list:Add(self.future_princess)
	walker_list:Add(self.big_pet)

	-- 루프 시작지점까지는 그냥 걸어감
	for i = 0, walker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(walker_list[i], { name = 'walk' })

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.move_to(walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z),
					nil, speed, true, false)
		elseif i == 1 then
			character_util.move_to(walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x + 1, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z),
					nil, speed, true, false)
		else
			character_util.move_to(walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x - 4, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z),
					nil, speed, true, false)
		end
	end

	-- 무한루프 걷기
	while self.is_walk do
		-- is_stop 이면 일단 멈춤. 걷기 애니메이션은 연출 멈추고 시작할때 끄고 키는것으로.
		if self.is_stop ~= true then
			if user_party_leader.Position.x > self.loop_end_x then
				local diff = user_party_leader.Position.x - self.loop_end_x

				for i = 0, walker_list.Count - 1 do
					if i == 0 then
						character_util.set_position(
								walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x + diff, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z))
					elseif i == 1 then
						character_util.set_position(
								walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x + diff + 1, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z))
					else
						character_util.set_position(
								walker_list[i], vector(self.loop_start_x + diff - 4, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z))
					end
				end
			else
				for i = 0, walker_list.Count - 1 do
					local cur_x = walker_list[i].Position.x + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

					character_util.set_position(walker_list[i], vector(cur_x, 0, walker_list[i].Position.z))
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 걷기 종료되면 끝까지 이동
	local dest_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	dest_list:Add(vector(35.5, 0, -0.5))
	dest_list:Add(vector(36.5, 0, -0.5))
	dest_list:Add(vector(31.5, 0, -0.5))

	for i = 0, walker_list.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		waypoint_list:Add(dest_list[i])

		character_util.move_waypoint(walker_list[i], waypoint_list, speed, false, 'stop',
				'floor', 'right')
	end

	local waited = 0
	while waited ~= walker_list.Count do
		waited = 0

		for i = 0, walker_list.Count - 1 do
			if walker_list[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.walk_finished = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.highlight_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				self.knight_grave)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

		-- 서브 마커 배치
		if stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_craig_event, false) and
				stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_sohee_event, false) then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.tent_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
					get_field_object(self.princess_tent_name).Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5))
		else
			if not stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_craig_event, false) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.craig_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
						get_character(self.craig_name))
			end

			if not stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_sohee_event, false) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.sohee_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
						get_character(self.sohee_name))
			end
		end
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_ready_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_fire_preset)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.barricade_monster_list = nil
	self.knight_grave = nil

	if self.princess_appear_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.princess_appear_effect)
		self.princess_appear_effect = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.highlight_effect) then
		self.highlight_effect:Dispose()
		self.highlight_effect = nil
	end

	-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
	if self.reminiscence_characters ~= nil and self.controller.experimental_destroy_character then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.reminiscence_characters)
		self.reminiscence_characters = nil
	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent) then
		self:on_convert_wall_changed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.entrance_event_zone_name  then
		if self.enter_camp == false then
			self.enter_camp = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_camp_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.break_barricade then
			self.current_progress = self.scene_progress.break_barricade

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_barricade_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.princess_tent_exit_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.clean_grave then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					self.knight_grave)
		else
			local princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, princess)
		end

		if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.convert_switch then
			if not stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_craig_event, false) then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.craig_quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.craig_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
						get_character(self.craig_name))
			end

			if not stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.custom_key.finished_sohee_event, false) then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.sohee_quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.sohee_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
						get_character(self.sohee_name))
			end
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.princess_tent_inside_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.sohee_quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.craig_quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.tent_quest_marker_name)

		if self.current_progress == self.scene_progress.convert_switch then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					get_field_object(self.princess_tent_exit_name))
		elseif self.current_progress ~= self.scene_progress.clean_grave then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					get_field_object(self.convert_switch_name))
		end
	--섹션 8 레지스탕스 싸움
	elseif zone_name == self.camp_event_zone_name  then
		if self.resistance_camp == false then
			self.resistance_camp = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_convert_wall_changed_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.convert_switch then
		self.current_progress = self.scene_progress.convert_switch

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				get_field_object(self.princess_tent_exit_name))

		character_util.set_position(get_character(self.future_princess_name), vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, future_princess) then
		if self.current_progress == self.scene_progress.clean_grave then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.future_history, self)
		end
	end

	for i = 4, 8 do
		local grave = get_field_object('gravestone_' .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, grave) then

			if i ~= 8 and self.current_progress >= self.scene_progress.interact_grave and self.clean_grave[i - 3] == false then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cleaning_grave, self, grave, i)
			else
				if i == 8 and self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.interact_grave then
					self.current_progress = self.scene_progress.interact_grave
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_princess, self)
				else
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_grave, self, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.convert_switch then
			if e.Params[0] == self.craig_event_finished then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.craig_quest_marker_name)
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.sohee_event_finished then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.sohee_quest_marker_name)

				if self.current_progress < self.scene_progress.convert_switch then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.tent_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, false,
							get_field_object(self.princess_tent_name).Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5))
				end

				-- 소히와 대화한 것 메인 퀘스트에 키로 저장
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
						self.controller.quest_progress, self.has_sohee_marian_blueprint, 1))
			end
		end
	end
end

	character_util.set_direction(resistance_watcher_list[2], 'down')

	character_util.set_direction(resistance_watcher_list[3], 'up')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_watcher_list[3], { key = 'futurecastle_main_a_s6_2' })

		character_util.look_at(resistance_watcher_list[i], user_party_leader)

--- 회상 추격씬에서 소히가 마기톤 체인을 사용하는 씬
function local_class:sohee_use_magiton()
	local sohee = self.reminiscence_characters['sohee']
	local target_invaders = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do table.insert(target_invaders, self.reminiscence_characters['chase_invader_' .. i]) end

	-- 마기톤 체인 스킬 상수 정의
	local shoot_duration = 1.25
	local shoot_max_count = 14
	local shoot_interval = shoot_duration / shoot_max_count
	local shoot_offset = 0.75

	local cast_time = 0.45
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_fox_ball_03'})
	sohee:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	character_util.set_anim(sohee, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, scale = 1.9 })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_ready_preset):Instantiate(sohee.Position)
	wait_for_sec(cast_time)

	-- 마키톤 체인 연출 루프
	local shoot_count = 0
	local time_passed = shoot_interval
	while shoot_count < shoot_max_count do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= shoot_interval then
			shoot_count = shoot_count + 1

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_impact_lightning_02' })

			-- 카메라와의 거리가 4타일 이하일때만 쉐이크 해줌.
			local cam_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(stage_camera.LookAtPosition - sohee.Position).magnitude
			if cam_diff <= 4 then
				camera_util.shake(0.18 + shoot_count * 0.05, 0.1)
			end

			character_util.set_anim(sohee, {name = 'rifle_shoot2', scale = 1.9})

			-- 소히가 인베이더들에게 마기톤 체인을 날림.
			local sohee_shoot_point = sohee.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(sohee.Direction) * shoot_offset +
					unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.1
			local chain_indexes = { 1, 4, 6 }
			for i, invader in pairs(target_invaders) do

				-- 앞 줄 인베이더들에게 붙는 체인
				if table_util.contain_value(chain_indexes, i) then
					local chain1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_preset):Instantiate(sohee_shoot_point)
					self:set_ray(chain1, sohee_shoot_point, invader.Position)
				end

				-- 각 히트 당하는 인베이더들에게 붙는 체인
				if i ~= 1 then
					local chain2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_chain_preset):Instantiate(sohee_shoot_point)
					self:set_ray(chain2, target_invaders[i - 1].Position, invader.Position)
				end

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.magiton_fire_preset):Instantiate(invader.Position)

				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader)
				invader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
				invader:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
			end

			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	sohee:SetAnimation('seat', true)

	-- 인베이더들 모두 날려버림.
	for _, invader in pairs(target_invaders) do
		character_util.air_spin(invader, {offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3, play_deathsfx = true})
	end
end

--- 소히 체인 라이트닝 이어붙여주는 함수
function local_class:set_ray(chain, start_point, target_point)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(start_point - target_point)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, diff.normalized)
	local target_scale = diff.magnitude

	local scale_comp = chain:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScalingEffect))
	scale_comp:SetTransform(target_point, rot, target_scale)
end

function local_class:chase_stick_scene()
	local marvin = self.reminiscence_characters['marvin']
	local china = user_util.has_fei() and self.reminiscence_characters['chase_fei'] or self.reminiscence_characters['chase_mei']
	local shapira = self.reminiscence_characters['chase_shapira']
	local eva = self.reminiscence_characters['eva']

	local b_invaders = {}
	for i = 7, 22 do table.insert(b_invaders, self.reminiscence_characters['chase_invader_' .. i]) end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_jump_01')
	local b_champions = { marvin, eva, china, shapira }
	local assault_scene = function(invader, assault_pos)
		character_util.jump(invader, 2.5, 0.75)
		invader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
		character_util.move_to_async(invader, assault_pos, 0.75)

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small'):Instantiate(invader.Position)

		table_util.for_each(b_champions, function(_, champ)
			if champ.Bounds:Intersects(invader.Bounds) then
				champ:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
			end
		end)
	end

	local assault_routines = {}
	local assault_ref_pos = vector(21, 0, 62.5)
	for _, invader in pairs(b_invaders) do
		invader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, 1)

		local assault_pos = vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(assault_ref_pos, 0.85)
		local routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(assault_scene, invader, assault_pos))
		table.insert(assault_routines, routine)

		wait_for_sec(0.05)
	end

	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(assault_routines)
end

	local rah_resistance_num = 6

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이펙트 로드
	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local rain_screen_effect = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			resholder, 'effects/stage/weather', 'fx_env_rain_screen_fx', function(prefab)
				rain_screen_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				rain_screen_effect.transform:SetParent(stage_camera.Transform.parent)
				rain_screen_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

function local_class:show_messy_text_async(data)
	local key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'key')
	local screen_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'screen_pos', vector(0, 0))
	local type_speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type_speed', 0.05)
	local max_width = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'max_width', 300)
	local text_size = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'text_size', 25)
	local text_angle = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'text_angle', 0)
	local move_dir = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'move_dir')
	local move_speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'move_speed', 0.3)
	local life_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'life_time', 2)
	local text_color = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'text_color')
	local alpha_fade_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'alpha_fade_time', -1)

	local text = game_string:GetString(key)
	coroutine.yield(CS.MessyText.ShowSkippableText(text, screen_pos, type_speed, max_width,
			text_size, text_angle, move_dir, move_speed, life_time, text_color, alpha_fade_time))
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.training_event_zone_name then
		-- 오른쪽으로 나갔을 때
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.talking_scene and user_party_leader.Position.x > 128 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.talking_scene
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_craig, self, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_invaders, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.resistance_battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.resistance_defeat_invaders, self))
	end
end

-- 바리케이드 파괴 지역 입장 이벤트
function local_class:break_barricade_event()
	local break_barricade = get_field_object(self.break_barricade_name)
	local barricade_pos = break_barricade.Position

	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

	-- 배틀게이트 닫음
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		if i ~= 3 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i))
		end
	end

	-- 인베이더 UI 임시로 제거
	for i = 0, self.barricade_monster_list.Count - 1 do
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.barricade_monster_list[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	-- 인베이더들 달려옴
	for i = 0, 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		character_util.set_position(self.barricade_monster_list[i], vector(barricade_pos.x - 1 - val, 0, barricade_pos.z - mod + 1))
		character_util.set_direction(self.barricade_monster_list[i], 'right')
	end

	local marker_1 = field:GetMarker('s7_battle_monster_1')
	for i = 2, 3 do
		local mod = i % 2
		character_util.set_position(self.barricade_monster_list[i], marker_1.position + vector(0, -1.5, mod))
		character_util.set_direction(self.barricade_monster_list[i], 'left')
	end

	local marker_2 = field:GetMarker('s7_battle_monster_2')
	for i = 4, 6 do
		character_util.set_position(self.barricade_monster_list[i], marker_2.position + vector(i - 5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.barricade_monster_list[i], 'up')
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, 1 do
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.barricade_monster_list[i], vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.set_anim(self.barricade_monster_list[i], { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 바리케이드 파괴되고 인베이더들 등장
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset):Instantiate(barricade_pos)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	for i = 0, 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.barricade_monster_list[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_roar_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_minotaurs_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 바리케이드 제거
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.break_barricade_name, 'disabled')

	-- 인베이더 침입한 쪽 바리케이드 닫음
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. 3))

	-- 인베이더 UI 활성화
	for i = 0, self.barricade_monster_list.Count - 1 do
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.barricade_monster_list[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	-- 인베이더 침입
	for i = 0, 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.barricade_monster_list[i], { name = 'run' })
		character_util.move_to(self.barricade_monster_list[i], self.barricade_monster_list[i].Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				1, nil, true, false)
	end

	for i = 2, 3 do
		character_util.jump_move(self.barricade_monster_list[i], self.barricade_monster_list[i].Position + vector(-4, 1, 0), 5, 1, false)
	end

	for i = 4, 6 do
		character_util.jump_move(self.barricade_monster_list[i], self.barricade_monster_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 5), 6, 2, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_appear,
			self, field:GetMarker('s7_princess_battle').position))

	for i = 0, self.barricade_monster_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.barricade_monster_list[i])
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.barricade_monster_list[i], self.battle_group_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.barricade_monster_list[i], user_party_leader, 'battle')
	end

	-- 공주 전투 시작하기 전에 몹 전멸하면 버그 발생하므로 미연에 방지
	character_util.set_immortal(self.barricade_monster_list[0], true)

	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_immortal(self.barricade_monster_list[0], false)
end

function local_class:defeat_invaders()
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	end
end

-- 무덤 이끼 때기
function local_class:cleaning_grave(grave, i)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name .. i)
	self.clean_grave[i - 3] = true
	self.clean_grave_count = self.clean_grave_count + 1

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self:get_grave_name(i - 3) })

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	--character_util.set_side_direction(user_party_leader)
	local dir = grave.Position.x > user_party_leader.Position.x and 'right' or 'left'
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, dir)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'eat'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	equipping_sfx:FadeOut()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lights_01', volume = 0.5, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local twinkle = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset):Instantiate(grave.Bounds.center + vector(0, 2, -1))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	grave.Transform:Find('a').gameObject:SetActive(true)
	grave.Transform:Find('b').gameObject:SetActive(false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	twinkle:Dispose()

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	-- 4개의 무덤을 다했으면 씬 시작.
	if self.clean_grave_count == 4 then
		self.current_progress = self.scene_progress.clean_grave

		self:grave_end_event()
	end
end

	--에바, 마빈, 메이, 샤피라…

	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_main_part_a_s7_talk_5', skip = true})
	--자주 들르지 못해서 미안해.

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'futurecastle_main_part_a_s7_talk_6', skip = true})

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 세력 분리 씬

	if self.reminiscence_characters ~= nil and self.controller.experimental_destroy_character then

function local_class:princess_appear(target_pos)
	local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_battle_name)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_holy_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 화면 틴트
	field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 0.3)

	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.princess_appear_effect.transform.localPosition = target_pos

	-- 미래 공주 등장
	character_util.set_position(future_princess, target_pos + vector(0, 10, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(future_princess, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.4
	local start_pos = future_princess.Position

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, future_princess.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time <= fall_duration do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(future_princess, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(future_princess,  vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 2)

	character_util.set_position(future_princess, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(false)

	character_util.remove_anim(future_princess)
	character_util.remove_emotion(future_princess)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(future_princess, user_party, true)

	local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party_leader)
	battle:AddAlly(future_princess)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent.Create(battle))
end

function local_class:princess_disappear()
	local future_princess = get_character(self.future_princess_battle_name)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_princess_shoot_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.convert_to_npc(future_princess, user_party, true)

	local start_pos = future_princess.Position

	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(true)
	self.princess_appear_effect.transform.localPosition = start_pos

	character_util.set_direction(future_princess, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(future_princess.Direction))
	character_util.set_emotion(future_princess, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(future_princess, { name = 'cast2' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, 0, 1, fall_duration))
		character_util.set_position(future_princess, start_pos + vector(0, 10 * progress, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(future_princess, vector(999, 0, 999))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(false)

	character_util.remove_anim(future_princess)
	character_util.remove_emotion(future_princess)
end

-- 레지스탕스 캠프 내부 입장 이벤트
function local_class:battle_event()
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

	-- 배틀게이트 닫음
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.resistance_battlegate_name..i))
	end

	local monsters = {}
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local monster = get_character(self.camp_invader_name .. i)
		monsters[i] = monster
	end

	-- 인베이더 UI 임시로 제거
	for i = 1, #monsters do
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(monsters[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	local marker_1 = field:GetMarker('s8_battle_monster_1')
	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.set_position(monsters[i], marker_1.position + vector(i - 2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(monsters[i], 'down')
	end

	local marker_2 = field:GetMarker('s8_battle_monster_2')
	for i = 4, 5 do
		local mod = i % 2
		character_util.set_position(monsters[i], marker_2.position + vector(0, -1, mod))
		character_util.set_direction(monsters[i], 'right')
	end

	local marker_3 = field:GetMarker('s8_battle_monster_3')
	for i = 6, 7 do
		local mod = i % 2
		character_util.set_position(monsters[i], marker_3.position + vector(-1, 0, mod))
		character_util.set_direction(monsters[i], 'left')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_roar_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_minotaurs_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 인베이더 침입
	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.jump_move(monsters[i], monsters[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -5), 7.5, 1, false)
	end

	for i = 4, 5 do
		character_util.jump_move(monsters[i], monsters[i].Position + vector(5, 1, 0), 7.5, 1, false)
	end

	for i = 6, 7 do
		character_util.jump_move(monsters[i], monsters[i].Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), 6, 1, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_appear,
			self, field:GetMarker('s8_princess_battle').position))

	for i = 1, #monsters do
		-- 인베이더 UI 활성화

	--[[

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,

	--]]

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.craig = nil
	self.sohee = nil
	self.lavi = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--[[
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end
	--]]

	return false
end

--[[
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.sohee_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_sohee_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_sohee_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sohee_event, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 터렛 이동
function local_class:move_turret(turret, end_x, duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = turret.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration
		local diff_x = (end_x - start_pos.x) * normalized

		turret.Position = vector(start_pos.x + diff_x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	turret.Position = vector(end_x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)
end

-- 아군과 적군의 미는 이벤트
function local_class:push_event()
	local is_push_ally = false
	local timer = 0
	local push_duration = 3
	local is_move = false

	while self.is_pull_and_push do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 아군이 밀림
		if is_push_ally then
			if not is_move then
				is_move = true

				for i = 0, self.push_ally_list.Count - 1 do
					character_util.set_emotion(self.push_ally_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
					character_util.move_to(self.push_ally_list[i],
							self.push_ally_list[i].Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
							1, nil, false, false)
				end

				for i = 0, self.push_enemy_list.Count - 1 do
					character_util.set_emotion(self.push_enemy_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
					character_util.move_to(self.push_enemy_list[i],
							self.push_enemy_list[i].Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
							1, nil, false, false)
				end
			end

			if timer > push_duration then
				timer = 0
				is_push_ally = false
				is_move = false
			end
		else
			if not is_move then
				is_move = true

				for i = 0, self.push_ally_list.Count - 1 do
					character_util.set_emotion(self.push_ally_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
					character_util.move_to(self.push_ally_list[i],
							self.push_ally_list[i].Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
							1, nil, false, false)
				end

				for i = 0, self.push_enemy_list.Count - 1 do
					character_util.set_emotion(self.push_enemy_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
					character_util.move_to(self.push_enemy_list[i],
							self.push_enemy_list[i].Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
							1, nil, false, false)
				end
			end

			if timer > push_duration then
				timer = 0
				is_push_ally = true
				is_move = false
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	self.get_human_emotion_pool()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local factor = get_field_object('move_factor')
	factor.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_first, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local saviour = get_character('chapter_end_saviour')
	if saviour.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		saviour.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.bg_battlefield ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bg_battlefield.gameObject)
		self.bg_battlefield = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.bugs ~= nil then
		for _, bug in ipairs(self.bugs) do
			CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bug.gameObject)
		end
		self.bugs = nil
	end

	if self.blood_effect ~= nil then
		self.blood_effect:Dispose()
		self.blood_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('chapter_end_saviour')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_end, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'section2_preloaded' then
		self.wait_preload_section2 = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.white_bug_loop then
		-- 터치 위치 저장
		local touch_pos_with_y = stage_camera.Camera:ScreenToWorldPoint(e.TouchPos:GetXy0())
		local add_z = touch_pos_with_y.y
		local touch_pos = vector(touch_pos_with_y.x, 0, touch_pos_with_y.z + add_z)

		local white_bug_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.bug_white.transform.position, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5)
		local touch_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(touch_pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.1)
		if white_bug_bound:Intersects(touch_bound) then
			self.white_bug_loop = false
			return true
		end

		if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled and self.wait_pad_time > 5.0 then
			self.white_bug_loop = false
			return true
		end

	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight and not self.swipe_check then
		self.swipe_check = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 페러렉스 스크롤링
function local_class:parallax_scrolling(transform_table, start_pos, end_pos, time)
	local time_passed = 0
	local increment = 1 / #transform_table * 0.3
	local start_positions = {}

	for i, back in ipairs(transform_table) do
		table.insert(start_positions, back.localPosition)
	end

	while time_passed < time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		for i, back in ipairs(transform_table) do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / time)
			local camera_travel = end_pos.z - cur_pos.z
			local multiplier = increment * i
			local offset = camera_travel * multiplier

			if i ~= 3 then
				back.localPosition = vector(back.localPosition.x, start_positions[i].y - offset,  back.localPosition.z)
			else
				back.localPosition = vector(back.localPosition.x, start_positions[i].y + offset * 0.35,  back.localPosition.z)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i, back in ipairs(transform_table) do
		back.localPosition = start_positions[i]
	end
end

-- 흰 벌레 움직임 및 터지는 로직
function local_class:fly_bug_white()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	local animaton_state =  CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.bug_white.transform,
		  'spine_front'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	local center = self.intro_show_pos + vector(0, 0, -32.5)
	self.bug_white.transform.position = center + vector(15,0,3)
	animaton_state:SetAnimation(0, "fly_front", true)
	local fly_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_fly_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "default"})

	local move_time = 5
	local idle_time = 2
	local time_passed = move_time
	self.wait_pad_time = 0

	while self.white_bug_loop do
	   time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.wait_pad_time = self.wait_pad_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	   if time_passed >= move_time then
		  local rand_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-6.5, 6.5)
		  local rand_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-3, 3)
		  local end_pos = center + vector(rand_x,0, rand_z)
		  coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_bug,
				self, self.bug_white, end_pos, move_time - idle_time, true))
		  time_passed = 0
	   end
	   coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	animaton_state:SetAnimation(0, "die_front", true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_hit_01')
	fly_sfx:Stop()

	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_bug_splash'):Instantiate(self.bug_white.transform.position)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bug_white.gameObject)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function(effect, start_pos)
		local time = 0

		local free_fall_fire = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 4.9, 0, 0)
		while time < 2 do
			time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			free_fall_fire:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local dist_z = free_fall_fire:GetDistance()
			effect.transform.position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1) * dist_z
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end, effect, effect.transform.position))
 end

-- 벌레 움직임용
 function local_class:moving_bug(target, end_pos, duration, is_first)
	local start_pos = target.transform.position
	local dir = end_pos - start_pos
	local moving_option = false

	if math.abs(dir.x) < math.abs(dir.z) then
	   moving_option = true
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration and (not is_first or self.white_bug_loop) do
	   time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	   local angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0,360, time_passed / duration)
	   local current_plus = unity_class.mathf.Sin(math.rad(angle))
	   local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)

	   if not moving_option then
		  target.transform.position = current_pos + vector(0,0,current_plus)
	   else
		  target.transform.position = current_pos + vector(current_plus,0,0)
	   end

	   coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.white_bug_loop then
	   target.transform.position = end_pos
	end

 end

function local_class:camera_shake_loop()
	local duration = 2

	while self.shake_loop_stat do
		camera_util.shake(0.08, duration * 0.7)
		wait_for_sec(4)
		if self.shake_loop_stat == false then
			break
		end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	end
end

function local_class:kinght_scale_position(knight)
	while self.shake_loop_stat do
		local min_z = self.intro_show_pos.z + 9.12
		local max_z = self.intro_show_pos.z + 11
		local size = max_z - min_z

		local pos_z = knight.Position.z
		if min_z < pos_z then
			local dist = (knight.Position.z - min_z) / size
			knight.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * (1.4 - dist * 0.15), 0.02)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.02)
	end
end

function local_class:bug_boom(character, wait_time)
	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	character_util.shake(character, 0.08, 1.3)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_bug_circle'):Instantiate(character.Position)
	character_util.remove_emotion(character)

	character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'unique/half_dead', loop = false, scale = 1.5 })

	while self.shake_loop_stat do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	wait_for_sec(wait_time * 0.4)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bug_explosion'):Instantiate(character.Position)
	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')
	effect:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	local sec_3 = math.floor(self.hero_list.Count / 3) * 3 + self.hero_list.Count % 3
