function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.tutorial_invader_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.tutorial_invader_num do
		self.tutorial_invader_list:Add(get_character(self.tutorial_invader_name..i))
	end

	self.lorain_head = get_field_object(self.lorain_head_name)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = self.lorain_head.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.lorain_clone_spine_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.SpineController)
	self.lorain_clone_spine_for_event_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.SpineController)

	for i = 1, self.lorain_clone_num do
		local cur_clone = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_name..i)
		local spine_controller = cur_clone.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		self.lorain_clone_spine_list:Add(spine_controller)

		local cur_clone_for_event = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_for_event_name..i)
		local spine_controller_for_event = cur_clone_for_event.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		spine_controller_for_event:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'prostrate', true)
		spine_controller_for_event:SetEmotion('empty', true)

		self.lorain_clone_spine_for_event_list:Add(spine_controller_for_event)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 10 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

	-- 로레인 클론 위치 바꿔치기는 여기서 진행
	for i = 1, self.lorain_clone_num do
		local cur_clone = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_name..i)
		local cur_clone_for_event = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_for_event_name..i)

		cur_clone_for_event.Position = cur_clone.Position
		cur_clone.Position = vector(200, 0, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.princess = nil

	self.tutorial_invader_list = nil

	self.lorain_head = nil
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = nil

	self.lorain_clone_spine_list = nil
	self.lorain_clone_spine_for_event_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		self:on_throw_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_tutorial_event and not self.is_throw_lorain_head and
			(zone_name == self.tutorial_event_zone_name_1 or zone_name == self.tutorial_event_zone_name_2) then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_tutorial_event

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tutorial_event, self, zone_name)
	end
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lorain_head) then
		-- 로레인 머리가 인베이더와 같은 그리드에 있을 때만 작동
		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(e.Target.Position, self.tutorial_invader_list[0].Position) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.lorain_clone_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil then
		if e.Params.Length == 2 then
			if not self.is_detected and e.Params[0] == self.detected_event then
				self.is_detected = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.player_detected, self, e.Sender))
			end
		elseif e.Params.Length == 1 then
			if e.Params[0] == self.lorain_head_out_event then
				self.is_lorain_head_out = true
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.lorain_head_in_event then
				self.is_lorain_head_out = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_event(zone_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	-- 로레인 머리는 밖에 나와 있을 경우, 이 때 집어 넣어준다.
	if self.is_lorain_head_out then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'press_lorain_button' }))

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)
	self.princess:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 로레인 머리 나오게 함

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'press_lorain_button' }))

		self.lorain_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right')

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'left')
	end

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lorain_head_shake, self, 30, 1))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lorain_head, { key = self.main_script..1, skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-0.5, 0, 23), 1)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lorain_head, { key = self.main_script..2, skip = true })

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	self.princess:HideWeapon(false)

	self.lorain_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', true)

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

-- 로레인 까딱거리는 연출
function local_class:lorain_head_shake(magnitude, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = -magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = -magnitude / 2
	end_angle = magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 2 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 2)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = magnitude / 2
	end_angle = 0

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))
end

-- 인베이더 클론에게 당하면서 소리지르는 이벤트
function local_class:invader_scream_event()
	local action_duration = 0.3
	local timer = action_duration

	for i = 0, self.tutorial_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], 'left')
		end

		character_util.shake(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], 0.04, 9999)
		character_util.set_anim(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
	end

	-- 로레인 클론 위치 바꿔치기는 여기서 진행
	for i = 1, self.lorain_clone_num do
		local cur_clone = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_name..i)
		local cur_clone_for_event = get_field_object(self.lorain_clone_for_event_name..i)

		cur_clone_for_event.Position = cur_clone.Position
		cur_clone.Position = vector(200, 0, 0)

		self.lorain_clone_spine_for_event_list[i - 1]:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'eat', true)
		self.lorain_clone_spine_for_event_list[i - 1]:Shake(0.04, 9999)
	end

	while self.is_attacked_invader do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= action_duration then
			timer = 0

			for i = 0, self.tutorial_invader_list.Count - 1 do
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
						self.tutorial_invader_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0))

				character_util.jump(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], 0.3, 0.3)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1.5, 0.3)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.tutorial_invader_list[i], 1.5, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

				self.lorain_clone_spine_list[i]:Jump(0.3, 0.3)

				if i == 0 then
					character_util.spine_deviate_local(
							self.tutorial_invader_list[i], vector(0.1, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
				else
					character_util.spine_deviate_local(
							self.tutorial_invader_list[i], vector(-0.1, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.1)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.little_princess = get_character(self.little_princess_name)
	self.little_princess.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.little_princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_princess, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.little_princess, self.little_princess_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.little_princess, 'left')

	self.little_guardian = get_character(self.little_guardian_name)
	self.little_guardian.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.little_guardian, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	self.little_guardian.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.little_guardian, 0.7, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.little_guardian, 30, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.little_guardian, self.little_guardian_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.little_guardian, 'left')

	self.lorain_head = get_field_object(self.lorain_head_name)
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = self.lorain_head.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.exit_stage = get_field_object(self.exit_stage_name)
	self.exit_stage.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 로레인 클론 리액션 시작
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'lorain_clone_reaction_true' }))

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5, 0, 148.5))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.princess = nil

	self.lorain_head = nil
	self.lorain_head_spine_controller = nil

	self.exit_stage = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent)  then
		self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event and
			zone_name == self.waypoint_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_waypoint_event

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.waypoint_event, self)
	elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.roll_lorain_event and
			zone_name == self.roll_lorain_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.roll_lorain_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lorain_head_roll_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_little_princess_guardian_event and e.CameraGrid.name == self.event_cameragrid_name then
		self.is_little_princess_guardian_event = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_and_guardian_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_little_princess_guardian_event and e.CameraGrid.name == self.event_cameragrid_name then
		self.is_little_princess_guardian_event = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_stage) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil then
		if e.Params.Length == 1 then
			if e.Params[0] == self.lorain_head_out_event then
				self.is_lorain_head_out = true
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.lorain_head_in_event then
				self.is_lorain_head_out = false
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 꼬마 공주와 가디언 이벤트
function local_class:princess_and_guardian_event()
	while self.is_little_princess_guardian_event do
		local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - vector(22, 0, 69)).magnitude

		if dist > self.princess_guardian_event_dist_limit then
			dist = self.princess_guardian_event_dist_limit
		elseif dist < 1 then
			dist = 1
		end

		character_util.set_position(self.little_princess,
				self.little_princess_pos + vector(0, 0.2 * dist, 0))

		character_util.set_position(self.little_guardian,
				self.little_guardian_pos + vector(-0.17 * dist, 0, 0))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 로레인 까딱거리는 연출
function local_class:lorain_head_shake(magnitude, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = -magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = -magnitude / 2
	end_angle = magnitude / 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 2 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 2)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	start_angle = magnitude / 2
	end_angle = 0

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 4 do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / (duration / 4)
		local cur_angle = start_angle + (end_angle - start_angle) * normalized

		self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lorain_head.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, end_angle))
end

-- 로레인 머리 굴러가는 이벤트
function local_class:lorain_head_roll_event()
	local lorain_head = get_field_object(self.lorain_head_name)

	lorain_head.Position = vector(5.5, 0, 173)

	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	local lorain_head_spine_controller = lorain_head.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	lorain_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	lorain_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'walk', true, 1.8)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local roll_duration = 2.5

	local start_pos = lorain_head.Position
	local start_pos_z = start_pos.z
	local end_pos_z = start_pos_z + 13

	local roll_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < roll_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / roll_duration

		lorain_head.Position = vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos_z + (end_pos_z - start_pos_z) * normalized)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	roll_sfx:FadeOut()

	lorain_head.Position = vector(200, 0, 0)
end

	while not self.end_event and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < scale_duration do
		local cur_scale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
				start_scale, end_scale, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / scale_duration)

		self.burning_screen.transform.localScale = cur_scale

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.burning_screen.transform.localScale = end_scale
end

-- NPC들 가운데로 뒷걸음질치는 연출
function local_class:move_to_center()
	local center = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local anim_list_1 = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	local anim_list_2 = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)

	anim_list_1:Add('sword_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('sword_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('rifle_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('gauntlet_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('katana_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('rifle_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('rifle_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('staff_walk')
	anim_list_1:Add('bow_walk')

	anim_list_2:Add('sword_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('sword_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('rifle_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('gauntlet_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('katana_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('rifle_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('rifle_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('staff_idle')
	anim_list_2:Add('bow_idle')

	for i = 0, self.hero_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_dest = self.hero_list[i].Position + (center - self.hero_list[i].Position) * 0.3

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.move_npc, self, self.hero_list[i], cur_dest, anim_list_1[i], anim_list_2[i]))

		character_util.set_emotion(self.hero_list[i], { name = 'tired' })
	end
end

-- 각 NPC들 실제 이동
function local_class:move_npc(character, dest, anim_name_1, anim_name_2)
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = anim_name_1 })
	character_util.move_to_async(character, dest, nil, 0.5, false, false)

	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = anim_name_2 })
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class
